Contributors: Sh1penfire (world logic)

⚠ PERFORMANCE WARNING: This mod may crash or misbehave on weaker PCs and phones.

Best played with a completely fresh campaign save.

Currently in development. Description will try to increase player engagement later.

Allure is a large RTS mod that attempts to bring a true start-to-finish storyline to the table. And also hardcore gameplay. Enjoy being swarmed by the bee legion.

This mod is planned to introduce an overhauled vanilla experience, with sweeping changes across every aspect of Serpulo. Maps are redone, tutorials added.

What comes after? Well, I guess we'll have to find out. I'm not giving you any spoilers. You'll find out if you're curious.

Enabling this mod will break every Serpulo schematic until disabled. Be careful, well, if you like yours.

Works on beta build 157. Edit the mod.hjson's minGameVersion to use.

docs.text: An extremely durable defensive block, capable of releasing electric arcs at a high rate upon taking damage as well as deflecting bullets with a strong magnetic field.

docs.title: Inseltiene Wall
docs.text: An extremely durable defensive block, capable of releasing electric arcs at a high rate upon taking damage as well as deflecting bullets with a strong magnetic field.

docs.title: Huge Shadow Wall
docs.text: A nearly indestructible defensive block, reinforced with inseltiene.

docs.title: Large Shadow Wall
docs.text: A nearly indestructible defensive block, reinforced with inseltiene.

docs.title: Shadow Wall
docs.text: A nearly indestructible defensive block, reinforced with inseltiene.

docs.title: Tube
docs.text: A limited and slow means of transport, made of basic materials.

docs.title: Tube Bridge
docs.text: A limited form of transport, able to span over other tubes.

docs.title: Atlas Silo
docs.text: A small item silo, designed for the Atlas system.

docs.title: Atlas Cell
docs.text: A liquid cell designed for use with the Atlas system.

docs.title: Anden Stack Belt
docs.text: Uses low-voltage electromagnetic rails to move packets in bulk.

docs.title: Renfrien Stack Belt
docs.text: Uses low-voltage electromagnetic rails to move packets in bulk. Double the throughput of anden belts.

docs.title: Amethyst Stack Belt
docs.text: Uses low-voltage electromagnetic rails to move packets in bulk. Industrial throughput.

docs.title: Shadow Stack Loader
docs.text: Uses shadow to safely compress packets. Outputted packets can be used on all stack belts.

docs.title: Breakpoint
docs.text: Splits belts. Allows for crossing belts easily. Can be configured with any item to sort it from the belt.

docs.title: Elevated Track
docs.text: Transports items over large gaps. Lower throughput.

docs.title: Treads
docs.text: A pile of tank treads. Used to build units.

docs.title: Lightweight Cells
docs.text: A bundle of unarmored cells. Used to build units.

docs.title: Thin Armor
docs.text: A bundle of thin, welded plates. Used to build units.

docs.title: Thruster Module
docs.text: A standard thruster, used for flight in atmosphere. Used to build units.

docs.title: Shielded Cells
docs.text: A bundle of cells with tough armor. Used to build units.

docs.title: Plated Armor
docs.text: A pile of thick, dense armor plates. Used to build units.

docs.title: Exotic Item Source
docs.text: Sandbox only item source with more health.

docs.title: Force Barricade
docs.text: Emits a massive force field. Extremely durable, though slow to recover from overload.

docs.title: Discharge
docs.text: Releases periodic blasts of energy, overcharging nearby power-using blocks.

docs.title: Genesis
docs.text: The ultimate warden healing block. Releases shockwaves of powerful healing.

docs.title: Multiply
docs.text: Assists building in an area around it in pulses. Maintains 500% build speed, splitting it with up to five constructing buildings.

docs.title: Synapse
docs.text: An advanced central node for warden infrastructure. Heavily armored.

docs.title: Silo
docs.text: Stores a mediocre amount of items. Can be used to bolster the Nexus' small capacity.

docs.title: Depot
docs.text: Stores half as much as a Nexus. Can be used to increase the core's capacity.

docs.title: Hangar
docs.text: Stores a mediocre amount of items. Increases core unit control limit.

docs.title: Localize
docs.text: A central nexus of a rebel base. Builds directly from itself. Boasts limited self defense when controlled.

docs.title: Vacuum Tank
docs.text: A storage tank for vacuum conduits. Doubles as a distributor.

docs.title: Vacuum Pump
docs.text: A weak pump, useful for starting out with.

docs.title: Spatial Conduit
docs.text: Pumps liquid at a very large rate, but is extremely vulnerable.

docs.title: Spatial Junction
docs.text: A vulnerable junction intended to cross spatial conduits.

docs.title: Spatial Cell
docs.text: A fast liquid distributor, ideal for use with spatial conduits.

docs.title: Spatial Bridge
docs.text: A powerful, quick bridge intended for use with spatial conduits.

docs.title: Spatial Warp
docs.text: Instantly teleports liquids over longer distances than the bridges.

docs.title: Inseltiene Pump
docs.text: A massive pump, able to feed several structures. Consumes fluid-energy fuel.

docs.title: Exotic Liquid Source
docs.text: A sandbox liquid source with more health.

docs.title: Holo Board
docs.text: A small, limited canvas for simple pixel art.

docs.title: Holo Canvas
docs.text: A large, limited canvas for simple pixel art.

docs.title: Steam Turbine
docs.text: Generates power from the flow of steam. Returns the majority of the water.

docs.title: Dual Turbine
docs.text: Generates a large amount of power from the flow of steam. Returns the majority of the water.

docs.title: Layered Turbine
docs.text: Generates a massive amount of power from the flow of steam. Returns the majority of the water.

docs.title: Industrial Turbine
docs.text: Generates power from the flow of steam.

docs.title: Large Industrial Turbine
docs.text: Generates a large amount of power from the flow of steam.

docs.title: Tri-Turbine
docs.text: Generates a massive amount of power from the flow of steam.

docs.title: Solar Heater
docs.text: Concentrates solar energy through a lens to boil a small amount of water.

docs.title: Flow Turbine
docs.text: Generates a meager amount of power from flowing water.

docs.title: Thermal Boiler
docs.text: Heats a large amount of water with geothermal output.

docs.title: Gaseous Reactor
docs.text: A gas powered nuclear reactor that does not generate power on its own. Able to shut down in the event of coolant failure safely. Slowly breeds enriched scilaxa isotopes.

docs.title: Vapourization Generator
docs.text: Cools crystal plasma down, allowing it to form energy crystal formations. Flash boils water during the cooling process, which leaves a thick sludge of supercoolant.

docs.title: Dual Fusion Reactor
docs.text: A reactor with an extremely slow warmup. Fuses hydrogen in an outer reaction chamber to heat up an inner reaction chamber. Fuses oxygen for power.

docs.title: Arc Reactor
docs.text: A massive reactor that requires extensive cooling. Converts draconium and baenite into antimatter, producing shadow as a byproduct.

docs.title: OHR Burner
docs.text: Burns reactive organic liquids with heat input for power. Requires significant additional internal setup. May cause air pollution.

docs.title: Plasma Node
docs.text: Projects energized plasma in four directions. Causes considerable power efficiency loss.

docs.title: Plasma Beacon
docs.text: Projects energized plasma in four directions. More effective for long-range power systems.

docs.title: Plasma Booster
docs.text: A short-range energy broadcasting node. Causes severe power loss.

docs.title: Plasma Artery
docs.text: A bulky, expensive conduit able to transfer plasma without any loss.

docs.title: Capacitor
docs.text: Stores a small buffer of energy for times of need.

docs.title: Burner Array
docs.text: Burns flammable materials at a high rate to generate a mediocre amount of power.

docs.title: Cascadus Reactor
docs.text: Generates a massive amount of power by reacting fluid-energy with inseltiene. Explodes violently when destroyed.

docs.title: Draconium Reactor
docs.text: Compresses draconium powder to force a superheated thermal reaction. Will detonate without sufficient coolant.

docs.title: Exotic Power Source
docs.text: For Exotic Mod power needs in sandbox. Outputs more than a standard source.

docs.title: Geothermal Differentiator
docs.text: A highly upgraded thermal generator. Uses amethyst to generate a massive differential effect for power.

docs.title: Rudimentary Fuser
docs.text: Breaks down and melts gravel, extracting the components of territe and raw chunks of dantrales.

docs.title: Sand Crusher
docs.text: Atomizes and blasts sand with fluid-energy vapour to produce metaglass and purify silicon.

docs.title: Temporal Blaster
docs.text: Blasts ore deposits with huge, baenara-fueled temporal plasma shockwaves.

docs.title: Energized Bore
docs.text: Bores through any material. Able to extract ore from draconium boulders.

docs.title: Bedrock Bore
docs.text: Chews through rock at high speed to extract tougher deposits. Cannot mine tougher resources.

docs.title: Earthshaker
docs.text: Delves as deep as it needs to extract ores. Can excavate everything. May break balancing of other mods.

docs.title: Fracker
docs.text: Excavates deeper and tougher ores with powerful shaped explosions.

docs.title: Industrial Drill
docs.text: A large drill able to mine higher tier ores with less hardness falloff. Can optionally be boosted with cryofluid.

docs.title: Mantle Bore
docs.text: Chews deep to extract materials at an unnecessarily fast speed. Cannot mine tougher resources. Does not output the full drill speed below the same game framerate.

docs.title: Obliterator
docs.text: Uses even more concentrated explosives to delve for tougher materials.

docs.title: Soil Bore
docs.text: Chews away at surface level deposits at incredible speed. Cannot mine tougher resources.

docs.title: Twin
docs.text: A small, cheap turret used for early defenses.

docs.title: Tri
docs.text: A medium, cheap turret used for early defenses.

docs.title: Tetra
docs.text: A large, cheap turret used for early defenses.

docs.title: Light Minigun
docs.text: Fires a stream of ordnance at air enemies.

docs.title: Cannon
docs.text: Fires large-caliber, piercing shells at ground enemies over long range.

docs.title: Halberd
docs.text: Slashes enemies with three razor-shrap blades. Extremely short ranged.

docs.title: Flail
docs.text: Fires a blast of debris at nearby enemies.

docs.title: Ward
docs.text: Launches a barrage of defensive blocks at enemies. Blocks can absorb bullets and deal contact damage to units.

docs.title: Spearhead
docs.text: Shoots volleys of splintering bullets at enemies.

docs.title: Gauntlet
docs.text: Rapidly shoots shaped homing shells at enemies.

docs.title: Cutlass
docs.text: Launches a large explosive payload into the sky to drop on enemies. Drop position is based on enemy location when the payload is launched.

docs.title: nilevaJ
docs.text: ???sdrawkcab ...tub nonnac tohsitlum rehto yna ekil seriF

docs.title: Sledge
docs.text: Fires a single shot that periodically explodes.

docs.title: Broadsword
docs.text: Fires a cluster of teleporting swords at enemy units. Has no effect on blocks.

docs.title: Whip
docs.text: Concentrates a massive explosion into a cone of force.

docs.title: Glaive
docs.text: Fires massive crossbow bolts over long distances.

docs.title: Pike
docs.text: Fires a massive cannon shell over very long distances. Requires manual fire.

docs.title: Sawblade
docs.text: Fires a massive howitzer shell over extremely long distances. Requires manual fire.

docs.title: Lance
docs.text: Fires a barrage of explosive rounds over very long distances. Requires manual fire.

docs.title: Tomahawk
docs.text: Launches a swarm of cluster nukes over long distance to harrass enemy infrastructure. Requires manual fire.

docs.title: Dart
docs.text: Fires massive blasts of anden pellets over vast distances.

docs.title: Kusarigama
docs.text: Launches batches of orbital tugs to pull meteors from space.

docs.title: Blade
docs.text: Fires a triple-beamed laser salvo at enemies.

docs.title: Cluster
docs.text: Assists in defense by shooting down weak bullets.

docs.title: Fallout
docs.text: Fires a barrage of easily shot down missiles. Missiles cause a delayed explosion on destruction.

docs.title: Infini
docs.text:
An incredibly potent weapon prototype. Blueprints state a destructive force capable of leveling anything above it.

Cannot be deconstructed once placed.

docs.title: Potential
docs.text: Places temporary landmines. Has different effects based on ammunition.

docs.title: Retbleed
docs.text: Propels projectiles at high speeds with electromagnetic rails. Useful for taking down armored units.

docs.title: Stellar
docs.text: Fires a double volley of anti-air ordinance. Effectiveness is heavily dependant on ammo.

docs.title: Supercell
docs.text: Fires large shells rapidly at enemies. Ramps up quickly to full output. Takes as long to ramp down.

docs.title: Vertex
docs.text: Slashes enemies with three sharp blades. Inflicts a strong debuff.

docs.title: Atlas
docs.text: A small, quick payload transporter, perfectly suited for high-throughput uses.

docs.title: Atlas Router
docs.text: Splits the Atlas' throughput to multiple sides.

docs.title: Atlas Driver
docs.text: Launches small payloads over decent distances, with quick reload time.

docs.title: Atlas Constructor
docs.text: Produces liquid cells and silos for the Atlas transport system.

docs.title: Tank Synergizer
docs.text: Uses assembly drones and payloads to build assault tanks.

docs.title: Military Tank Assembler
docs.text: Uses assembly drones and tougher payloads to construct advanced assault tanks.

docs.title: Air Synergizer
docs.text: Uses assembly drones and payloads to build interceptor aircraft.

docs.title: Naval Synergizer
docs.text: Uses assembly drones and payloads to build specialized warships.

docs.title: Basic Synergizer Module
docs.text: Allows synergizers and facilities to accept units for upgrading.

docs.title: Combat Module
docs.text: Allows assemblers to produce the final tier of units.

docs.title: Compact Upgrade Module
docs.text: Allows assemblers to upgrade final tier units to their sister units.

docs.title: Large Payload Conveyor
docs.text: Used for moving massive payloads between unit factories and constructors.

docs.title: Industrial Constructor
docs.text: Produces blocks for unit factories. Can produce factory modules inefficiently.

docs.title: Industrial Demolisher
docs.text: Deconstructs any inputted payload. Returns full build cost.

docs.title: Alciala
docs.text: A combustable chunk of plant matter, harvested from alciala bushes with a saw.

docs.title: Altesin
docs.text: A chunk of waste from crystal plasma refining. Can be melted into slag for further refining, or shot from turrets as a delayed explosive.

docs.title: Amethyst
docs.text: A strong crystalline substance. Has an astonomically high heat capacity.

docs.title: Anden
docs.text: Used extensively by rebel as a structural reinforcement and a slightly explosive ammunition.

docs.title: Baenite
docs.text: A strange material with very powerful regenerative and temporal properties. Useful for support structures.

docs.title: Crystal
docs.text: A cubic chunk of building-grade energy crystal.

docs.title: Dantrales
docs.text: A common refining byproduct with many low intensity properties.

docs.title: Draconium
docs.text: A powerful material. Internal reactions make it almost glow red hot with heat. Extremely powerful if used correctly, though dangerous. Highly suggested for weaponization.

docs.title: Forge Plating
docs.text: A mysterious plating found universally in FTL cores. Aids heavily in research of advanced structures and units.

docs.title: Granite
docs.text: A rock used for building primitive structures.

docs.title: Infrastructure
docs.text: The base of larger blocks. Supports massive loads and stabilizes structures.

docs.title: Inseltiene
docs.text: A strange crystalline metal alloy that seems to weigh nothing, yet acts quite dense. Extremely magnetic.

docs.title: Ladera
docs.text: A crystalline lattice that gains strength and usability in water.

docs.title: Renfrien
docs.text: A durable, very conductive alloy of anden, silicon, and surge alloy. Used extensively in moving parts.

docs.title: Scilaxa
docs.text: A radioactive material originating from accelerated uranium decay.

docs.title: Shadow
docs.text: A strange unknown material, formed by combining other materials and their properties. Extremely powerful.

docs.title: Territe Alloy
docs.text: A slightly electrical alloy extensively used as a semiconductor in warden structures.

docs.title: Uranium
docs.text: A yellow chunky substance with high radioactivity. Sprays radioactive gas if shot from a turret.

docs.title: Wolframite
docs.text: Unusable scrap remains left by warden ships destroyed in war.

docs.title: Chlorine
docs.text: A toxic gas used commonly as acid.

docs.title: Crystal Plasma
docs.text: A very volatile fluid found in ruins, as a byproduct of some refineries, or from superheating wolframite scrap.

docs.title: Fluid Energy
docs.text: Glows with contained, immense energy. Extensively used in more energy costly structures.

docs.title: Hydrochloride
docs.text: A strangely organic seeming compound. May be alive.

docs.title: Kerosene
docs.text: An extremely dangerous fuel fluid used in high-octane infrastructure. May cause cataclysmic chain reactions.

docs.title: Baenara
docs.text: A concentrated mixture of baenite and water. Slowly regenerates units.

docs.title: Supercoolant
docs.text: A dense, oily sludge. Its lubricating properties and incredibly high heat capacity make it viable for use as coolant.

docs.title: Glistening Ocean
docs.text: A hidden, highly developed Crux base revealed by communications from their launch site. Capture it, and use it to reveal any more hidden strongholds.

docs.title: Infested Valley
docs.text:
A narrow, isolated valley in the northern mountains.

Two small enemy bases have built up here. Eradicate them with Minke units and take their new research. Expect attacks from two sides.

docs.title: Jagged Heights
docs.text: Jagged, sharp shale cliffs lie infested with enemy infrastructure to the north. The enemy appears to have engineered a new drill here, faster than your basic drills. Eradicate the bases quickly. Push the enemy back. Steal their pneumatic drills, and perhaps find a new alternative.

docs.title: Overgrown Basin
docs.text: Once a lush basin, now overtaken by spores. The enemy has set up a production base here. Claim it for your own. Use your new Flare units to whittle them down. Use Crawler units to open breaches for your daggers.

docs.title: Plagued Islands
docs.text: A small, infested lake lies nestled between frigid mountain ranges. Spore has devastated the land, spreading rapidly over the marshes. The enemy has built a major production factility here. Steal their Nova and silicon smelter blueprints. Use this new unit against them.

docs.title: Power Research Outpost
docs.text: The ruins of a long-abandoned research base lie in the untainted mountains to the south. Extensive flooding has destroyed most of the advanced technology here. The enemy is starting to notice our presence globally. Research the Arc turret and steam generator. Fend off the enemy's army.

docs.title: Industrial Blast Furnace
docs.text:
Takes several inputted resources and processes them into refined blocks of industrial infrastructure.

This structure is quite large.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Victory
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Victory. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Reckless
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Reckless. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Endeavour
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Endeavour. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Forefront
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Forefront. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Barricade
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Barricade. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Harmony
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Harmony. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Ultimatum
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Ultimatum. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Valiance
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Valiance. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Pioneer
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Pioneer. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Leviathan
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Leviathan. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Fearless
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Fearless. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: Spawn Package: Hellfire
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning Hellfire. Designed for situations such as reinforcements, waves, and beacons.

docs.title: HF:01 Victory
docs.text:
A small fighter that blasts energy from its broadsides.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Reckless
docs.text:
A small interceptor. Burns enemies with a plasma lance and harasses with missiles.

Damage Type: Energy, Thermal Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Endeavour
docs.text:
A warship that blasts targets with plasma mortars.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Forefront
docs.text:
A powerful but limited ship designed for melee combat. Can dump extra energy temporarily into thrusters.

Damage Type: Kinetic Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Barricade
docs.text:
Projects large side shield bulwarks for added defense. No offensive capabilities.

Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Harmony
docs.text:
A nimble, lightly armored warship with a large siege railgun. Vulnerable when firing.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Ultimatum
docs.text:
A generalist combat ship with a massive and several minor beams. Possesses more durable shields than her sister ships.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Valiance
docs.text:
A close-ranged heavy behemoth. Fires barrages of defense-piercing plasma bolts. Protects herself with rapidly regenerating shields.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Pioneer
docs.text:
An older warship, with generic armaments. Powerful generalist, with few notable abilities.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Exodus
docs.text: Rams targets to deal damage. Currently nonfunctional.

docs.title: Unstoppable
docs.text:
A massive siege capital ship. Launches huge salvos of guided rockets and defensive flak.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Leviathan
docs.text:
A high-tech, modernized capital ship. Capable of releasing massive pulses of energy. Recommended for the frontlines.

Damage Type: Energy, EMP Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Fearless
docs.text:
A powerful heavy ship built for siege. Fires a devastating beam, but overheats quickly and damages herself. Cannot be commanded by AI.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: HF:18 Hellfire
docs.text:
Fires devastating eldritch plasma beams and large-caliber railgun shells at enemies. Handle with care, she's a touch delicate.

Damage Type: Energy Weaknesses: Kinetic Immunities: Energy

docs.title: Meras Spawner
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning a Meras capital ship.

docs.title: Extelsus Spawner
docs.text: A visual effect bundle for spawning the Extelsus flagship.

docs.title: Kelta
docs.text: A remote controlled high explosive drone. Detonates on touch with any enemy.

docs.title: Meron
docs.text: Sprays speedy, piercing slugs over a decent range.

docs.title: Calsaten
docs.text: Fires standard shots and long-range, powerful grenades.

docs.title: Bantres
docs.text: Fires salvos of explosive shots and radioactive rounds. Can build in an emergency.

docs.title: Qsentrex
docs.text: A powerful destroyer, designed for siege. Rakes enemies with an explosive barrage and controllable missiles.

docs.title: Pentense
docs.text: A multi-use warfighter with a sniper cannon and a short-range defense shredder.

docs.title: Saiace
docs.text: A tough carpet bomber with the ability to perform bombing runs.

docs.title: Extelsus
docs.text: The flagship of the red, or rebel, side of warden. Boasts several piercing and mass denial weapons, making him a formidable structure devastator.

docs.title: Ponterx
docs.text: A harmless hauler, able to carry a large amount of items and payloads. Able to build and fly above other air units.

docs.title: Harass
docs.text: A nimble glider with an automatic cannon. Specialized in strafing defenses.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: Generates a massive electric field at higher velocities.

docs.title: Wildfire
docs.text:
Barrages enemies with splintering rockets, requiring an overheating power source.

Takes heavy self-damage over time. Much of this damage is emitted as Thermal Damage in a massive aura.

docs.title: Guard
docs.text: Fires a double shot volley of homing, explosive missiles.

docs.title: Meras
docs.text: Impales enemy ships with its three massive blades, dealing massive damage. Ineffective against anything on the ground.

docs.title: Conflict
docs.text: A tough tank armed with a piercing salvo capable of annihilating infrastructure.

docs.title: Strife
docs.text: A sister tank to Conflict, re-designed for sieging heavy defenses.

docs.title: Dispute
docs.text: A powerful tank capable of stripping infrastructure, even from heavily defended fortifications.

docs.title: Skirmish
docs.text: A sister tank to Dispute, reworked to fire tactical warheads.

docs.title: Hostility
docs.text: A brutal war machine. Launches barrages of artillery over walls to deal massive damage to infrastructure.

docs.title: War
docs.text: A sister tank to Hostility, modified to fire cluster artillery at heavy defenses.

docs.title: Bulwark
docs.text: A mobile defense emplacement, able to repair allies or other Bulwarks quickly. Boost to move.

docs.title: Palisade
docs.text: A mobile bastion, capable of repairing nearby allies and blocks. Boost to move.

docs.title: Instigate
docs.text: Charges and fires inaccurate blasts of energy. Can fly over walls.

docs.title: Oreodytes
docs.text: A small scooty ship with the ability to debuff a target enemy.

docs.title: Acilius
docs.text: Locks down singular enemies via encasing them in a warp bubble. Enemies are still able to shoot.

docs.title: Piscicola
docs.text:
Barrages nearby enemies with an arsenal of sapping weapons, healing for every damage it deals. Able to manually teleport short ranges by clicking to the rear.

Teleporting deals massive self-damage.

docs.title: Haemopis
docs.text:
A brutal artillery warship, capable of annihilating unprepared bases.

Haemopis projectiles do nothing to force shields of any kind.

docs.title: Occlusion
docs.text: Blasts enemies with focused laser beams. Irradiates enemies close to it. Capable of limited flight.

docs.title: Index
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/alnyled/astherive Stars 11 Last updated 2025-01-05T10:02:01Z

Tropical, oceanic planet. Inhabited by mutated creatures.

Currently in very early development.

[v1.52 build 4 - stable]

docs.title: Pneumatic Cracker
docs.text: Applies controlled pressure to rock to crack them open and extract the resource they hold.

docs.title: Filter
docs.text: Recovered technology. Recognize specific item through unknown process and pass them through.

docs.title: Item Gate
docs.text: Let item through. If blocked, output to the side.

docs.title: Core: Aeris
docs.text: The main base, when destroyed a sector is lost.

docs.title: Liquid Pipe
docs.text: Transports liquids forward. Does not accept input from the side.

docs.title: Liquid Junction
docs.text: Acts as bridge between two crossing pipes.

docs.title: Turbine
docs.text: Generate power by rotation using steam. Output pure water as a byproduct

docs.title: Rotary Drill
docs.text:
Mine resources from the ground.

Can generally work by itself but supplying it with coolant is highly recommended.

docs.title: Rift Excavator
docs.text: Extracts resources from rift. Require steam to operate.

docs.title: Evict
docs.text: A pressure-driven turret that launch quartz shrapnel at enemy.

docs.title: Decline
docs.text: A pressure-driven turret that launch quartz into the air. Require a lot of steam due to the force required to high altitude.

docs.title: Stream
docs.text: Releases steam at high pressure continously to knockback the enemy and slow them down. Require power for pump.

docs.title: Silver
docs.text: Used as heat conductor and power conductor.

docs.title: Rock
docs.text: Can be cracked to extract the resource inside.

docs.title: Moss Water
docs.text: A swampy water dominated by moss and algae.

docs.title: Biocyte
docs.text: An acidic, biochemical liquid. Can spread endlessly and damage nearby building. Spread quickly through water.

docs.title: Steam
docs.text: I can't think of description. Evaporated water, that's it.

docs.title: Elaris
docs.text: Habitable planet. Go invade it, its fun.

docs.title: Overgrown Forest
docs.text:
A densely packed forest which make ground logistic difficult.

The thriver seem to have adapted and they are now flying in the air.

docs.title: Primal
docs.text: Commence the conquest of Elaris. Gather resources, defend, and research new technology.

docs.title: Iter
docs.text: Fires low damage laser beam at the enemy.

docs.title: Rex

Property Value Repository https://github.com/catana791/asthosus Stars 244 Last updated 2026-06-27T11:27:19Z

A mod that adds a new planet, Asthosus, into the game.

Asthosus is a deserted planet. A wasteland filled with danger.

It has a fully playable campaign with 11 campaign and 21 optional maps.

Aside from these 32 maps, Asthosus contains over 180 pieces of unique content,

including blocks, liquids, items, units and status effects.

This number is not counting any internal units or environment blocks/tiles.

I aimed to re-use nearly no vanilla content and instead fill the mod

with new and (hopefully) exciting things.

The mod comes with it's own custom music, made by ThePythonGuy3!

If you find any issues or want to tell me anything else,

feel free to join the Asthosus Discord server.

The same thing goes for when you need help with this mod.

Asthosus is available in the following languages:

  • English

  • German

  • Indonesian

  • Russian

  • Ukrainian

  • Traditional Chinese

  • Simplified Chinese

Enjoy!

docs.title: Lodestone Mixer
docs.text: Mixes and magnetizes Ferrinite and Hardened Sand into Lodestone while also outputting sand.

docs.title: Lodestone Basin
docs.text: Creates Lodestone more efficiently by melting down the Ferrinite used before mixing it with Hardened Sand. Requires Oasis Water for cooling.

docs.title: Lithium Grinder
docs.text: Grinds Demetite and Lignite into powder and uses it to create Lithium.

docs.title: Lithium Compactor
docs.text: Grinds and compacts Demetite and Lignite into Lithium. More efficient than a regular Lithium Grinder.

docs.title: Cretite Mixer
docs.text: Melts down Lithium, powderizes Lignite and mixes the two with red sand to create highly flammable Cretite.

docs.title: Barite Quern
docs.text: Crushes Irradiated Lumps into usable and buildable Barite. Requires power.

docs.title: Barite Cooler
docs.text: Cools down Liquid Barite using Oasis Water to create Barite.

docs.title: Crosium Infuser
docs.text: Infuses Obsidian with Purified Oasis Water before compressing it to create Crosium. Requires power and pressure.

docs.title: Vesmonium Accultor
docs.text: Creates Vesmonium using Barite and Lignite. Requires power and pressure. Works better on Barite tiles.

docs.title: Draysten Crucible
docs.text: Creates Draysten using Vesmonium and Nontragen. Requires heat and power.

docs.title: Nontragen Synthesizer
docs.text: Grinds down Obsidian into Obsidian Powder and pressurizes it with Oasis Water using Pressure to create Nontragen.

docs.title: Pressure Rig
docs.text: Harnesses the pressure of geothermal vents and makes it available for use.

docs.title: Large Expansion Tank
docs.text: Uses heat to create pressure. Creates pressure faster and more efficiently than a regular Expansion Tank.

docs.title: Lignite Burner
docs.text: Burns flammable Lignite to produce heat and output created heat to all sides equally.

docs.title: Cretite Etna
docs.text: Burns highly flammable Cretite to produce heat. Is more efficient than a Lignite Burner. Outputs created heat to all sides equally.

docs.title: Solar Heater Panel
docs.text: Produces small amounts of heat and power passively.

docs.title: Red Sand Filter
docs.text: Filters Red Sand using Oasis Water to create Sand as well as Ferrinite, Demetite and Lignite in small amounts. Also outputs Purified Oasis Water. Requires Pressure.

docs.title: Sand Compactor
docs.text: Condenses regular Sand back into Hardened Sand to be reused. Requires pressure.

docs.title: Pyre
docs.text: Uses power to burn items inputted into it and destroy them.

docs.title: Luminary Vat
docs.text: Infuses Mycillite with Arcana Spores using ambient pressure to create Lumifibre.

docs.title: Large Ferrinite Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from Ferrinite. Protects allied structures from damage.

docs.title: Lodestone Wall
docs.text: A wall made from Lodestone. Blocks lightning and interrupts power connections.

docs.title: Large Lodestone Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from Lodestone. Blocks lightning and interrupts power connections.

docs.title: Lithium Wall
docs.text: A wall made from charged lithium. Sometimes releases electrical arcs that damage nearby enemies.

docs.title: Large Lithium Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from charged lithium. Sometimes releases electrical arcs that damage nearby enemies.

docs.title: Obsidian Wall
docs.text: A wall made from obsidian. Protects allied structures from damage. Bursts into damaging shards upon destruction.

docs.title: Large Obsidian Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from obsidian. Protects allied structures from damage. Bursts into damaging shards upon destruction.

docs.title: Barite Wall
docs.text: A wall made from Barite. Protects allied structures from damage. Radiates nearby enemies.

docs.title: Large Barite Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from Barite. Protects allied structures from damage. Radiates nearby enemies.

docs.title: Crosium Wall
docs.text: A wall made from crosium. Defends allied structures from damage. Capable of absorbing lasers and conducting power.

docs.title: Large Crosium Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from crosium. Defends allied structures from damage. Capable of absorbing lasers and conducting power.

docs.title: Projector Wall
docs.text: A wall made from Vesmonium that is capable of emitting a one-time use directional shield. Explodes on destruction, briefly stunning enemies hit. Fortified against weaker attacks.

docs.title: Large Projector Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from Vesmonium that is capable of emitting a one-time use directional shield. Explodes on destruction, briefly stunning enemies hit. Fortified against weaker attacks.

docs.title: Draysten Wall
docs.text: A sturdy wall made from Draysten that slows down enemies in its vicinity. Requires and conducts power.

docs.title: Large Draysten Wall
docs.text: A sturdy wall made from Draysten that slows down enemies in its vicinity. Requires and conducts power. Slows enemies for longer and has more range than a normal Draysten Wall.

docs.title: Crosium Belt
docs.text: Packages stacks of items before sending them off. Outputs items in three directions at the end.

docs.title: Pipeline Router
docs.text: Made from Ferrinite. Distributes input items from ducts to three directions equally.

docs.title: Pipeline Distributor
docs.text: A larger Pipeline Router. Distributes input items from ducts to seven directions equally.

docs.title: Ferrinite Pipeline Bridge
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for crossing pipelines or terrain.

docs.title: Pipeline Sorter
docs.text: If an input item matches the selection, it passes forward. If not, it is outputted to the sides.

docs.title: Inverted Pipeline Sorter
docs.text: Works like a Duct Sorter but outputs selected items to the sides instead of straight on.

docs.title: Overflow Controller
docs.text: Outputs items to the sides if the front path is blocked.

docs.title: Underflow Controller
docs.text: Works like an Overflow Controller but inverted.

docs.title: Heavy Unloader
docs.text: A directional Unloader that cannot unload cores.

docs.title: Kinetic Propulsor
docs.text: Fires batches of items over medium distances to another Kinetic Propulsor in range. Requires power.

docs.title: Cargo Base Station
docs.text: Loads a cargo drone with items to be sent off towards a Cargo Drop Point.

docs.title: Cargo Drop Point
docs.text: Accepts items dropped by an Alveus cargo drone.

docs.title: Heat Distributor
docs.text: Transfers heat to other Heat Distributors or heat consumers.

docs.title: Voidlock Generator
docs.text: Emits an impassable and invulnerable shield to protect critical infrastructure. Healing does not stack.

docs.title: Strataduct
docs.text: Transports items through porous mudstone conduits using controlled osmotic pressure differentials.

docs.title: Strataduct Router
docs.text: Distributes input items from strataducts to three directions equally.

docs.title: Strataduct Bridge
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for crossing strataducts or terrain.

docs.title: Aged Demetite Wall
docs.text: Contains traces of unsuable Demetite which can be mined using specialized means. Has been exposed to the weather for a long time, making the Demetite inside unusable.

docs.title: Aged Ferrinite Wall
docs.text: Contains traces of unusable Ferrinite. Has been exposed to the weather for a long time, making the Ferrinite inside unusable.

docs.title: Ample Monolith
docs.text: An ancient construct, left by a civilization long gone. Summons Arcana Moths to defend itself and attack.

docs.title: Arcane Monolith
docs.text: An ancient construct, left by a civilization long gone. Summons Arcana Raynoids to defend itself and attack.

docs.title: Barite
docs.text: A floor that contains radioactive barite. Needs high-tier drills to be mined.

docs.title: Barite Hive
docs.text: A hive that seems to be creating spider-like creatures. Best not to get close to them.

docs.title: Hive Interceptor
docs.text: Charges up to deliver a concentrated blast of liquid barite, dealing damage and radiating hit targets. Deals extra damage to buildings.

docs.title: Hive Slinger
docs.text: Grows organic barite hive boulders in its body to launch them at enemies, dealing high splash damage in a large area.

docs.title: Hive Tempest
docs.text: Charges up to deliver a flurry of liquid barite globs, melting targets.

docs.title: Demetite Wall
docs.text: Contains traces of Demetite which can be mined using specialized means.

docs.title: Obsidian Wall
docs.text: A wall made from lava that cooled too quickly.

docs.title: Ferrinite Wall
docs.text: Contains traces of Ferrinite which can be mined using specialized means.

docs.title: Hardened Sand Wall
docs.text: Sand compressed into a firm, nigh-impenetrable barrier. Can not be harvested.

docs.title: Large Hive Barricade
docs.text: An alien wall that protects hive infrastructure.

docs.title: Hive Barricade
docs.text: An alien wall that protects hive infrastructure.

docs.title: Huge Barite Hive
docs.text: A hive that seems to be creating spider-like creatures. Best not to get close to them.

docs.title: Large Barite Hive
docs.text: A hive that seems to be creating spider-like creatures. Best not to get close to them.

docs.title: Mudstone Rift
docs.text: A torn up piece of earth containing mineable Mudstone.

docs.title: Primal Monolith
docs.text: An ancient construct, left by a civilization long gone. Summons Arcana Blobs to defend itself and attack.

docs.title: Red Sand
docs.text: A floor consisting of red sand. Mineable for Red Sand.

docs.title: Core: Essence
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored and stores a medium amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Substratum
docs.text: Core of the base. Well armored and able to store large amounts of items.

docs.title: Core: Omphalos
docs.text: Core of the base. Excellently armored and stores massive amounts of items.

docs.title: Core: Petra
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored and stores a medium amount of resources. Allows for more active units than an Essence core.

docs.title: Core: Silex
docs.text: Core of the base. Well armored and able to store large amounts of items. Allows for more active units than a Substratum core.

docs.title: Core: Summit
docs.text: Core of the base. Incredibly well armored and able to store vasts amounts of items. Allows for more active units than an Omphalos core.

docs.title: Explosive Trap
docs.text: Explodes when enemies step on it, dealing decently high damage.

docs.title: Barrier Projector
docs.text: When supplied with power, creates a square shield to protect allied structures and units from damage. May optionally be boosted using Vesmonium.

docs.title: Restoration Projector
docs.text: Slowly repairs nearby allied blocks. Requires power. May be optionally boosted with Lithium. Healing does not stack.

docs.title: Restoration Dome
docs.text: Slowly repairs nearby allied blocks. Requires power. Has more range than a normal Restoration Projector and regenerates health faster. May optionally be boosted with Vesmonium. Does not stack.

docs.title: Core: Hyphos
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored and stores a medium amount of items.

docs.title: Viaduct
docs.text: An Aqueduct with higher health and speed, made out of Obsidian.

docs.title: Aqueduct Router
docs.text: Distributes inputted liquids to three outputs equally.

docs.title: Aqueduct Bridge
docs.text: Used for crossing multiple distribution lines or terrain to connect Aqueducts.

docs.title: Exothermic Pump
docs.text: Pumps liquids from liquid tiles. Requires Lignite to operate.

docs.title: Oasis Water Sieve
docs.text: Purifies Oasis Water to create Purified Oasis Water.

docs.title: Oasis Water Griddle
docs.text: Purifies Oasis Water using Red Sand to create Purified Oasis Water. Is more efficient than a regular Oasis Water Sieve.

docs.title: Liquid Vat
docs.text: Stores liquids and outputs them to all sides.

docs.title: Liquid Silo
docs.text: Stores vasts amounts of liquids and outputs them to all sides.

docs.title: Logic Chip
docs.text: Runs logic instructions. Is able to control units and buildings.

docs.title: Message Chip
docs.text: Stores a message for communication between allies.

docs.title: Ferrinite Wire
docs.text: Transfers power when placed next to more wires. Can store very small amounts of power.

docs.title: Reinforced Wire
docs.text: Transfers power when placed next to more wires. Stores more power and has substantially more health than a regular wire.

docs.title: Rectifier
docs.text: Moves battery power in a single direction only if the other side has less power stored.

docs.title: Network Terminal
docs.text: Connects to wires, displaying current and stored power inside the system.

docs.title: Connector Node
docs.text: Connects wires over small distances without needing to direclty connect. A wire bridge.

docs.title: Power Cell
docs.text: A simple power cell made for holding and storing power.

docs.title: Voltage Capacitor
docs.text: A capacitor capable of storing larger amounts of power than a regular Power Cell.

docs.title: Ignition Generator
docs.text: Burns flammable materials to create small amounts of power.

docs.title: Pressure Turbine
docs.text: Uses pressure to create larger amounts of power.

docs.title: Cretite Turbine
docs.text: Creates medium amounts of power by using highly flammable Cretite and Purified Oasis Water as coolant.

docs.title: Discharge Generator
docs.text: Produces power by discharging charged materials. Slowly builds up pressure and explodes when pressure reaches the maximum threshold.

docs.title: Radiation Reactor
docs.text: Placed on Barite vents to create power using the radioactive emissions created by the vent.

docs.text: Generates power by diffusing a mixture of Nontragen and Silicon Tetrafluoride using heat. Explodes violently if insufficient coolant is provided.

docs.title: Demetite Mining Unit

docs.title: Demetite Crusher

docs.title: Large Friction Quarry

docs.title: Abrasion Quarry
docs.text: Uses large-scale friction explosions to mine materials from the ground in high amounts. Enhanced through Obsidian. Can mine advanced materials. Requires power.

docs.title: Discharge Quarry
docs.text: Uses massive friction explosions to mine materials from the ground in high amounts. Fortified using Barite. Can mine advanced materials. Requires power.

docs.title: Geothermal Accumulator

docs.title: Decompression Extractor
docs.text: Uses base components of Silicon Tetrafluoride gas as well as Hardened Sand to create small amounts of Ferrinite and Demetite. Also outputs regular Sand as well as Red Sand as byproducts.

docs.title: Slag Cooling Mold

docs.title: Catapult
docs.text: Fires bursts of small artillery shells at enemies over medium distances.

docs.title: Spray

docs.title: Singe

docs.title: Skip

docs.title: Billow
docs.text: Rapidly fires drops of liquid at enemies. Capable of extinguishing fires.

docs.text: Creates a constant, low-damaging beam that knocks back ground units.

docs.title: Shaft
docs.text: A small laser turret that fires a very powerful, continuous laser at enemies. Requires power and coolant to operate, only firing in each cardinal direction. Damage output depends on the coolant used.

docs.title: Cavalier
docs.text: Charges up to deliver three consecutive laser beams that deal high damage and pierce enemies.

docs.title: Accendret
docs.text: Fires homing, piercing, and incendiary rounds at enemies.

docs.title: Fulmination
docs.text: Fires high-velocity, piercing needles at enemies that have various effects depending on the ammunition used.

docs.title: Syntaxe
docs.text: Heats up and melts materials to then fire at enemies, creating caustic puddles upon impact.

docs.title: Instauro
docs.text: Fires repeating bolts at enemies, covering a lot of area.

docs.title: Myriad
docs.text: Fires homing and fragging missiles at enemies. Applies the shock status to hit enemies.

docs.title: Typhoon
docs.text: Rapidly blasts bullets at enemies. Specialized at dealing with single enemies, head-on. Less efficient against swarms.

docs.title: Concite
docs.text: Fires alternating, powerful rounds at enemies, piercing them. Specialized at annihilating swarms. Less efficient against single targets.

docs.title: Tralux

docs.title: Verite
docs.text: Long-range, high-precision turret. Fires piercing rounds at enemies. Requires pressure.

docs.title: Comedite
docs.text: Uses Vesmonium or Draysten as ammo to fire fast-paced volleys of missiles at enemies.

docs.title: Preject

docs.title: Fracture

docs.title: Large Missile Autoforge

Crafts very basic components used for unit assembly. Requires power. Conducts power to blocks it touches.

Crafts high-tier components used for unit assembly. Requires power, pressure, and nontragen. Conducts power to blocks it touches.

docs.title: Vesmonium
docs.text: A slightly charged and flammable material. Used in advanced building, defenses and crafting.

docs.title: Draysten
docs.text: A slightly charged and flammable alloy used in lategame building and unit creation. Made by infusing Vesmonium with Nontragen using heat.

docs.title: Mudstone
docs.text: A simple muddy rock, mined from Coarse Dirt. Used in basic crafting.

docs.text: Parasitic spores, mined from specific spore walls in a Trecarian Arcana biome.

docs.text: An organic webbing made from Arcana Spores and Mycillite. Used in basic construction.

docs.title: Silicon Tetrafluoride

docs.title: Arcanoma
docs.text: A seemingly organic liquid found in Arcana creatures. It seems to react to high temperatures and consume heat.

docs.title: Fungal Water

docs.title: Resource Entry - Ferrinite
docs.text:
Location: The Barrens, a biome on Asthosus where conditions are relatively stable compared to the rest of the planet. This area is defined by vast stretches of quicksand floors, lignite deposits, geothermal vents and the remains of dead plant life. While it's not free from hazards, the Barrens offer a much safer environment for initial operation.

Composition: Ferrinite is a rock-like material, formed from the natural fusion of sand and mineral deposits. The intense heat that is present on Asthosus hardened the material into a dense, stone-like substance, making it a useful resource for early construction.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Demetite
docs.text:
Location: The Barrens, a biome on Asthosus where geothermal vents and mineral-rich deposits create ideal conditions for Demetite's formation. Often found alongside Ferrinite, this metallic resource is extracted from the same resource-rich regions.

Composition: Demetite is a metallic material formed through the natural fusion of minerals under pressure. Its soft, metallic composition makes it suitable for basic building, though it is not durable enough to be used by itself in advanced construction.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lignite
docs.text:
Location: Found in the Barrens and the Desert regions of Asthosus. Lignite appears close to walls where flora once thrived, particularly where ancient organic depots have been buried and compressed.

Composition: Lignite is a low-grade, coal-like material created through the partial decomposition of long-dead plant matter. Its porous, brittle structure allows for easy ignition, making it valuable for heating and basic combustion.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Hardened Sand
docs.text:
Location: Found primarily in the desert biomes on Asthosus. Hardened Sand forms where loose sediment is exposed to sustained heat, causing natural compression over time.

Composition: Hardened Sand is the result of intense thermal exposure to standard sand deposits and sediment in general. The process fuses grains into a denser, more compact material. Though it lacks the structural strength of stone or metal, it serves as a useful intermediary in the refinement of simple construction resources.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Red Sand
docs.text:
Location: Found exclusively in the Mesa biome of Asthosus. Red Sand is easily identified by its vibrant hue and granular texture, often blanketing the steep, stratified slopes and valley of the region.

Composition: Red Sand is composed of oxizdized mineral particles and weathered sediment, bearing subtle traces of various elemental materials. Its coloration stems from high ferric or iron content, oxidized over countless cycles of exposure to heat and wind.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lodestone
docs.text:
Location: Manufactured within specialized mixing facilities using base components from the Barrens and the Dessert. Though naturally occuring magnetic rock exists on Asthosus, it is unreachable through common means, requiring artificial production instead.

Composition: A compact, magnetically reactive compound, Lodestone results from the physical blending of dense mineral and sediment-based materials. While lacking the same level of magnetization that can be found in naturally occuring Lodestone, the mixture forms a stable structure with conductive properties useful in automated systems and transport.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Lithium
docs.text:
Location: Manufactured through industrial refinement rather than mined. Lithium is produced in grinders - facilities that extract and refine reactive elements from Lignite and Demetite under abrasion.

Composition: A soft, pale material with high charge potential and chemical sensitivity. The process of converting raw combustible and metallic matter into usable Lithium is efficient but must be closely monitored due to the flammable ingredients involved.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Cretite
docs.text:
Location: Produced in Cretite Mixers, specialized industrial facilities that combine Lignite, Lithium, and Red Sand. The result is a volatile composite material, primarily used in controlled explosions or as a powerful energy source when carefully managed.

Composition: Cretite is a chemically reactive and highly unstable mixture of Lignite, Lithium, and Red Sand. The interaction of these elements under controlled constants results in a compound that is flammable and slightly explosive, with immense potential energy when harnessed properly.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Crystalline Geode
docs.text:
Location: Found on the surface around the walls of the Igneous Biome, where the terrain is harsh and molten slag pools are abundant. These geodes can be spotted near the edges of this biome, making them both dangerous but also rewarding to gather and access.

Composition: Obsidian crystals, encased in thick Ferrinite layers, form these geodes. The intense heat from surrounding molten slag speeds up the natural formation of these protective layers, making these geodes more difficult to extract.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Obsidian
docs.text:
Location: Found in the Igneous Biome and areas with abundant molten slag. Obsidian is not directly mined; instead, it is extracted through specialized methods such as geode cracking or slag cooling.

Composition: Obsidian is a naturally occuring volcanic glass formed under extreme heat. Due to its hardness and durability, it is sought after for advanced building and specialized equipment.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Irradiated Lump
docs.text:
Location: Typically found in the Radiant Expanse, a vast and treacherous biome where natural radiation saturates the environment. The irradiated materials in this area are abundant yet extremely dangerous to interact with.

Composition: A radioactive mineral, the Irradiated Lump holds no practical value in its raw form. Its high radioactivity makes it hazardous to handle without proper protective measures, and it cannot be directly used in construction or production. Its structure is porous and brittle.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Barite
docs.text:
Location: Found primarily in the Radiant Expanse, this mineral is a refined product of Irradiated Lump, processed in specialized facilities designed to handle its dangerous properties.

Composition: Barite is a highly radioactive mineral with various applications in high-tier building, power production, and crafting. It is a dense and durable resource that plays a crucial role in constructing more advanced technologies and structures. The mineral is known for its significant radioactivity, which is both a danger and an asset, depending on its use.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Crosium
docs.text:
Location: Crosium is created in a specialized facility called the Crosium Infuser, where Obsidian, Pressure, and Purified Oasis Water are combined under controlled conditions. This unique process allows the material to take on properties that are highly valued in advanced building and unit creation.

Composition: Crosium is a versatile material with a remarkable ability to shift between being electrically insulative and conductive depending on the handling process. Its molecular structure gives it an unusual adaptability, making it essential for high-tech applications, from intricate building systems to the creation of specialized units and machinery.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Vesmonium
docs.text:
Location: Vesmonium is produced in the Vesmonium Accultor, a specialized facility where Lignite, Barite, Pressure, and Liquid Barite are combined under controlled conditions. This unique mixture results in a material with slightly charged, flammable, and radioactive properties, commonly used in advanced building, defensive structures, and crafting.

Composition: Vesmonium is a highly reactive material formed through a complex process involving the blending of volatile substances. Its slight charge, flammability, and moderate radioactivity make it a critical resource for high-tech applications but also a dangerous one to manage.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Draysten
docs.text:
Location: Draysten is crafted in the Draysten Crucible, a high-tech facility where Vesmonium, Nontragen, and Heat are combined to create this advanced alloy. Due to the complex nature of its production process, Draysten is an extremely expensive material, especially given the resource-heavy requirements of Vesmonium in its creation.

Composition: Draysten is a slightly charged and highly flammable alloy formed by infusing Vesmonium with Nontragen using extreme heat. The resulting material is a potent combination of charge, explosiveness, and moderate radioactivity, making it ideal for lategame applications in building and unit creation.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Pressure
docs.text:
Location: Pressure is one of the most vital and commonly used resources across Asthosus, powering an array of machines, generators, and other devices essential to life and operations. Found in natural reserves deep underground or extracted through specialized equipment, it serves as the lifeblood for countless operations.

Composition: Pressure itself is a gaseous material under extreme conditions, harnessed and utilized for its ability to generate energy when released in controlled settings. It is a fundamental component of many Asthosian machines, turbines, and energy systems, often stored in high-pressure containers or used in real-time processes to power technology. Despite its potential for catastrophic explosions under improper management, it remains an indispensable part of Asthosian industry.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Silicon Tetrafluoride
docs.text:
Location: Silicon Tetrafluoride is a highly volatile gas that, while dangerous, is a necessary component in a variety of advanced Asthosian systems, especially in the cooling mechanisms for weaponry and resource refinement processes. Found primarily in research and industrial facilities, its role is critical to maintaining the efficiency and safety of certain high-energy systems. The gas itself is harnessed by Geothermal Accumulators from Asthosian vents.

Composition: Silicon Tetrafluoride is a gaseous compound, highly reactive with water and moisture, and capable of inducing severe damage if mishandled. Despite its toxicity, it serves a vital role in the cooling processes for turrets and certain resource refinement techniques, where its properties allow it to absorb and dissipate heat efficiently. Its danger lies not only in its reactive nature but also in its explosive potential when subjected to high temperatures or improper containment.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Oasis Water
docs.text:
Location: Oasis Water is a rare and vital liquid sourced from oases found within the desert biomes of Asthosus. These oases, which are few and far between, serve as the only significant reservoirs of liquid in the otherwise dry and hostile landscape.

Composition: Oasis Water is distinguished by its unusually high concentration of minerals, which gives it unique properties compared to typical water. The elevated mineral content increases its boiling point, preventing it from evaporating instantly in the extreme temperatures of Asthosus. This makes it crucial for use as a coolant, particularly in environments where regular water would evaporate too quickly to be useful. Its mineral concentration also makes it a highly effective thermal conductor, able to absorb and dissipate heat much more efficiently than standard liquids.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Purified Oasis Water
docs.text:
Location: Purified Oasis Water is derived from the mineral-rich Oasis Water found in desert biomes on Asthosus. After being extracted, the water undergoes a filtration process to remove any contaminants, ensuring that only the highest quality liquid remains.

Composition: Purified Oasis Water is the result of Oasis Water that has been carefully filtered using a specialized sieve. This filtration process removes impurities, leaving the water in a pristine state ideal for technical applications. While still maintaining its high mineral concentration, Purified Oasis Water is now free from the natural contaminants present in raw Oasis Water. Its improved composition enhances its use as a superior coolant and makes it more effective in delicate machinery or advanced systems that require a higher level of purity.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Liquid Barite
docs.text:
Location: Liquid Barite is a highly unstable, radioactive form of Barite, only found in the most extreme conditions. This fluid form is capable of spreading quickly and causing damage to anything it comes into contact with. Its caustic nature and the radiation it emits make it one of the most dangerous liquids on Asthosus. However, when cooled and processed through a Barite Cooler, Liquid Barite can be hardened back into solid Barite, a useful material for advanced building and crafting.

Composition: Liquid Barite retains many of the properties of its solid counterpart, but in a more unstable, liquid state. Its high radioactivity makes it extremely dangerous to handle, and it emits a faint but persistent radiation field. Anything that comes into contact with Liquid Barite becomes exposed to this radiation and is damaged as a result. Its high viscosity and explosiveness make it a potential hazard in large quantities.

docs.title: Resource Entry - Nontragen
docs.text:
Location: Nontragen is a sophisticated and highly specialized gas, produced through a unique process that involves pressurizing Oasis Water and Powderized Obsidian. This gas plays a crucial role in advanced cooling systems and high-tech production processes on Asthosus. Its unique properties make it invaluable for high-efficiency applications, particularly in environments where extreme temperatures are a challenge. Nontragen is recognized for its thermal stability, which allows it to serve as a powerful coolant in systems requiring constant, regulated temperatures.

Composition: Nontragen is a gas with a distinct thermal signature, making it a critical component in managing the heat generated by advanced machinery and facilities on the planet. The synthesis process, which involves the combination of Oasis Water and Powderized Obsidian under intense pressure, results in a gas with impressive heat capacity and a stable cooling effect. It can withstand high temperatures and regulate cooling in systems that would otherwise be vulnerable to overheating. The unique mixture of ingredients gives Nontragen a subtle but noticeable color and texture, a distinguishing factor for working with it.

docs.title: Asthosus
docs.text: A deserted planet, filled with dangers but also possibilities. Good luck!

docs.title: Trecara - Work in Progress!
docs.text: Asthosus moon, a lush stellar body that contains an abundance of water and fauna. Ores are exceedingly rare here so use what you have to conquer this planet.

docs.title: Genesis
docs.text: You land on Asthosus and find yourself in a small ravine devoid of life and resources. Can you really conquer this planet?

docs.title: Ignition
docs.text:
Small deposits of Lignite have formed via geothermal activity.

Start to venture into electric power.

docs.title: Lattice
docs.text: Scattered boulders of resources dot the area. Prevent the enemy from harnessing them. Expand quickly. Utilize Lodestone to defend against stronger foes.

docs.title: Fulge
docs.text:
You land on a small sector. This is the perfect opportunity to research and use Lithium.

Set up Lithium production. Bring down the enemy on this sector.

A powerful geomagnetic storm is wrecking havoc here. It appears to affect both you and the enemy.

Modifiers: - Enemies deal 10% increased damage. - Enemies have 25% more health. - Your buildings have 15% less health.

docs.title: Immist
docs.text:
The enemy has entrenched inside a deserted area.

Upon landing, they will mount an assault. Defend the core from enemy fire.

Research unit production technologies. Remove the enemy foothold.

docs.title: Igneous Peaks
docs.text:
This sector contains high-temperature biomes. These contain a new resource for you to use, Obsidian.

Produce Obsidian and use it to bring down this sectors guardian.

docs.title: Detriment Valley
docs.text:
A sector that has survived many bombings. The enemy has gathered a formidable force here.

Venture into producing Barite.

Create stronger defenses. Push back the enemy in this sector.

Modifiers: - Enemies have 15% more health. - Enemies deal 15% more damage. - Enemies move 10% faster.

docs.title: Defringe
docs.text:
An old production complex lies here, idle for thousands of years. Kickstart its self-repair capabilities. Utilize Vesmonium for defense.

Do not be fooled by the large wave spacing. This is a key site of enemy interest.

Utilize old, dead constructs left after each failed attempt to secure a foothold. Defeat the powerful guardian that is protecting this sector.

Modifiers: - Enemies are equipped with a speed bost. -Solar Heater Panels are unavailable. -Deconstructing Derelict structures yields less resources.

docs.title: Synthesis Facility
docs.text:
The enemy is approaching from two sides at the same time.

Venture into the creation of Crosium. Defend and capture this challenging sector.

docs.title: Furnace Settlement
docs.text:
The enemy has created an extremely powerful base here.

Furthermore, the enemy is deploying forces from two drop zones at the same time. Some of their most powerful guardians have been ordered to put a stop to your campaign.

Venture into the creation of Draysten. Bring down the enemy waves and destroy their massive base.

docs.title: Omega
docs.text:
The last and final frontier.

The enemy has gathered all remaining forces and will attack relentlessly.

Be prepared to fight back from multiple frontlines at the same time.

The enemy has secured their drop zones with a massive base.

Bring this base down. It might be a good idea to first secure your own zones and production before launching your attack.

docs.title: Maar
docs.text:
You find yourself on a small sector with lots of Oasis Water.

This sector lends itself perfectly for Lodestone production.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Chasm
docs.text:
This sector may prove useful for additional Lithium production.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Inferate
docs.text:
You stumble across a large base.

After you have captured Immist, you wonder how many more bases you have to face.

The enemy has built defenses in layers. Bring them down one by one.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Clamor
docs.text:
It appears this sector is rich in resources.

Arumis tier 5 guardians have been sighted.

Take them down. Claim this sector for yourself.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Embage
docs.text:
You find yourself on a very tight and claustrophobic sector filled with danger.

The enemy is relentless. Push them back in the limited space provided.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Factory Unit 0047
docs.text:
One of the many massive factory units left that were created by the Arumis.

This production complex lies abandoned, most of it's defensive capabilities having withered away.

The enemy is unattentative.

Modifiers: - You can use turrets to attack the enemy base.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Magmatic Riverbed
docs.text:
A vast slag riverbed is housing in this area. Enormous volcanic activities resulted in harsh terrain, proving most units being useless to attack.

The enemies set up a large, heavily protected outpost here.

Modifiers: - Only Hover units are usable. - Enemy structure have 50% more health. - Enemies deal 50% more damage. - Your structures have 20% more health. - You build 50% faster. - Your unit production is 50% faster. - You can only deposit into the core. - Deconstructed structures refund no materials.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Barite Valley
docs.text:
You find yourself on an unexplored sector. This sector seems to be home to strange, mutated creatures. They appear to be somehow organic.

Survive the waves of mutant creatures. Secure a foothold.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Lucila
docs.text:
Just when you researched everything you need to create Barite, your Barite Quern techonolgy gets stolen by the enemy.

Utilize Barite Coolers to create Barite instead. Create higher-tier units to take down the multiple bases here.

Modifiers: - Barite Querns are unavailable. - Utilize Barite Coolers to create Barite.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Bioweapon Facility
docs.text:
A large research facility that was taken over by barite creatures. It once contained dangerous biological weapons.

Now the hives control the entire base.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Oasis Delta
docs.text:
Separated by a massive river of oasis water, an untouched region lies separated from a huge enemy base.

Utilize Vesmonium to create high-tier units. Bring this base down.

The enemy will fight back with full power. Be prepared.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Preciptum
docs.text:
Once a massive area used for weapon tests.

A major part of this sectors terrain has been turned into a gaping void by a devastating explosion.

The enemy has created a base on the remnants of this land.

Take it down.

Modifiers: - Enemy units deal 50% more damage. - Enemy buildings have 50% more health. - Your unit production is 50% slower. - Fog of War is present here.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Abandoned Research Center
docs.text:
The enemy has created a mighty base with multiple cores here. Higher tier units will be required to take it down.

Act Fast. Expand quickly. Take down the enemy base before the enemy forces take you down.

Modifiers: - Enemy units deal 15% more damage. - Enemy structures have 25% more health. - Enemy structures deal 25% more damage.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Thanatos
docs.text:
An outlying sector that contains abundant resources considering its size.

The enemy appears to have little presence here. Or do they...

Fight heaps of enemies and guardians. Take this sector for yourself.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Caldoria
docs.text:
Scans indicate that this sector contains no Crystalline Geodes.

The enemy force cannot be calculated.

Take this sector for yourself.

Modifiers: - There are no Crystalline Geodes present. - Use Slag Cooling Molds to create Obsidian. - Low-Tier Tech is unusable here.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Molten Heights
docs.text:
Due to massive amounts of volcanic activity, the area is flooded with slag. The higher regions of the terrain remain untouched.

The enemy values this sector greatly. Prepare for merciless waves.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Mune
docs.text:
Units equipped with superbuffed shield generators have been sent to stop you.

Retaliate with your most powerful weapons.

Modifiers: - Enemies deal 25% increased damage from all sources. - Enemies possess a multitude of their health as shields.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Inferno Bastion
docs.text:
This area is rich in resources due to high volcanic activity, due to which the sector was flooded with heaps of slag.

Enemies have settled here long ago but were taken over by the barite creatures.

Take back the base from these creatures while avoiding the molten mass and building your infrastructure around it.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: A d_ngero__ inte_ligenc_ se_ms to be ral_ying an i_credib_e amo_nt of bar_te cr__tures her_, it is reco_mend__ to
docs.text:
Transmission lost, data unavailable.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Finistera
docs.text:
You land on a claustrophobic, cramped sector.

The enemy has found great value in this sector.

They are attacking from 4 directions. Some drop zones will activate after a while, others will be active the entire time.

A large population of Barite Creatures is also present here. Take down their hives.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Acropolis
docs.text:
You stumble upon a strangely shaped sector.

The enemy appears to have created the most powerful base you have ever seen here.

Take it down. High-tier units will be required.

It appears that the base is built in stages. Perhaps you should defeat the stages starting with the weakest one.

Consider securing the limited space you have before attacking.

Expand as much as you can.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Rejuvenated

docs.title: Radiated

docs.title: Infested

docs.title: Energy Phasing

docs.title: Control Corruption
docs.text: The movement controllers of this unit have been affected. Reload and speed decreased.

docs.text: Protects the Hyphos core. Equipped with a single missile launcher. Capable of building and mining.

docs.title: Arcana Moth
docs.text: Created by an Ample Monolith, this alien creature drops arcane moss clusters on your defenses.

docs.title: Shiv

docs.title: Elucidate

docs.title: Expound
docs.text: Capable of building and automatically repairing damaged structures. Equipped with a double barrel healing launcher, a piercing heal laser array and two missile launchers.

docs.title: Clitelle

Property Value Repository https://github.com/deercarbonate/azimuth Stars 46 Last updated 2026-06-27T04:29:13Z

Hybrid mod primarily built around a gradually branching campaign that expands in multiple directions.

The mod adds a new planet, Gelion, featuring its own campaign, star system, research tree, and gameplay mechanics.

The planet offers over 90 blocks to research, 12 units each with their own unique abilities, 12 campaign sectors, more than 6 new mechanics, and plenty of room for map creation.

On top of that, the campaign also stands out with absolutely BRUTAL visual effects. Every texture was made with care and dedication.

THIS MOD IS STILL IN DEVELOPMENT!

The current completion percentage is approximately 57%, with plenty of room to grow!

Help me develop the mod! Join the Azimuth Discord server using the link in the README file on the mod's official GitHub page.

///////////////////////////////

Land on a sub-cryonic terra slowly heating up beneath its unstable star. The celestial body is suffering from global warming — glaciers are melting, atmospheric pressure is rising, and temperatures continue to climb.

Exterminate the enemy faction. Turn the planet into a temporary source of raw materials. Witness a world that will soon become ash.

If you enjoyed the mod, please consider giving it a star!

Thank you for playing.

docs.title: Octinium arc foundry

docs.title: Parsion heater
