docs.title: Morphite Belt
docs.text: Packages stacks of items before sending them off, faster when powered.

docs.title: Morphite Splitter
docs.text: Distributes the stacks equally over every output. Faster when powered.

docs.title: Junction Pipe
docs.text: Allows for two pipelines to cross each other.

docs.title: Splitter Pipe
docs.text: Distributes input items to 3 output directions equally.

docs.title: Sorter Pipe
docs.text: Can be used as a directional router and sorter.

docs.title: Overflow Gate Pipe
docs.text: Only outputs items to the sides if the front path is blocked.

docs.title: Underflow Gate Pipe
docs.text: Only outputs items to the front if the sides path is blocked.

docs.title: Morph Bridge
docs.text: Transport items very fast over blocks and buildings, requires power.

docs.title: Surge Driver
docs.text: Transports items in batches to another surge driver in range.

docs.title: Cargo Bay
docs.text: Loads a cargo drone with items to be sent off towards a cargo depot.

docs.title: Cargo Depot
docs.text: Accepts items dropped off by an iris cargo drone.

docs.title: Unloader Pipeline
docs.text: A directional unloader, cannot unload contents directly from cores.

docs.title: Aqua Wall
docs.text: Most of the blocks are filled with water.

docs.title: Bethine Wall
docs.text: Sometimes including a small amount of Chromium

docs.title: Obsidian Wall
docs.text: The heat fuse all the blocks here.

docs.title: Tantriscape
docs.text: Formed million years ago, Tantriscape contains a small energy from its crystal

docs.title: Core: Apex
docs.text: Core of the base. Lightly armored and stores decent amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Empower
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored and stores medium amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Apeirogon
docs.text: Core of the base. Heavily armored and stores large amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Crest
docs.text: Core of the base. Lightly armored and stores decent amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Boundless
docs.text: Core of the base. Armored and stores medium amount of items.

docs.title: Core: Ultimatum
docs.text: Core of the base. Heavily armored and stores large amount of items.

docs.title: Enforcer
docs.text: Creates shockwaves that damages enemy projectiles. Requires necroplasm and power.

docs.title: Auto-Repairer
docs.text: Automatically repairs blocks in range, requires cryogenics and power.

docs.title: Holoshield
docs.text: Creates a square shield that blocks enemy projectiles, requires cryogenics and power.

docs.title: Signal Navigator
docs.text: Uncovers fog in a large area, requires power.

docs.title: Survey Buoy
docs.text: Uncovers fog in a medium range, can be placed on water.

docs.title: Discharge Landmine
docs.text: Discharges when enemies step on it. Dealing massive damage.

docs.title: Build Tower
docs.text: Automatically rebuilds structures in range and assists other units in construction.
Additional fog border in aqua biome, editor only.

docs.title: Core: Astral
docs.text: Core of the base, lightly armored. Astral exclusive blocks.

docs.title: Necroplasm Navigator
docs.text: Illuminates nearby area within range using necroplasm light source.

docs.title: Artificial Mycellium
docs.text: Constantly repairs all units in its range, requires power.

docs.title: Ultimate Accelerator
docs.text: Accelerates cores and launch it across the space.

docs.title: Aqua Conduit
docs.text: Transfers liquids and fluids forward, much stronger than sea conduit.

docs.title: Hoverducts
docs.text: Transfers liquids and fluids using non-gravity ducts, much faster than regular conduits.

docs.title: Seaduct Junction
docs.text: Used to cross two separate liquid pipes.

docs.title: Seaduct Router
docs.text: Distributes and intakes liquids from all sides equally.

docs.title: Reinforced Sea Bridge
docs.text: Transfers liquids over blocks and buildings, has more range than a sea bridge.

docs.title: Sea Morph Bridge
docs.text: Transfers liquids over blocks and buildings at a high speed.

docs.title: Jet Pump
docs.text: Pumps and outputs liquids. Requires cryogenics to function.

docs.title: Hydrolic Pump
docs.text: Pumps and outputs liquids in large amount. Requires power to function.

docs.title: Miasma Filtration Unit
docs.text: Filtralize miasma into elixir using tantrium. Beware! Leaking conduits can be the cause for a miasma infection!

docs.title: Nullifier
docs.text: Mixes ichor with ectoplasm to synthesize miasma.

docs.title: Chute Crosspipe
docs.text: Used to cross two separate liquid pipes.

docs.title: Chute Router
docs.text: Distributes and intakes liquids from all sides equally.

docs.title: Drawer
docs.text: Displays a simple image with a pre-defined palette. Editable.

docs.title: Large Drawer
docs.text: Displays a large size of single image with a pre-defined pallete. Images can be imported and exported. Editable.

docs.title: Multi Drawer
docs.text: Displays a massive size of single image with a pre-defined pallete. Images can be imported and exported. Editable.

docs.title: Terminator
docs.text: Runs logic instructions. Able to control units and buildings.

docs.title: Hyper Terminator
docs.text: Runs logic instructions. Able to control units and buildings. Faster than the terminal chip.

docs.title: Data Cell Chip
docs.text: Stores numbers for a terminal chip to read at a later point in time.

docs.title: Large Data Cell Chip
docs.text: Stores large numbers for a terminal chip to read at a later point in time.

docs.title: Powerbeam
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally, has more range than normal powerline.

docs.title: Large Powerline
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks over a long distance, only capable of forming a single connection.

docs.title: Morphite Node
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks over a medium distance, can connect to multiple blocks.

docs.title: Testing Node
docs.text: Connect non-powered blocks, useful while checking enemy bases in editor playtesting.

docs.title: Small Powerbank
docs.text: A battery capable of storing large amounts of power.

docs.title: Powerbank
docs.text: A battery capable of storing massive amounts of power.

docs.title: Power Redirector
docs.text: Moves battery power in a single direction only if the other side has less power stored.

docs.title: Burner Generator
docs.text: Burns flammable materials using elixir to generate power.

docs.title: Burner Reactor
docs.text: Burns flammable materials to generate power, requires cryogenics and chromium to function.

docs.title: Geothermal Generator
docs.text: Uses miasma and cryogenics to heat the ground and generate power.

docs.title: Tokamak Reactor
docs.text: Generates large amount of power via morphitix plasma and ichor. Explodes violently if has no sufficient fluids.

docs.title: Necroplasia Reactor
docs.text: Uses necroplasm's radioactivity to generate power and ectoplasm as a byproduct. Explode violently if ectoplasm reaches above the threshold.

docs.title: Necrogenerator
docs.text: Generates power using necroplasm. Astral exclusive blocks.

docs.title: Power Nylon
docs.text: Transmits power to other blocks orthogonally. Astral exclusive blocks.

docs.title: Elixir Collector
docs.text: Extracts elixir from vents, requires power to operate.

docs.title: Elixir Extractor
docs.text: A better elixir extractor, requires power to operate.

docs.title: Ore Extractor
docs.text: Extracts ore in its direction, requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Ore Blaster
docs.text: A better ore extractor, requires cryogenics to function.

docs.title: Tantrium Extractinator
docs.text: Extracts tantrium from tantrium walls, faster than a tantrium crusher.

docs.title: Aquamarine Crusher
docs.text: Crushes down aqua walls to extract aquamarine.

docs.title: Aquamarine Extractor
docs.text: Slowly extracts aquamarine from aqua tiles, requires hydryite to operate.

docs.title: Bore Jet
docs.text: Uses a high-pressure jet of elixir to mine ground ores.

docs.title: Ichor Rig
docs.text: Slowly extracts ichor from ichor tiles, requires large amounts elixir to operate.

docs.title: Nucridscrap Shredder
docs.text: Extracts nucridscrap from nucrid walls. Faster than a regular nucridscrap crusher. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Discharge Bore
docs.text: Making use of the unique properties of gravitix, ichor is dissected by enormous localized gravitational fields. The resulting reaction is carefully contained and directed towards the ground where it turns much of what was there to less than dust.

docs.title: Earthmover
docs.text: Slams down to generate a shockwave that slows down enemies and decrease their reload speed.

docs.title: Spewer
docs.text: Rapidly fires drops of liquid at enemies. Capable of extinguishing fires.

docs.title: Vulcan
docs.text: Shoots a laser that pushes enemies away.

docs.title: Torrefy
docs.text: Fires explosive cluster grenades that scatter into puddles of slag and inflict melting effect. Deals more damage with a direct hit.

docs.title: Influx
docs.text: Charges up and discharges electrical arcs in a cone.

docs.title: Deprive
docs.text: Fires barrages of bullets at enemy targets over long distances, dealing massive AoE damage.

docs.title: Continuum
docs.text: Fires a slow-moving single-target laser at enemy targets.

docs.title: Voyage
docs.text: Fires a missile over vast distance, cannot damage air units.

docs.title: Phantasm
docs.text: Rapidly blasts bullets at enemies. Specialized at dealing with single enemies, head-on. Less efficient against swarms.

docs.title: Vertex
docs.text: Launches high-energy projectiles at enemies, pierces through armored enemies.

docs.title: Havoc
docs.text: Fires barrages of grenades at enemies. Spawns baron when destroyed.

docs.title: Heavy Armored Treads
docs.text: Heavy armored treads used in tank unit production.

docs.title: Hyperspace Thruster
docs.text: High-tech thruster used in ship unit production.

docs.title: Geopowered Mechlegs
docs.text: Geothermal powered mechanical legs used in mech unit production.

docs.title: Multi Batteries
docs.text: Multi batteries used in walker unit production.

docs.title: Tankbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of tanks.

docs.title: Shipbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of airships.

docs.title: Mechbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of mechs.

docs.title: Walkerbay
docs.text: Used to produce the first tier of walkers.

docs.title: Tankbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted tanks to the second tier.

docs.title: Shipbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted airships to the second tier.

docs.title: Mechbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted mechs to the second tier.

docs.title: Walkerbay Upgrade Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades inputted walkers to the second tier.

docs.title: Basic Expansion Module
docs.text: Increases an assembler tier by 1 when placed next to its bounding box. Can be used as an additional payload input.

docs.title: Advanced Expansion Module
docs.text: Increases an assembler tier by 2 when placed next to its bounding box. Can be used as an additional payload input. Requires previous expansion module to be placed.

docs.title: Regenerator
docs.text: Constantly repairs all units in its range. Requires power and elixir.

docs.title: Prime Regenerator
docs.text: Constantly repairs all units in its range at faster rate. Requires ichor and power to operate.

docs.title: Large Splitter
docs.text: Distributes inputted payload to up to three output directions.

docs.title: Surge Launcher
docs.text: Launches payloads to another connected surge launcher in range.

docs.title: Large Surge Launcher
docs.text: Launches payloads to another connected large surge launcher in range.

docs.title: Block Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts walls for unit assembly, requires power.

docs.title: Large Block Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts factory blocks. Requires elixir and power.

docs.title: Advanced Fabricator
docs.text: Crafts unit part for unit assembly, requires power and necroplasm.

docs.title: Material Disassembler
docs.text: Disassembles blocks and units, returns 100% of the build cost. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Large Material Disassembler
docs.text: Disassembles large blocks and units, returns 100% of the build cost. Requires elixir and power to operate.

docs.title: Cobalt
docs.text: Used in basic construction and as ammunition.

docs.title: Anthracite
docs.text: Used in generators for burning and heating.

docs.title: Lamine
docs.text: High-explosive material, used in heat-related blocks and explosive ammo.

docs.title: Tantrium
docs.text: Mostly used to purifying elixir, has some other uses.

docs.title: Aluminium
docs.text: Mainly used in units and electronic parts.

docs.title: Nichrome
docs.text: Fused nickel and chromium, known as nichrome. Can be separated using elemental separators.

docs.title: Chromium
docs.text: Tough and strong material used in many buildings and ammunition.

docs.title: Clevorite
docs.text: Super conductive material that is used in many advanced buildings.

docs.title: Nucridscrap
docs.text: Strong material originating from nucrid walls, can be strengthend more with petal fragments.

docs.title: Petal Fragment
docs.text: Extracted flower petal, can be processed with nucridscrap to produce bloodstone.

docs.title: Bloodstone
docs.text: High durability material used in advanced unit assembly and gravity manipulation.

docs.title: Morphite
docs.text: Crystallic, high energy material from highly accelerated low-tier material. Used in electric-based component blocks and weaponry.

docs.title: Gravitix
docs.text: Strong material used in gravity manipulation based technology and advanced component parts.

docs.title: Technoscrap
docs.text: Bunch of metal scraps, needs filtering before it is usable.

docs.title: Techno Plating
docs.text: Stores decent amount of information and data, used in logic-related blocks.

docs.title: Gryphic
docs.text: Refined cobalt, more durable thanks to the added necroplasm.

docs.title: Crystallic Geode
docs.text: Crystalline morphite, it is unknown how they form.

docs.title: Morphitix Crystal
docs.text: Another morphite form, uses accelerated crystal instead of normal material.

docs.title: Elixir
docs.text: Contaminated water mixed with biomass, can be filtered for coolant or used in factories.

docs.title: Cryogenics
docs.text: Filtered elixir, able to operate advanced factories. Can be used as turret coolant.

docs.title: Ichor
docs.text: Truly purified fluids, self-healing technology and stable regeneration.

docs.title: Necroplasm
docs.text: Biological mutated liquids, grows slowly until it gained its intelligence mutation.

docs.title: Miasma
docs.text: Uncontrollable mass of sulfuric acid, can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Hydryite
docs.text: Used in cleaning aquamarine, an elixir counterpart.

docs.title: Morphitix Plasma
docs.text: Plasma created by heating and discharging morphite.

docs.title: Ectoplasm
docs.text: A deadly liquid created from miasma, highly explosive. Can spread into elixir.

docs.title: Nucliogen
docs.text: Slimy substance, byproduct from surrounding petal flower.

docs.title: Newgrounds
docs.text:
The Mothership sent you to this sector as your first mission.

Analyze available resources and build infrastructure to protect yourself.

docs.title: Mountain Ridge
docs.text:
The only path available from sector Newgrounds.

This sector is rich in tantrium and anthracite. Research the Elixir Purifier and the Burner Generator to weather the enemies.

docs.title: Encampment
docs.text:
This sector is scarce in cobalt and anthracite deposits in the walls. Bore Jets are required to mine ores from the ground.

The enemy has built a small outpost here with lots of defence. Mech and Walker units will be required to increase your offensive ability.

docs.title: Cliffside
docs.text:
This sector contains deposits of chromium. Use Bore Jet to mine it from the ground.

The enemy will send one of their elites to protect this sector.

docs.title: Crest
docs.text:
This sector is very rough and cramped. Mech units are the only choice to take down the enemy base here.

Push them back in the limited space provided. Claim this sector for yourself.

docs.title: Botanical Garden
docs.text:
This sector contains large deposits of chromium on the opposite side of the island. Perfect to test out new transport tech.

Research Surge Driver and Shipbay Upgrade Chamber to capture the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Escarpment
docs.text:
An important transportation route between outposts used by Rhodes. To make up for the lack of tantrium in the area, research the Tantraformer to create tantrium as the replacement.

Rhodes does not take kindly to you being here and will do their utmost to stop you.

docs.title: Cornerstone
docs.text:
You land on a sector filled with mountainous terrain. The enemy base is hidden deep within. Tier two units may prove necessary to take down their fortifications.

Research the Tankbay Upgrade Chamber and the Walker Upgrade Chamber.

docs.title: Hazardous Wasteland
docs.text:
Rich in miasma but starved of anthracite, this sector is very treacherous. Build Geothermal Generator to generate power.

The enemy has built a strong base with advanced tech in this sector. Capture this sector and acquire the technology.

docs.title: Precipice
docs.text:
A jagged, fractured canyon formerly used as Mech Testing Grounds by Rhodes. The unsupported terrain makes it very hard to build and operate a base.

Utilize Surge Launcher for transporting resources across the winding terrain. Be prepared for attacks from multiple directions.

docs.title: Creek
docs.text:
A ravine carved by flowing hydryite and rich aquamarine deposits. Research the Aquamarine Filter and the Elemental Separator as an alternative ways to produce basic materials.

Our radar detected several Rhodes activity in this sector. Do not give them time to send their strongest units.

docs.title: Marshlands
docs.text:
This sector is very large and rich in resources, but will be attacked by the enemy once a new core lands.

Utilizes morphite for further colonization. Rhodes will send a large punitive force in order to stop your conquest.

docs.title: Pier
docs.text:
This sector was used by Gowa Industries long ago, it has been claimed by Rhodes over the course of countless wars. The pier and its facility became abandoned and decayed.

Astral naval units have been sighted on the radar, no further data available. It might be stronger than normal units.

Unidentified aircraft detected.

Utilize morphitix plasma to create even stronger defences. Use your best strategy against them.

docs.title: Bioproject Core
docs.text:
An abandoned research facility, toxic and unhabitable. Vent is scarce and separated across several islands, analyze the remaining tech to survive.

Utilize Miasma Filtration Unit as an alternative solution. Additionally, research Cargo Bay as a main drone-based transportation.

Landing area is unstable, disallowed additional starting blocks.

docs.title: Eridanus
docs.text:
A zigzag pattern, forces enemy units to take a very long path take out your base in this sector. Dont be fooled by its large wave spacing, Rhodes will send their units faster the more you progress.

Produce gravitix. Fend off the enemy.

WIP

docs.title: Luminary
docs.text:
Due to lack of vents, you will need a better source of power. It might be a good idea to have air defence around the edges.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Foggy Fields
docs.text:
Due to a great number of vents present, the sector has occasional foggy episodes. The enemy has built a giant base here. It is recommended to bring large amounts firepower.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Abandoned Reservoir
docs.text:
You land in a cramped sector filled with miasma. The sensor detects an enemy base in this sector.

Unfortunately, you must build your production and defence between a lake and distorted environment. Use ship units to dismantle the enemy base before the enemy dismantles you.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Trekker Campsite
docs.text:
This is the campsite of the mountain trekker, controlled by Rhodes. Use various units to eliminate all enemy cores.

Intel suggests the enemy has nuclear weapons of some form, stay alert for a potential strike!

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Ridgeline
docs.text:
Rhodes have built a heavily guarded stronghold here. It remains undefeated for years. Your goal is to find any exploit and all weaknesses in order to make it fall.

Modifiers: - Terraformic Basin, Terrafilter & Nichrome Dissembler are unavailable.

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Clover Springs
docs.text:
Hotspring occupied by the Rhodes Facility. The lakes generates at the central area, creating almost perfect four clover leafes with several twists.

You will land on a pre-built base from another agent. Advance to the crater and eliminate all enemy cores.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Myrra Heights
docs.text:
The highest mountain range in frostnova. A home to the Rhodes mightiest operation known. The enemy have been constructing an experimental gravitix warhead.

BEWARE OF POTENTIAL STRIKE.

We will attempt to sent units to aid your endevors of conquest, by contacting Signal Transmission Station. The enemy values this sector with all of their might. So expect large amounts of resistance and strife in a myriad of ways.

WIP

Note: This is an optional sector. Capturing it is not required for completing the campaign.

docs.title: Breached
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets breached, its health gets slowly drained.

docs.title: Immunity
docs.text: Increases unit health and movement speed, but decreases the damage output.

docs.title: Discharge Overload
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets discharge overload, its health drains very fast.

docs.title: Contaminated
docs.text: Whenever a unit gets contaminated, its health gets slowly drained and gains increased attack speed.

docs.title: Ground Shock
docs.text: Shocks enemies and drains unit health slowly.

docs.title: Rogue
docs.text: Protects the Apex Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal allied structures.

docs.title: Pioneer
docs.text: Protects the Empower Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks.

docs.title: Trailblaze
docs.text: Protects the Apeirogon Core, can build and retrieve resources. Can heal blocks very fast.

docs.title: Suzuran
docs.text: Used for insta-healing blocks and scouting, sandbox only.

docs.title: Huntress
docs.text: Fifth generation of helicopter tech. Equipped with mounted missile and machinegun.

docs.title: Strike
docs.text: Fires pairs of plasma bolts at enemy targets.

docs.title: Skyblade
docs.text: Charges and fires high damage piercing plasma orb over long distances. Has dual laser canons attached on the sides and a shield in the front.

docs.title: Archangel
docs.text: Fires a long-range piercing round. Equipped with dual suppression missiles launcher.

docs.title: Beth
docs.text: Protects the Astral core, can mine and build. Astral exclusive units.

docs.title: Coronis
docs.text: Protects the Crest Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Sepia
docs.text: Protects the Boundless Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Can attack enemy units.

docs.title: Locust
docs.text: Protects the Ultimatum Core, can build and retrieve resources faster. Equipped with additional mount weapon.

docs.title: Honsha
docs.text: Third generation of tank tech. Equipped with mounted missile and piercing gun.

docs.title: Craig
docs.text: Launches artillery shells at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Fortis
docs.text: Fires cluster shells that creating caustic lava puddles upon impact at enemy ground targets.

docs.title: Rancor
docs.text: Fires powerful cluster shells and piercing bullet at enemy targets.

docs.title: Baron
docs.text: Torches enemy targets with a short range laser. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Tribune
docs.text: Fires missiles from a twin missile launcher. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Archon
docs.text: Fires barrages of missiles at enemy targets. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Emperor
docs.text: Fires a piercing bolt at enemy targets. Will dash every second shot. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Monarch
docs.text: Fires piercing shrapnel at multiple enemies in range. Has mounted seeking missiles suited for medium range and lower. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: Fires electric arcs at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Sora
docs.text: Fires short electric beams at enemies, able to float over bodies of liquid.

docs.title: Byte
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Syntax
docs.text: Fires electric orbs that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Decode
docs.text: Fires piercing laser that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Protects itself with a directional shield.

docs.title: Matrix
docs.text: Fires pulsing bullets that inflict a stunned effect at enemies. Creates strong energy shields to nearby units. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Program
docs.text: Fires impaling bullets that explodes upon contact. Equipped with point-defense turret. Capable to self regenerate. Damages nearby units when destroyed.

docs.title: Bulbhead
docs.text: Fires exploding bullet at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Hammerhead
docs.text: Fires missile at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Narhwal
docs.text: Fires electric bullets at enemies. Astral exclusive unit.

docs.title: Freesia
docs.text: Fires multiple exploding bullet at enemies, can also heal allied units. Astral exclusive unit.

A huge, fun & balanced content extension.

Please note that the Serpulo research tree has

been moved into it's own tree because it was

too large.

To get to the Fading Revelations Serpulo

research tree, please switch to it the same way

you would switch between the Erekir and Serpulo

research trees.

On that menu, a new button will be available

that takes you to the Fading Revelations

Serpulo research tree.

Features

Two new planets and many blocks,

units, items, liquids, schematics

& ammo types.

Languages

  • English

  • German

  • Spanish (WIP)

  • Ukrainian (WIP)

  • Russian

Check Discord / GitHub

for more information!

docs.title: Coal Condenser
docs.text: Condenses oil into coal in a highly efficient process.

docs.title: Advanced Cryofluid-Mixer
docs.text: Mixes large quantities of water with fine titanium powder to produce cryofluid.

docs.title: Advanced Separator
docs.text: Separates slag and scrap into their raw material components. High output.

docs.title: Igneous Alloy Smelter
docs.text: Smelts igneous alloy from surge alloy and titanium using slag. This smelter is a part of the Cryogenic Alloy assembly line.

docs.title: Amalgam Forge
docs.text: Using slag as a heat source, smelts copper, living steel, and surge alloy into larger quantities of steel amalgam than the smelter.

docs.title: Amalgam Smelter
docs.text: Using slag as a heat source, smelts copper, living steel, and surge alloy into steel amalgam.

docs.title: Level 1 Ammocrafter
docs.text: Crafts copper ammo out of copper and coal.

docs.title: Level 2 Ammocrafter
docs.text: Crafts titanium ammo out of titanium and coal.

docs.title: Level 3 Ammocrafter
docs.text: Crafts explosive ammo out of blast compound and coal.

docs.title: Atmospheric Extractor
docs.text: Extracts and concentrates Nitrogen out of the atmosphere. Works more efficiently than an Atmospheric Concentrator.

docs.title: Advanced Heating Element
docs.text: An improved version of the Electric Heater. Creates more heat.

docs.title: Basic Multismelter
docs.text: Uses a combination of smelting and compression procedures to mass produce basic resources.

docs.title: Fabric Forge
docs.text: A better phase fabric forge that is more cost-efficient.

docs.title: Plastanium Forge
docs.text: A better plastanium forge that is more cost-efficient.

docs.title: Carbide Basin
docs.text: A better Carbide Crucible that works more efficiently.

docs.title: Corrosion Chamber
docs.text: A better Oxidation Chamber that creates Oxide more efficiently and outputs more heat.

docs.title: Cryogenic Alloy Fusing Basin
docs.text: Amalgamates Igneous Alloy and Cryogenic Gel by shock-cooling it using Neutron Fluid. This basin is a part of the Cryogenic Alloy assembly line.

docs.title: Cryogenic Gel Mixer
docs.text: Used to create Cryogenic Gel needed to craft Cryogenic Alloy. Part of the Cryogenic Alloy Assembly line structure.

docs.title: Cyanogen Fuser
docs.text: Joins Arkycite and Graphite to make larger amounts of Cyanogen than a normal Cyanogen Synthesizer.

docs.title: Blast Forge
docs.text: A better blast mixer. Gets very hot so it uses graphite for isolation.

docs.title: Pyratite Forge
docs.text: A stronger pyratite mixer. Gets very hot so needs graphite for isolation.

docs.title: Esterification Chamber
docs.text: A better Electrolyzer that works more efficiently.

docs.title: Graphite Forge
docs.text: A better graphite press that makes Graphite way faster and more efficiently.

docs.title: Heal-Ammo Crafter
docs.text: Crafts healing ammunition using spore pods and coal. Used in turrets, this ammo can heal allied blocks.

docs.title: Heat Diverter
docs.text: A small block that is used to redirect heat to other blocks.

docs.title: Homing-Ammo Crafter
docs.text: Crafts homing ammo out of thorium and coal.

docs.title: Induced Kiln
docs.text: A better kiln that is a lot more efficient.

docs.title: Inverted Pulverizer
docs.text: Pulverizes sand to scrap. Don't ask how but you will be wondering how useful that is!

docs.title: Living Steel Forge
docs.text: Fuses titanium with spore pods, creating living steel in large quantities. More efficient than the infuser.

docs.title: Living Steel Hardening Forge
docs.text: Reinforces living steel via thorium infusion. More efficient than the hardening chamber.

docs.title: Living Steel Infusion Chamber
docs.text: Infuses titanium with spore pods, creating living steel.

docs.title: Living Steel Liquefaction Chamber
docs.text: Melts down living steel into a versatile fluid utilizing oil.

docs.title: Living Steel Liquefaction Forge
docs.text: Melts down living steel into a versatile fluid utilizing oil. More efficient than the liquefaction chamber.

docs.title: Nanobot Ammo Crafter
docs.text: Crafts nanobot ammo out of living steel and coal.

docs.title: Neutron Blender
docs.text: Blends large quantities of cryofluid, oil and liquefied living steel into the highly potent neutron fluid coolant.

docs.title: Nuke Crafter
docs.text: Crafts nuclear warheads using fuel rods and graphite.

docs.title: Phase Manufacturer
docs.text: A better phase synthesizer that works more efficiently

docs.title: Powderizer
docs.text: A better and bigger version of the pulverizer.

docs.title: Silicon Arc Forge
docs.text: A better version of the silicon arc furnace that creates silicon more efficiently.

docs.title: Silicon Forge
docs.text: A better silicon smelter that is more cost-efficient.

docs.title: Small Heat Router
docs.text: A smaller Heat Router that takes up less space!

docs.title: Steam Condenser
docs.text: Pulls water vapor from the atmosphere, condensing it into steam.

docs.title: Surge Melter
docs.text: A better version of the surge crucible that creates surge alloy more efficiently.

docs.title: Alloy Forge
docs.text: A better surge alloy forge that is more cost-efficient.

docs.title: Fuel Rod Crafter
docs.text: Layers a plastanium and lead core with thorium, creating fuel rods.

docs.title: Armored Door
docs.text: A door that opens automatically for allied units. Cannot be manually opened or closed.

docs.title: Armored Wall
docs.text: A better Shielded Wall that has more health and a stronger shield. Uses Carbide.

docs.title: Gigantic Carbide Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made out of Carbide. Is armored.

docs.title: Huge Carbide Wall
docs.text: A huge wall made out of Carbide. Is armored.

docs.title: Huge Copperwall
docs.text: A copper wall. Bigger than the big one.

docs.title: Living Steel Wall Large
docs.text: A large wall made of Living Steel. Heals itself slowly.

docs.title: Living Steel Wall
docs.text: A wall made from living steel that heals itself slowly.

docs.title: Huge Phase-Fabric Wall
docs.text: A huge wall made out of phase-fabric.

docs.title: Gigantic Phase-Fabric-Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made of phase-fabric. A lot of it.

docs.title: Gigantic Reinforced Surge Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made out of Surge Alloy and Tungsten. Is armored.

docs.title: Huge Reinforced Surge Wall
docs.text: A huge wall made out of Surge Alloy and Tungsten. Is armored.

docs.title: Large Amalgam Wall
docs.text: A large wall made from Steel Amalgam. Zaps enemies around it when they get close.

docs.title: Amalgam Wall
docs.text: A small wall made from Steel Amalgam. Zaps enemies around it when they get close.

docs.title: Huge Surge-Alloy-Wall
docs.text: A huge wall made of surge alloy. Can shoot lightning sometimes.

docs.title: Gigantic Surge-Alloy-Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made of surge alloy.

docs.title: Gigantic Thorium-Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made out of thorium.

docs.title: Gigantic Titanium-Wall
docs.text: A gigantic wall made out of titanium.

docs.title: Amalgam Conveyor
docs.text: Quickly transports items forward in larger batches, akin to the plastanium conveyor. Identical functionality.

docs.title: Charred Tree
docs.text: A tree that has endured high heat and lots of fire. The wood is charred.

docs.title: Gnarled Tree
docs.text: A gnarly tree that has lost all of it's leafs but the wood is still standing.

docs.title: Mass Accelerator
docs.text: Long-range item transport structure. Collects large batches of items and shoots them to other mass accelerators.

docs.title: Gate: Ammo
docs.text: The gate to all of the ammo included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Blocks
docs.text: The gate to all of the blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Core Units
docs.text: Contains the tech tree for all of the core units included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Cores
docs.text: The gate to all of the cores included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Production
docs.text: The gate to all of the production blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Distribution
docs.text: The gate to all of the conveyors and similar blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Drills
docs.text: The gate to all of the drills included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Effect Blocks
docs.text: The gate to all of the effect blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Factories
docs.text: The gate to all of the unit factories included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Flying Units
docs.text: Contains the tech tree for all flying units included in the Fading Revelations mod.

docs.title: Gate: Items
docs.text: The gate to all of the items included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Ground Units
docs.text: Contains the tech tree for all ground units included in the Fading Revelations mod.

docs.title: Gate: Liquid
docs.text: The gate to all of the liquid related blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Fading Revelations
docs.text: The gate to all of the content included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Naval Units
docs.text: Contains the tech tree for all naval units included in the Fading Revelations mod.

docs.title: Gate: Power
docs.text: The gate to all of the power blocks included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Resources
docs.text: The gate to all of the resources and ores included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Turrets
docs.text: The gate to all of the turrets included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Units
docs.text: The gate to all of the units included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Gate: Walls
docs.text: The gate to all of the walls included in the Fading Revelations Mod.

docs.title: Living Steel
docs.text: A sedimentation of living steel. Can be mined but beware as it damages units walking over it and slows them.

docs.title: Alloy Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward. Faster than a titanium conveyor.

docs.title: Alloy Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items over terrain or buildings. Faster than the titanium bridge conveyor.

docs.title: Tiny Mass Driver
docs.text: Short range item transport structure. Collects small batches of items and shoots them to other tiny mass drivers.

docs.title: Titanium Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items over terrain or buildings. Faster than the regular bridge conveyor.

docs.title: Titanium Distributor
docs.text: Distributes input items to 7 output directions equally. Faster than the regular distributor.

docs.title: Titanium Junction
docs.text: Acts as a bridge for two crossing titanium conveyor belts.

docs.title: Titanium Router
docs.text: Distributes items to 3 output directions equally. Faster than the regular router.

docs.title: Blast Compound Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for blast compound.

docs.title: Advanced Launch Pad
docs.text: Uses technology infused with living steel to launch items faster than the regular launch pad. Can be boosted by using water

docs.title: Coal Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for coal.

docs.title: Construction Pylon
docs.text: Automatically builds and destroys structures and supports the player.

docs.title: Core: Atom
docs.text: Core of the base. Very well armored and stores a good amount of resources.

docs.title: Core: Element
docs.text: Core of the base. Extremely well armored and stores a huge amount of resources.

docs.title: Dark Mender
docs.text: Heals nearby blocks in great amounts but needs a constant supply of living steel to do so .

docs.title: Depository
docs.text: Stores a gigantic amount of items of each type, akin to a vault. Expands storage when placed next to a core. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

docs.title: Advanced Unloader
docs.text: An unloader that unloads items way faster than the normal one and can also buffer some items.

docs.title: Force Dome
docs.text: A better Force Projector with more range and shield health. Cannot be boosted with Phase Fabric.

docs.title: Copper Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges copper for gold.

docs.title: Thorium Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges thorium for gold.

docs.title: Titanium Exchange Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges titanium for gold.

docs.title: Graphite Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for graphite.

docs.title: Lead Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for lead.

docs.title: Main Core
docs.text: Core of the base. Unbelievably well armored and stores vast amounts of resources. Isn't defended by a unit but can instead build, mine and defend itself.

docs.title: Metaglass Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for metaglass.

docs.title: Tiny Overdrive Projector
docs.text: A tiny overdrive projector. Makes everything in its range faster but be aware that it also increases energy consumption!

docs.title: Outpost
docs.text: An outpost that can be built anywhere on the map and transfers all items that are inputted directly to the main core.

docs.title: Phase Fabric Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for phase fabric.

docs.title: Plastanium Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for plastanium.

docs.title: Pyratite Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for pyratite.

docs.title: Sand Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for sand.

docs.title: Silicon Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for silicon.

docs.title: Spore Pod Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for spore pods.

docs.title: Surge Alloy Trading Station
docs.text: Exchange Station that exchanges gold for surge alloy.

docs.title: Isolated Conduit
docs.text: A decently fast conduit made from plastanium.

docs.title: Steel Pump
docs.text: A pump made using living steel that uses power to pump great amounts of liquid.

docs.title: Steel Tank
docs.text: A liquid tank made from living steel that has more capacity than a regular liquid tank but the same size.

docs.title: Advanced Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel that takes up the same amount of space as a regular one.

docs.title: Advanced Surge Tower
docs.text: A power node with a lot of range but a max of 2 connections. A better surge tower.

docs.title: Living Steel Thermal Generator
docs.text: Produces heat in hot locations using intelligent spore steel activity. Is more efficient than the normal thermal generator.

docs.title: Power Reserve
docs.text: A HUGE battery capable of storing vast amounts of power.

docs.title: Pyratite Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of pyratite to make a decent amount of power.

docs.title: Reinforced Large Power Node
docs.text: A large power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Reinforced Power Node
docs.text: A power node reinforced using titanium. Is a lot more durable than a regular beam node while also maintaining slightly more range.

docs.title: Slag Generator
docs.text: A generator that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Slag Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses the heat of Slag to make power.

docs.title: Solar Array
docs.text: A solar panel with a large surface area, enabling a high energy output.

docs.title: Steam Turbine
docs.text: A better version of the Steam Turbine built using Living Steel. Uses more water in exchange for greatly improved power output. Slowly produces steam and builds up pressure. Explodes when the pressure reaches a critical point.

docs.title: Amalgam Generator
docs.text: Uses the high flammability of Steel Amalgam to create large amounts of power from it.

docs.title: Titanium Solar Panel
docs.text: A better solar panel made with titanium. Produces more power than a regular solar panel.

docs.title: Turbine Concentrator
docs.text: Similar to a Turbine Condenser but creates larger amounts of power and more water.

docs.title: Nuclear Reactor
docs.text: A reactor that uses uraniumrods to create a lot of power. Explodes violently when it is not cooled extensively!

docs.title: Advanced Water Extractor
docs.text: Extracts large quantities of groundwater. Used in locations with no surface water available..

docs.title: Compact Laser Drill
docs.text: Allows small-scale drilling via laser technology, but requires power. Capable of mining thorium.

docs.title: Greenhouse
docs.text: A better cultivator that creates a lot more spore pods.

docs.title: Ground Crusher
docs.text: Quickly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires large quantities of power.

docs.title: Ground Grinder
docs.text: Slowly grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires power.

docs.title: Ground Miller
docs.text: Grinds up the ground it sits on to produce sand. Requires a hefty amount of power.

docs.title: Hyper Drill
docs.text: The magnum opus of drill technology. Incapable of mining sand, but mines other ores at massive rates, consuming cryofluid in the process.

docs.title: Oil Bore
docs.text: A better oil extractor that runs more efficiently.

docs.title: Steel Sieve
docs.text: The largest sieve. Rapidly filters gold out of water.

docs.title: Tiny Mechanical Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the mechanical drill.

docs.title: Tiny Plasma Bore
docs.text: A small version of the Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Tiny Pneumatic Drill
docs.text: A tiny version of the pneumatic drill.

docs.title: Tungsten Bore
docs.text: A Plasma Bore made from Tungsten. Has more range than a normal Plasma Bore.

docs.title: Vent Concentrator
docs.text: A better Vent Condensator that creates more water.

docs.title: Absole
docs.text: Inflicts a high energy burn upon enemies via a highly concentrated laser.

docs.title: Accel
docs.text: Marks a path with a damaging high-precision laser before firing an expanding electric round that explodes on impact.

docs.title: Air Arc
docs.text: Fires arcs of electricity at airborne targets.

docs.title: Batter
docs.text: Shoves back enemies using bolts consisting of various liquids.

docs.title: Arc Storm
docs.text: Swiftly fires powerful arcs of electricity at ground targets.

docs.title: Deracination
docs.text: Beams out an intense tractor beam that pulls in air targets, dealing heavy damage in the process.

docs.title: Shatter
docs.text: Fires various powerful clumps of flak at enemy aircraft.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Damages and destroys incoming projectiles, akin to the segment. Laser projectiles are still not targeted.

docs.title: Assail
docs.text: Launches a flurry of homing missiles at enemies, akin to the swarmer.

docs.title: CAATS
docs.text: Even if the name might sound cute, this is Cerbero's proudest anti-air invention: The Cerberian Anti Air Turret System.

docs.title: Cavalry
docs.text: Launches a rapidly pulsating, cascading plasma orb.

docs.title: Hurricane
docs.text: Fires many clumps of explosive flak at enemies, akin to the cyclone.

docs.title: Diffract
docs.text: Fires high-grade piercing shells that split into more shells.

docs.title: Gattling
docs.text: Pelts nearby enemies with a storm of bullets. Good luck feeding this.

docs.title: Ignitor
docs.text: Fires many close-range piercing bolts at nearby enemies, akin to the fuse.

docs.title: Interitus
docs.text: Deploys a singular homing missile at faraway enemies.

docs.title: Kugelblitz
docs.text: Launches powerful lightning orbs via supercharging of metal.

docs.title: Lightning Chaingun
docs.text: Gradually escalates in firerate, decimating enemies with a flurry of lasers.

docs.title: Armageddon
docs.text: Charges and fires three persistent laser beams at nearby enemies. Requires high quantities of coolant to operate.

docs.title: Landmine Launcher
docs.text: Deploys landmines that stick to the ground for a short while. Mines explode on contact.

docs.title: Missile Battery
docs.text: Deploys ballistic drones that fire a large barrage of homing rockets. Cannot rotate while charging.

docs.title: Nuclear Launch Silo
docs.text: Launches nuclear warheads that disable healing blocks and deal heavy damage to enemies caught in its radius. Low rate of fire.

docs.title: Mortar
docs.text: Flings incendiary cannon shells at nearby enemies. Has a blind spot.

docs.title: Itemslinger
docs.text: Slingshots pieces of raw material at enemies.

docs.title: CBST
docs.text: Cluster bomb strike turret. Fires fragging shells that cover a wide area.

docs.title: Sear
docs.text: Singes nearby enemies, akin to the scorch.

docs.title: Shotgun
docs.text: Fires many rounds at point-blank range. Deals more damage up close.

docs.title: Sniper
docs.text: Long range, high damage. Useful for point defense and securing vulnerable areas.

docs.title: Sprinkler
docs.text: Puts out nearby fires at high efficiency. Not useful in combat, as it deals no damage.

docs.title: Sunflare
docs.text: Incinerates any and all enemies that walk nearby, akin to the sear.

docs.title: Trio
docs.text: Fires rounds utilizing three barrels as opposed to the duo's two.

docs.title: Uhlan
docs.text: Charges and fires three powerful beams of energy at ground targets.

docs.title: Van Turretheim
docs.text: Fires bursts of powerful rounds, akin to a more concentrated shotgun.

docs.title: Weave
docs.text: Fires two weaving shots of water at enemies.

docs.title: Zephyr
docs.text: Fires non-damaging, high-concentration blasts of steam, dealing heavy knockback.

docs.title: Advanced Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 3rd tier. These upgraded units may be upgraded a final time.

docs.title: Basic Reassembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units created in the Basic Factory to the next tier. Units produced by this Reassembly Chamber may be further upgraded.

docs.title: Primary Factory
docs.text: Creates small and light units which may be upgraded using Reassembly Chambers.

docs.title: Progressive Assembly Chamber
docs.text: Upgrades units to the 4th and final tier.

docs.title: Regenerator
docs.text: A tower that continuously heals all allied units in its range. Requires Cryofluid.

docs.title: Copper Ammo
docs.text: Simple, boring ammo with absolutly no effects whatsoever.

docs.title: Titanium Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from titanium. Decent damage and has pierce.

docs.title: Explosive Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from blast compound. Decent damage and has a frag effect in some turrets.

docs.title: Cryogenic Alloy
docs.text: A shock-cooled, highly durable metal made from Igneous Alloy, Cryogenic Gel and Neutron Fluid. Useful in advanced electronic components.

docs.title: Cryogenic Gel
docs.text: A very cold material made from mixing cryofluid and silicon. Used as one of the components to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Fuel Rod
docs.text: A fuel rod constructed from layering thorium on a durable plastanium and lead core.

docs.title: Gold
docs.text: A shiny piece of metal! Can be traded to get other resources.

docs.title: Healing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from spore pods. No damage but heals hit allied blocks.

docs.title: Homing Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from thorium. Good damage and has a homing effect.

docs.title: Igneous Alloy
docs.text: A very hot material smelted from surge alloy and titanium using slag. Used as a component needed to create Cryogenic Alloy.

docs.title: Hardened Living Steel
docs.text: Living steel that was infused with thorium to make it more durable.

docs.title: Living Steel
docs.text: A living piece of metal. Titanium infused with spores.

docs.title: Nano Ammo
docs.text: Ammo made from living steel that infects enemies with nano bots which burn them from the inside.

docs.title: Nuke
docs.text: A nuclear warhead made using graphite and fuel rods.

docs.title: Steel Amalgam
docs.text: A compound material made from Copper, Living Steel and Surge Alloy.

docs.title: Living Steel Liquid
docs.text: Living Steel that was infused with oil thus making it a liquid. Spreads to nearby oil to 'self-replicate'.

docs.title: Neutron Fluid
docs.text: A highly potent coolant created by mixing oil, cryofluid and living steel liquid.

docs.title: Cangirus
docs.text: A lush planet that has land and water.

docs.title: Cerbero
docs.text: A barren planet where tragedy struck long ago. Nothing is left here besides destruction and death.

docs.title: Hathor
docs.text: A small piece of Cerbero created by the impact of a meteor. Nothing lasts here except an ancient Cerberian base built here before everything collapsed...

docs.title: Abandoned Battlefield
docs.text: The last sector before you conquer Cerbero. The instruments register many powerful foes here. Waves will be sent relentlessly. Try to survive!

docs.title: Dree
docs.text: The next step on your journey through Cerbero. This sector has coal and water. Use coal to create primitive power. Upgrade your resources.

docs.title: Etnatic Isles
docs.text: The Crux's primary manufacturing plant for flammables and circuitry. Eliminate the outposts, bust through the main gate and secure valuable resources.

docs.title: Exordium
docs.text: You arrive on Cerbero. This is the sector that the computer calculated the least danger for. Start your journey. Set up basic operations. Prepare for more difficult sectors.

docs.title: Spore Dunes
docs.text: The next challenging sector on cerbero. Has Titanium. Harder waves.

docs.title: Aedes
docs.text: Shoots swerving bullets at nearby targets. Rotors deal damage.

docs.title: Apis
docs.text: Fires small yet deadly precision laser blasts. Can hover.

docs.title: Armiger
docs.text: Equipped with rocket launchers and a minigun. Rotor deals decent damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: Penumbra
docs.text: A unit with technology similar to that of the Serpulo Antumbra but the main cannons shoot a laser instead of regular bullets.

docs.title: Veil
docs.text: Like the Eclipse unit but instead of shooting flak bullets, it shoots energy missiles. Also shoots stronger lasers. Sacrifices some of it's armor for more health and damage.

docs.title: Spark
docs.text: A unit similar to a Flare from Serpulo but with upgraded weaponry.

docs.title: Vista
docs.text: A Horizon-like unit that throws down stronger bombs.

docs.title: Summit
docs.text: A unit similar to a Zenith but the missile launchers fire barrages of missiles instead of single ones.

docs.title: Alopex
docs.text: Fires concentrated piercing lasers at nearby targets. Quick, but frail.

docs.title: Culiseta
docs.text: Equipped with fragging bombs, targetable missiles, railguns, and more. Manufactures assault and siege units on board to deploy upon destruction. Rotor deals damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: Delta
docs.text: Defends the Atom core from enemies. Swiftly builds structures, and is equipped with healing beams.

docs.title: Epsilon
docs.text: Defends the Element core from enemies. Rapidly builds a variety of structures, and is equipped with multiple healing beams.

docs.title: HIVE
docs.text: Frail, but has a powerful forcefield, alongside assault unit constructors. Boasts many highly effective laser weapons.

docs.title: Kestrel
docs.text: Equipped with onboard arc turrets and a concentrated laser beam. Forfeits agility and speed for power.

docs.title: Areus
docs.text: Fires a miniaturized laser beam at nearby targets.

docs.title: Onirion
docs.text: Equipped with a torpedo cannon, dual missile launchers, and swerving machine guns. Additionally, drops bombs on targets underneath it. Rotors deal large damage to nearby targets.

docs.title: Sapling
docs.text: Capable of large-scale mining, building, and repairing. The penultimate support drone.

docs.title: Sprout
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, building, and repairing. Boosts nearby allied units' move speed.

docs.title: Seed
docs.text: Capable of automatic mining, repairing, and building.

docs.title: Orbital Platform Strahl
docs.text: Boasts many highly concentrated laser beams, alongside point defense beam turrets. Rapidly builds and releases Alopex.

docs.title: Annax
docs.text: Deals medium-high damage via twin slag guns. Effective against enemy transport structures.

docs.title: Auctus
docs.text: A long, snake-like unit that stomps buildings.

docs.title: Auratus
docs.text: Utilizes slag and water orbs to neutralize enemy targets. Additionally, it is equipped with a main railcannon.

docs.title: Curtulus
docs.text: A unit with an appearance close to that of an Arkyid but instead of the main cannon shooting artillery bullets, it shoots a liquid shell.

docs.title: Hexathelid
docs.text: A unit type similar to an Atrax but shoots fragging slag bullets. Exchanges less health and armor for a lot more damage.

docs.title: Cerberian Behemoth
docs.text: A huge unit and Cerberos proudest invention. Shoots with a ginormous laser, huge fragging bullets, laser sweepers and smaller FLAK turrets.

docs.title: Straggle
docs.text: A cerberian version of the Crawler unit.

docs.title: Bayonet
docs.text: A stronger version of the Dagger unit typically found on Serpulo.

docs.title: Citadel
docs.text: An upgraded version of the Fortress that hails from Cerbero.

docs.title: Cudgel
docs.text: A unit similar to a Mace from Serpulo but stronger. Shoots with a different type of Flamethrower.

docs.title: Kaiser
docs.text: A unit inspired by the Reign from Serpulo but with upgraded technology. Hass massively increased health and armor at the cost of sacrificing some agility.

docs.title: Baton
docs.text: A re-manufactured version of the Scepter unit.

docs.title: Nephila
docs.text: Like the Spiroct unit but steals more life using enhanced sapping lasers.

docs.title: Setosus
docs.text: A Toxopid-like unit. The secondary cannons shoot out sapping lasers instead of normal ones. Equipped with significantly more armor and attack power than a regular Toxopid.

docs.title: Corax
docs.text: Charges up a gigawatt laser that obliterates enemy structures and units alike. Additionally equipped with smaller artillery lasers.

docs.title: Reduct
docs.text: Freezes its targets alive via a frigid laser.

docs.title: Ducalis
docs.text: Equipped with rocket and proximity mine launchers. Powerful in sieges.

docs.title: Toruct
docs.text: Lights targets ablaze with a small, fiery laser.

docs.title: Onager
docs.text: Equipped with a homing rocket cannon and several smaller weapons. Obliterates all buildings in its path, but suffers against units. Can run over enemy structures.

docs.title: Procer
docs.text: Rapid-fires dual salvos of missiles at enemy targets. Is also equipped with a piercing laser.

docs.title: Sambuca
docs.text: Fires standard bullets at enemy structures. Less effective against units.

docs.title: Scofra
docs.text: Equipped with dual oil and slag guns. Can walk over walls and terrain.

docs.title: Scorpio

docs.title: Large Cryofluid Mixer
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder with higher efficiency to produce cryofluid.

docs.title: Detonation Mixer
docs.text: Mixes pyratite and blast compound into detonation compound. Requires logic alloy to control the explosion.

docs.title: Electrothermal Silicon Furnace
docs.text: Refines silicon from sand. Requires massive amounts of power.

docs.title: Electromagnetism Diffuser
docs.text: Diffuses electromagnetism from magnetic alloy onto flamefluid crystal, forming surge alloy.

docs.title: Flesh Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes flesh from plastanium, phase fabric and spore pod.

docs.title: Slag Cooler
docs.text: Produces flamefluid crystal by cooling a large amount of slag.

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Crucible
docs.text:
Fuses thorium, plastanium into hardened alloy. Requires really-massive amounts of power to create high-temperature conditions. Will explode violently if there's another crucible producing nearby, or destroyed while producing.

"More efficient, more dangerous... More deadly."

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Smelter
docs.text: Fuses thorium, plastanium and kindling alloy into hardened alloy.

docs.title: Kindling Extractor
docs.text: Extracts sulflame alloy into pure kindling alloy.

docs.title: Sulflame Extractor
docs.text: Extracts combustible from coal and spore pods, and mixes it with slag into sulflame alloy.

docs.title: Logic Alloy Processor
docs.text: Processes copper, silicon and titanium into logic alloy.

docs.title: Magnetic Alloy Former
docs.text: Forms surge alloy, conductor and hardened alloy into magnetic alloy.

docs.title: Magnetic Ring Synthesizer
docs.text: Utilizes the strong magnetic field generated by the magnetic ring to synthesize thorium and sand with higher efficiency into phase fabric.

docs.title: Magnetism-Concentrated Rolling Mill
docs.text: Utilizes the magnetic field generated by magnetic alloy, applying an electric field force to microscopic oil particles and compress them into titanium with higher efficiency to produce plastanium.

docs.title: Melting Furnace
docs.text: Consumes massive power to generate heat, melting down input materials into slag. Open-top design allows partial combustion of flammable materials due to extreme temperatures.

docs.title: Thermal Kiln
docs.text: Smelts sand and coal into glass. More efficient in hot locations.

docs.title: Timber Burner
docs.text: Burns timber into coal and generates power.

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: Crushes copper and lead into scrap. Used in locations with no surface scrap available.

docs.title: Liquid Nitrogen Compressor
docs.text: Collects nitrogen in atmospheric. Uses blast compound and kindling alloy to create high-pressure conditions, with a large amount of cryofluid as coolant to compress nitrogen into liquid nitrogen.

docs.title: Large Hardened Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections. Can be placed on liquids.

Reconstructs itself depending on the degree of damage, further improving the ability to withstand pressure.

docs.title: Hardened Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Absorbs lasers and electric arcs. Blocks automatic power connections. Can be placed on liquids.

Reconstructs itself depending on the degree of damage, further improving the ability to withstand pressure.

docs.title: Dam Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Can only be placed on water.

docs.title: Large Dam Wall
docs.text: Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Can only be placed on water.

docs.title: Flesh Wall
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Reflects most bullets upon impact, meanwhile repairs itself depending on bullet damage.

Has the ability to repair itself. Optionally uses water to boost efficiency; transfers water input to nearby blocks of the same type.

docs.title: Adaptive Source
docs.text: Automatically fills nearby necessary buildings and infinitely outputs power and heat. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Composite Bridge Conveyor
docs.text: Instantly transports items over terrain or buildings. Longer range than the item bridge.

docs.title: Composite Router
docs.text:
Instantly distributes input items to 3 output directions, however max consecution is limited. Distributes randomly in singleplayer games, however in order to avoid synchronization issues, equal distribution is used instead in multiplayer games.

Support linkage operations with Logic Processor. When controlled by the instruction "Control-config", allows directional distribution with specific values: 0 -> Right 1 -> Up 2 -> Left 3 -> Down

docs.title: Composite Unloader
docs.text: Unloads the selected item from the block behind it. Unload speed will hardly be affected by low FPS.

docs.title: Composite Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward. Faster than a titanium conveyor.

docs.title: Hardened Alloy Conveyor
docs.text: Transports items forward in batches. Accepts items at the back, and unloads them in three directions at the front. Requires multiple loading and unloading points for peak throughput. Faster than a plastanium conveyor.

docs.title: Melted Sand
docs.text: A kind of glass melted from sand.

docs.title: Building Healer
docs.text: Slowly repairs allied structures in a square perimeter. Optionally uses silicon to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Campfire
docs.text: Uses lots of flammable materials to ignite campfire, increases the speed of nearby buildings. Inspire allied unit and sap enemy unit nearby.

docs.title: Javelin Pad
docs.text: Provides transformation into a quick, lightly-armored interceptor. Consumes power when using.

docs.title: Build Indicator
docs.text: Automatically rebuilds structures and assists other units in construction in range.

docs.title: Numb Delusion
docs.text:
Stores a large amount of items of each type. Expands storage when placed next to a core. Contents can be retrieved with an unloader.

A by-product of Fire Company's research on "timelines". By paying a certain cost, it can revive structures based on their "Concept", while compressing excess matter into the current timeline as bullets against enemies. However, reviving structures with complex "Concept" can cause severe temporal disturbances, resulting in spawning bullets that attacks indiscriminately.

Warning: NEVER attempt to revive any living beings! The previous trial annihilated the entire spatial sector of Struct Planet. The area remains a massless void to this day-anything entering it vanishes for reasons unknown.

docs.title: Primary Interplanetary Accelerator
docs.text:
Primary electromagnetic railgun tower. Accelerates primary cores to the Planet Faraway to escape velocity for interplanetary deployment.

Used to unlock the Planet Lysetta faraway, beginning your journey of Mod Fire.

docs.title: Sky Dome
docs.text: Creates a hexagonal force field around itself, protecting buildings and units inside from damage. More practical than a force projector.

docs.title: Core: Bulwark
docs.text: Core of the base. Exceedingly well armored. Stores less resources than a Nucleus. Creates a hexagonal force field around itself, protecting buildings and units inside from damage.

docs.title: Composite Bridge Conduit
docs.text: Transports liquids over terrain or buildings. Longer range than the bridge conduit.

docs.title: Composite Liquid Router
docs.text: Accepts liquids from one direction and outputs them to up to 3 other directions equally. Can also store a sizeable amount of liquid.

docs.title: Hardened Liquid Tank
docs.text: Stores excess amount of liquid. Outputs to all sides, similarly to a liquid router. Possessing considerable resistance to external pressure impacts.

docs.title: Liquid Unloader
docs.text: Let the selected liquid which is in the nearby buildings in an average level. Unknowingly, sometimes it doesn't work to the Plated Conduit.

docs.title: Magnetic Ring Pump
docs.text: Pumps and outputs liquids in a much greater efficiency. Requires power.

docs.title: Burst Reactor
docs.text:
Uses detonations to produce massive amounts of power. Needs liquid nitrogen for coolant. The detonations contained in it is not funny, so you must make perparations to repair it in time...

The top technology in magnetic. While running, it will produce much power according to the power consumed by the surrounding devices. However, it will produce less power when damaged. Randomly spawns a wave of magnetic after completely starts, which will not only increase its power production but also damage itself. It won't spawn the wave when in low health.

docs.title: Large Hydroelectric Generator
docs.text: Utilizes water flow to impact fan blades and generate power. The faster the water flow velocity, the greater the power generation.

docs.title: Hydroelectric Generator
docs.text: Utilizes water flow to impact fan blades and generate power. The faster the water flow velocity, the greater the power generation.

docs.title: Flame Generator
docs.text: Burns highly-flammable materials to generate power. Requires cryofluid as coolant.

docs.title: Conductor Power Node
docs.text: A long-range power node with fewer available connections than large power node. Can store an amount of power.

docs.title: Constraint Extractor
docs.text: Focuses a beam for long-distance mineral mining. Requires power. Due to the large amount of heat generated while working, mining can only be carried out at a lower speed. Needs to configure desired mineral manually, and the extractor will automatically search for and mine the nearest target. Optionally uses cryofluid to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Chopper
docs.text: When placed facing a tree, chops and outputs timber indefinitely.

docs.title: Focusing Extractor
docs.text: Focuses a beam for long-distance mineral mining. Requires an amount of power. Equipped with more focusing devices and improved heat dissipation structure, allowing for further increase in extraction speed. Optionally uses liquid nitrogen to boost efficiency.

docs.title: Fission Drill
docs.text: Uses a large amount of thorium to lead to fissions, leading ores escape from its position. (I'm kidding)

docs.title: Tree Farm
docs.text: Breeds trees with water, and processes it into timber.

docs.title: Vapour Condenser
docs.text: Collects a large amount of water vapor in the atmosphere, and condenses it into water. Require large amounts of power.

docs.title: Stacked Cultivator
docs.text: Extracts nearby tainted water sources through the built-in water extractor, directly outputting spore pods after further cultivation. Outputs surplus water while meeting its own cultivation needs.

docs.title: Biomass Cultivator
docs.text: Collects tiny concentrations of atmospheric spores, and cultivates them into spore pods with advanced technology. More efficient than cultivator.

docs.title: Aerolite
docs.text: High energy explosive thrower, causing devastating damage to enemy facilities over vast distances.

docs.title: Blossom
docs.text: Fires two seeking cluster-missiles at enemy targets.

docs.title: Cumulonimbus
docs.text:
Fires powerful energetic bullets. The bullet will be stronger if turret keeps shooting.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Seaquake

docs.title: Ignition

docs.title: Fulmination

docs.title: Gambler
docs.text:
Fires a barrage of shrapnels at enemy targets. Has a chance to fire a better bullet type depending on the level of ammo being used, until the highest level.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Grudge
docs.text: Fires huge bullets at enemy targets. Highly effective to well-armored units. Can't be overdriven for safety reasons.

docs.title: Smasher
docs.text: Shoots clusters of shells at ground enemy targets over long distances.

docs.title: Magnetic Domain
docs.text: Generates energy magnetic field, releasing directional energy beams to strike all enemy units and structures nearby and electrify enemy units.

docs.title: Magnetic Rail
docs.text: Electromagnetic railgun. Requires really-massive amounts of power.

docs.title: Magnetic Sphere
docs.text:
Fires a charged, decelerated sphere at aerial enemy targets. The sphere will detect whether there's a target nearby and release directional lightning attacking target. The sphere will select and chase a target nearby if it comes to the end.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Obstruction
docs.text:
Fires energetic balls, destroying nearby bullets and damaging gathered units.

"It resonates with otherworldly energy."

docs.title: Distance

docs.title: Scab
docs.text: Fires homing flesh bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Nightmare
docs.text: Fires overpowered pierce beams at enemy targets rapidly.

docs.title: Flesh Reconstructor

docs.title: Fractal Unit Factory
docs.text: Consumes "Element" contained in items to produce advanced units. Output units can be used directly, or moved into reconstructors for upgrading.

docs.title: Large Payload Router
docs.text: Splits input payloads into 3 output directions. Functions as a sorter when a filter is set.

docs.title: Unit Healer

docs.title: Vectorial Unit Factory
docs.text: Consumes "Element" contained in items to produce general units. Output units can be used directly, or moved into reconstructors for upgrading.
