docs.title: Lysetta
docs.text:
A planet with intricate connections to Serpulo, while possessing more advanced technology than it. Unfortunately, a certain force has already taken the lead.

More campaign maps will be available in the future.

docs.title: Branched Rivers
docs.text:
A section of the Eteriver. River there branches into multiple tributaries, providing rapid access to surrounding sectors. However, the turbulent currents here appear to have swept away most mineral deposits, and the crisscrossing waterways grant enemy naval forces exceptional mobility, making the region strategically vulnerable. A covert base along the riverbank had been established. Detectors have scanned unidentified type of liquid pumps and tanks nearby. While enemy forces are unlikely to arrive imminently, if the base is detected, they could swiftly deploy via the river to besiege us.

Secure the area to research advanced water extraction, purification, and storage technology. Establish a forward operating base for expanded territorial control.

docs.title: Spore Fiord
docs.text:
After Darksand Peak-forest, this sector was detected. An amount of enemy force has been already stationed here. The detection signs indicate that there was already some kind of force trying to confront the enemy before out arrival, but they failed. Eradicate enemies, capture the sector and research advanced material processing technology and primary spore cultivation technology.

Enemies will begin their attack in a short time, build up defenses as soon as possible.

docs.title: Desert Wastes
docs.text:
Desert's central zone. Numerous factories were once built here, but few remain. Resources are scarce, yet wastes are vast, and criss-crossed with derelict sector structures.

Enemies have seized the initiative, establishing small-scale material processing facilities. Main forces haven't yet reached this remote site - defenses remain lax. HQ will dispatch reinforcements to clear the area. Stay vigilant against enemy reserves, destroy their main forces, and research advanced material processing tech.

docs.title: Frozen Wall
docs.text: This sector is a canyon. The high mountains on both sides stretch out, eventually enclosing the sector ahead. Radar cannot penetrate these mountains to scan the sector ahead,which has caught our attention.This is the only route to that sector. The enemy has built massive defenses here, seemingly to guard against something coming from ahead.Regardless, we must thwart all the enemy's schemes. Moreover, the enemy here is using two new turrets, so we must capture this place.

docs.title: Glaciated Peaks
docs.text:
Breaking through the blockade north of the enemy in Dark Workshop, HQ dispatched a large number of detectors to confirm whether there were any enemy forces continuing to advance. One of the detectors went missing while passing through the area, and the last image it transmitted was of an electromagnetic razorblade tearing it in half.

The enemy has established a large base on the peaks, take it down. HQ will constantly dispatch reinforcements.

docs.title: Dark Workshop
docs.text: Further inland lies the enemy factories. There seems to be abandoned, but still has enemy units and installations. There also contains lots of production facilities. Capture enemy cores, leave nothing standing, research their tech. Allied units are strengthened, try using units to attack.

docs.title: Eteriver Stronghold
docs.text:
One of many parts of Eteriver. Tt is detected that enemy has used a kind of new turret that we have never seen. Capture the area to clear the threats around the Darksand Peak-forest, and research the new turret.

Detection radar indicates that an unknown large unit skulks there, build high-tier turrets to defend enemy's sudden attack.

docs.title: Darksand Peak-forest
docs.text:
Having broken through the outpost base, we arrived at this area of peak forests. The mineral resources here are relatively abundant, with a large number of thermal resources waiting to be developed. However, the bad news is that an enemy force has stationed on the other side of the river, enabling them to quickly launch counterattack measures.

Utilize the existing technology and resources to annihilate the enemies, occupy here and develop as much as possible.

docs.title: Beach Landing
docs.text:
After occupying the Frozen Ground, several construction ships were dispatched, which drifted here along the river. The enemies here possess knowledge of timber processing technology and hydroelectric generation technology. Destroy the enemy base, attempt to research their technologies, and use this place as a springboard to advance into the Antarctic region.

We have also detected several unknown types of turrets. However, due to the lack of materials, we are unable to conduct research on them.

docs.title: Landing Base
docs.text: Shortly after capturing the planetary launch terminal, the near-serpulo satellite received an unknown hostile signal. After investigation, it was found that the signal was transmitted from this distant planet. After multiple scans, this location was selected as the landing point. Destroy the base, capture the sector.

docs.title: Lava Stronghold
docs.text:
Having disintegrated the enemy forces in Scorching Volcano, it's time to deal a counter-blow to the North Pole. Enemy forces have built a complete defence and coupled the high temperature. Large allied units were unable to be delivered here, making the stronghold hard to capture.

However, remember the blue, light strike ships in Desolate Fortification? They were actually the elite units seized by allied forces in the latest attack here. Anyway, flying detector has found the equipment used to summon these strike ships here.

Allied forces have established a base here. Take over the base, leave nothing standing, research their tech.

docs.title: Chilly Mountains
docs.text:
The lifeless mountains. Records show here contains the tech of a brand-new, efficient generator.

Here stands reinforced enemy forces, don't be fooled by the long spacing between enemy attacks.

docs.title: Frozen Ground
docs.text:
After eliminating the threat in the Darksand Peak-forest, an old workshop site was detected. It is suspected to have been a private workshop belonging to the original inhabitants of this planet, but was later abandoned due to the area's barrenness. The returning detector brought us the news we were looking for: there is a new type of factory ruin here that we have never seen before, but it is also occupied by enemies that pose a deadly threat to the research team.

Occupy this site and provide more advanced factories for logistical support.

docs.title: Rubble Ridge
docs.text:
Amidst the mountain ranges, we discovered the remnants of a concealed factory complex. Despite the severely depleted mineral resources in this area, the scale of the ruins is unexpectedly vast, raising significant suspicion. Our analysis suggests two hypotheses: 1. The site may have once been resource-rich, but geological shifts buried the mineral veins beneath the mountains. However, the structural coherence of the ruins contradicts this theory, as the materials’ durability would not withstand such cataclysmic changes. 2. The site likely employed a brand-new extraction facility capable of bypassing conventional mining limitations. Preliminary scans strongly support the second hypothesis. Capture this sector and research the extraction facility.

Note that the region’s unique topography is dominated by an anomalous electromagnetic cloud. Any attempt to deploy overmass cores (e.g. Core: Nucleus, Core: Bulwark) will trigger immediate detonation when making landing. Reinforcements cannot be dispatched either.

docs.title: Stormy Coast
docs.text:
Following a tributary of the Eteriver, we arrived in this coastal area where the detector indicated a small enemy force stationed nearby. After a fierce battle, this is now the last remaining stronghold.

However, the enemy's reinforcements far exceeded our estimates, with the radar map showing a large enemy force swarming towards the area, including elite force. Additionally, through the images transmitted back by the detector from behind enemy lines, we discovered it appears to be a spore contamination source, where the enemy has established a small flesh research facility.

Regardless, repelling enemy's attack and capture this sector, research th e preliminary tech of Flesh, and gain an advantage for future maritime operations.

The weather may be quite severe, please take necessary preparations.

docs.title: Tainted Estuary
docs.text: Having captured Branched Rivers, HQ had continuously deployed detectors to survey upstream conditions, with this estuary area being one of the results. Blanketed with spores, this sector proves ideal for mycological research. Regrettably, enemy forces have already established a stronghold here, fortifying the area with exceptionally high defensive measures. Previous detector deployments have alerted the enemy, leaving us limited operational time. Employ the technology researched from Branched Rivers to completely eradicate all their cores and attain critical information regarding Flesh-about technology. HQ will transmit relevant technical data shortly after landing - ensure to take research promptly. Be advised that enemy forces periodically activate Javelin pads to summon strike ship reinforcements. Maintain constant anti-air readiness to counter these aerial threats.

docs.title: Desolate Fortification
docs.text: After Dark Workshop, allied forces were sent to develop the sectors nearby. This sector seems to have been developed by enemy. As a consequence, this sector was taken over quickly. But now, it has been detected that enemy forces are approaching here. Fend off the enemies and capture this sector. The original frontline will be soon destructed after ~10 waves, build up defense made up of missile turret "Distance" asap.

docs.title: Scorching Volcano
docs.text:
As we went deeper into the North Pole, the volcanic zone in this area was located, which is one of the most violent plates in Lysetta. "A pure hell..."This is what flying detector showed on its screen after returning from there.

Pay attention to repairing buildings damaged by the earthquake in time, and defend the large number of troops sent by enemy.

It has a special shield, which can boost the unit a lot when it's in good shape, but can also weaken the unit when destroyed.

docs.text: Plays Soundtrack after connected to power (The Fortress of Frostbite by CY4N)

docs.title: moon-mod-Getharspeaker
docs.text: Plays Soundtrack after connected to power (Distant by CY4N)

docs.title: moon-mod-Solarspeaker
docs.text: Plays Soundtrack after connected to power (Sunlight Rays by CY4N)

docs.title: Aluminium Blast Kiln
docs.text: Produces more Aluminium using Bauxite and Arcanite, also produces Yttrium as byproduct.

docs.title: Arcalith Mixer
docs.text: Mixes water with Arcanite to create Arcalith.

docs.title: Arcalith Synthesizer
docs.text: Synthesizes even more Arcalith from water and Arcanite.

docs.title: Cryofluid Combiner
docs.text: Mixes water and ice shards to create Cryofluid.

docs.title: Heater
docs.text: Heats up Ice and melts it into Water.

docs.title: Ionized Xenon Mixer
docs.text: Ionizes xenon particles with arcalith fluid energy

docs.title: Xenon Concentrator
docs.text: Seperates Xenon from the rest of the air.

docs.title: Aerogel Wall
docs.text: Mix of Aerogel and Aluminium; tougher than Yttrium.

docs.title: Large Arcanthium Wall
docs.text: A larger and stronger Arcanthium Wall with a bigger shield.

docs.title: Arcanthium Wall
docs.text: After connecting it to power it produces a shield that covers the size of the wall.

docs.title: Cryogenium Wall
docs.text: A wall made out of Cryogenium, tougher than an Aerogel Wall.

docs.title: Diamond Wall
docs.text: A wall made out of pure diamond, very durable.

docs.title: Large Reinforced Cryofabric Wall
docs.text: "A larger and stronger Reinforced Cryofabric wall, no other wall matches it's durability."

docs.title: Reinforced Cryofabric Wall
docs.text: The strongest wall, reflects bullets and absorbs lasers.

docs.title: Yttrium Wall
docs.text: A solid block made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Cargo Loader
docs.text: Creates units that carry selected materials across the map.

docs.title: Unload Point
docs.text: A specialized point where cargo units may drop their carried materials.

docs.title: Moonstone Conveyor
docs.text: A faster conveyor made out of Moonstone.

docs.title: Yttrium Bridge
docs.text: A transport bridge made out of Yttrium

docs.title: Yttrium Conveyor
docs.text: Conveyor made out of Yttrium; a bit faster than the original.

docs.title: Yttrium Junction
docs.text: A junction but made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Inverted Overflow Yttrium Gate
docs.text: An inverted overflow gate made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Yttrium Overflow Gate
docs.text: An verflow gate made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Yttrium Router
docs.text: A router but made out of Yttrium. Outputs inputted items to three output directions equally.

docs.title: Yttrium Inverted Sorter
docs.text: An invetred sorter made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Core: Iceberg
docs.text: Stronger core with more capacity, health and a different core unit.

docs.title: Cryo Mine
docs.text: Creates cryo explosion upon enemy units on contact, can be used multiple times but loses health when triggered.

docs.title: Reinforced Launchpad
docs.text: Launches items to selected sectors, has a smaller capacity than the orginal but recharges faster.

docs.title: Repair Field
docs.text: Repairs nearby structures, can be boosted with arcalith

docs.title: Small Magazine
docs.text: A block that stores items, can be placed around a core to increase its capacity.

docs.title: Fluid Tank
docs.text: Stores decent amounts of liquids and gases.

docs.title: Yttrium Liquid Bridge
docs.text: Bridge for liquids, made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Yttrium Liquid Junction
docs.text: Junction for liquids, made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Yttrium Liquid Router
docs.text: Router for liquids, made out of Yttrium.

docs.title: Yttrium Pipe
docs.text: A simple pipe used to transport fluids.

docs.title: Yttrium Pump
docs.text: A basic pump, needs power to work.

docs.title: ATG
docs.text: ATG stands for arcanite thermal generator, produces small amounts of power.

docs.title: Cryothermal Generator
docs.text: Mixes heat from Arcalith with cold Cryogenium to create power, produces water as byproduct.

docs.title: Ionized Xenon Generator
docs.text: Produces large amounts of energy using Ionized Xenon.

docs.title: Large Solar
docs.text: Larger wersion of the Solar, produces more power.

docs.title: Electric Tower
docs.text: Only has two connections but increased range.

docs.title: Large Electric Node
docs.text: Larger power node, has more available connections.

docs.title: Micro Drill
docs.text: A small and cheap drill, effective in larger amounts.

docs.title: Ray Drill
docs.text: Mines even faster using fragmental technology, can be accelerated by Xenon. Requires power.

docs.title: Alectro
docs.text: A powerful turret that is perfect for taking down hoards of enemies from a large distance.

docs.title: Defragmentation
docs.text: Shoots a medium-ranged piercing laser that splits enemies from the inside.

docs.title: Dragonfly
docs.text: Fires a hail of bullets at enemies.

docs.title: Frostbite
docs.text: Absolutley devastates enemies with its powerful, extremly cold fragmentational beam.

docs.title: Leech
docs.text: Deals constant damage to a single target using a medium-ranged laser.

docs.title: Moonray
docs.text: Charges up to fire a single piercing bullet.

docs.title: Pike
docs.text: A small turret, good for taking down single targets.

docs.title: Restart
docs.text: A fragmentational superweapon, capable of dealing with enemies with ease.

docs.title: Stinger
docs.text: Hits enemies with a single spiked bullet.

docs.title: Stormer
docs.text: Long-ranged missile launcher, can use various materials to shoot different types of rockets.

docs.title: Zap
docs.text: A small turret capable of dealing serious damage and stunning enemies.

docs.title: Icycle
docs.text: Medium ranged turret that targets enemy bullets.

docs.title: Assembler Module
docs.text: "Allows for 5 tier units upgrades. Place next to an Assemblers' bounding box."

docs.title: Main Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades all kinds of units to tier 3.

docs.title: Yttrium Payload Conveyor
docs.text: Transports payload, limited to payloads of a 3x3 size.

docs.title: Aerogel
docs.text: Very light material with average durability, used for producing flying units.

docs.title: Aluminium
docs.text: A metal created through smelting Bauxite, used in more advanced buildings.

docs.title: Arcanite
docs.text: A material with energetic properties, can be used in all power-related buildings.

docs.title: Arcanthium
docs.text: A material made from combining and compressing Arcanite with other materials. Extremly energetically active.

docs.title: Bauxite
docs.text: This material can be smelted into Aluminium.

docs.title: Cryogenium
docs.text: A very cold material that can be extracted from cryofluid.

docs.title: Diamond
docs.text: Very durable material, can be used in buildings or as ammo.

docs.title: Moonstone
docs.text: A stone used in more advanced technology.

docs.title: Reinforced Cryofabric
docs.text: An extremly durable material capable of absorbing many kinetic or energetic forces before taking damage.

docs.title: Yttrium
docs.text: A very common material on Zilo, used in nearly all buildings.

docs.title: Ionized Xenon
docs.text: Charged particles of Xenon, can be used as energy source.

docs.title: Xenon
docs.text: Abnormaly common on Zilo, Can be extracted from air. Used in production.

docs.title: CrashLanding
docs.text: A land devastated by a spaceship that crashed here, maybe we can find new technology?

docs.title: Cryo River
docs.text: A river of Cryofluid with remnants of an old enemy base. Capture it to push back our enemies.

docs.title: The Fortress
docs.text: The greatest base that Bushark has ever built. Many attacks were already launched here, none of which were successful. They have an unimaginably powerful super weapon guarding their main entrance, this base is extremly guarded. The more time you spend defending, the harder it gets. Your base will be constantly attacked, you have to launch succesful counter attacks in order to survive. If you manage to capture this base, the whole of Zilo will be under our control.

docs.title: Frontline
docs.text: We are preparing for our final target, main base of Bushark on Zilo, also known as The Fortress, they already know our plans and they are throwing everything at us, if you will be able to defend yourself, we can launch an attack on The Fortress.

docs.title: Ground Sub Zero
docs.text: The perfect place for your first steps on Zilo, collect new materials, research new technology and destroy the enemy outpost nearby.

docs.title: Lonely Lake
docs.text: A öake of cryofluid located around mountains, Maybe we can use it to research new technologies?

docs.title: Secret Passage
docs.text: Our next primary target is another enemy base located along the sunny mountains, sadly the terrain does not allows us to attack it straight up, we have to get through this claustrophobic ravine...

docs.title: Solar Peaks
docs.text: One of 2 main bases of Bushark on Zilo, their technology far surpasses yours but there is no turning back now, eradicate everything and steal their technology.

docs.title: The Asylum
docs.text: A vast place located on an asteroid. Here, Bushark from Zilo has teamed up with the Crux from Serpulo to get revenge on you. Once you defeat them, the whole asteroid will be under your control. These two factions will not give you an easy victory, you have really made them mad...

docs.title: Transit Cavern
docs.text: A cave used for transporting resources and goods, we have to weaken our enemies. Take over this place and eradicate every enemy in your path.

docs.title: Quark
docs.text: Shoots with single energy bullet, can heal friendly structures and mine, can heal allies.

docs.title: Proton
docs.text: Can help with building and repairing, has stronger bullets, can heal allies and mine.

docs.title: Neutron
docs.text: builds faster and can mine, has two guns, can heal allies.

docs.title: Element
docs.text: Charges us a strong piercing laser, can repair frendly structures and heal allies.

docs.title: Quantum
docs.text: Shoots with series of 10 powerful energy bullets, cannot heal alies but has a shield instead.

docs.title: Stellar
docs.text: Guards the Glacier core; deals less damage against buildings.

docs.title: Polaris
docs.text: Guards the Iceberg core; deals less damage against buildings.

docs.title: Flicker
docs.text: Fires a pirecing laser, gets knocked back after shooting.

docs.title: Lightning
docs.text: Fires two massive bullets, also equipped with two smaller turrets.

docs.title: Thunderstorm
docs.text: Equipped with two missile launchers and two altillery cannons, very tough.

docs.title: Salmon
docs.text: Small and cheap unit used for transporting resources.

docs.title: Scimitar
docs.text: Equipped with two more powerful burst yttrium guns.

docs.title: Rapier
docs.text: Equipped with two long ranged yttrium guns.

docs.title: Cutlass
docs.text: Equipped with two even more long ranged yttrium guns.

docs.title: Decimate
docs.text: Equipped with two bomb launchers, very tough.

docs.title: Sight
docs.text: Uses a small beam to steal life from enemies.

docs.title: Predator
docs.text: Has two lasers and one long-ranged bomb launcher, also equipped with star-shaped shield.

docs.title: Index
docs.text:
Property Value Repository https://github.com/fat-bird-owner/gier-revitalized Stars 21 Last updated 2026-06-27T16:04:40Z

Makes gier a playable planet.

IOS Compatible

More info in the repository's ReadMe.

If the main version isnt available or is

bugged then please use download from the

latest releases instead.

Starring is greatly appreciated

(Our current goal is 20 stars)

docs.title: Radiance Panel
docs.text:
A larger variant of the photon

use depleted thorium to better absorb the sun's radiation

  • Better power production
  • Quite explosive

docs.title: Boiler
docs.text:
Boils water turning it into steam.

While active over 100% damage is increased 50%

[I] - Steam: Used for defrosting and as a non-voltatile heating solution

  • Produces steam
  • Explosive
  • Requires power

docs.title: Heating port
docs.text:
Burns graphite to produce heat, Which is than channel using oxide.

  • Explosive

docs.title: Oxidization Reactor
docs.text:
Consumes water and beryllium to produce oxide. Hydrogen is made as a byproduct.

[i] - Oxide: Used for most heat based buildings and as ammo.

  • Produce oxide
  • Produce hydrogen
  • Hydrogen doesn't need to be emptied
  • Requires power
  • Explosive

docs.title: Steam Turbine
docs.text:
Produces power by condensing water into steam and turning it into usable power.

  • Very reliable
  • Lesser maintance
  • Explosive whilst active

docs.title: Cargo Cell
docs.text:
Stores items, unloadable with an output port. Has a much greater storage capacity then a crate

  • Expands core capacity
  • Explosive
  • Flammable

docs.title: Mend Tower
docs.text:
Very angry repair point beware Able to shoot at damaged buildings.

  • Bullet heals damaged buildings
  • Units are higher priority than buildings

docs.title: Plastanium Crusher
docs.text:
Refines titanium with oil turning it into plastanium

[I] - Plastanium: Used for advanced defenses

  • Produces plastanium
  • Explosive
  • Requires power
  • Long crafting proccess

docs.title: Pressure
docs.text:
Charges up an EMP

EMP burns targets and repairs allied structures

  • AOE
  • Heals small amount
  • Melts enemy target
  • Requires Power
  • Explosive

docs.title: Regen Barracade
docs.text:
Acts similar to an insulated wall. Able to absorb lasers but cant absorb eletric arcs.

  • Regenerates health slowly

  • More durable then insulated wall

  • Cant absorb eletric arcs
  • Could be nullified

docs.title: Reinforced Structure
docs.text:
Upon taking damage a small portion of the damage will heal the surrounding walls (including itself)

  • Doesnt need power
  • Could resist being suppressed
  • Heals are lower when suppressed
  • Takes increased damage

docs.title: Sealent Chamber
docs.text:
Seals liquids into capsules in packs. Capsules could then be transported and released.

  • Could contain more volatile liquids
  • Explosive

docs.title: Deviate
docs.text:
Shoots focused beams of power.

  • Anti-IFrame
  • High damage output
  • Requires power to operate
  • Water is required to operate

docs.title: Geothermal Turbine
docs.text:
Alternative to steam turbine. Could be placed on hot rocks to produce power.

  • Pumps oil from heated oil tiles(15/sec)

  • Produces power off of hot rocks

  • Explosive
  • Requires both surge and oxide tech

docs.title: Power Grid
docs.text:
A short-range outpost, Able to link to other blocks beside itself.

  • Stores abit of power
  • Explosive
  • Explodes if damaged while over netIn

docs.title: Surge Furnace
docs.text:
Smelts surge alloy by combining different minerals

Water is used to cool the furnace

[I] - Surge Alloy: Used for advanced power technology

  • Smelts surge-alloy
  • Explosive
  • Needs power
  • Needs water

docs.title: Surge Pile
docs.text:
Extremely destructive pile of surge alloy. Stores large amounts of power.

  • When attacked: Released lightning arcs

  • 1x1

  • Explodes into damaging lightning arcs

docs.title: Piston
docs.text:
Pushes blocks away from it's face. can push multiple blocks.

  • Doesn't need power
  • Explosive

docs.title: Melting Port
docs.text: Melts a varity of metals into liquids. Clicking on this building will change it's recipe.

docs.title: Dummy
docs.text:
A wall to release your anger on, Very primitive.

Click to change teams

docs.title: Embankment Formation
docs.text: Nearly indestructable barrier could be broken by destroying it's Embankment Seal

docs.title: Objective Core
docs.text: Core used outside of attack mode for other objectives like on production site

docs.title: Heat Circulator
docs.text: Uses steam to up it's surroundings. Used to cancel the effects of Solstice.

docs.title: Mechanical Pad
docs.text: Fabricates a unit with the required resources.

docs.title: Pod: Receiver
docs.text:
Uses a medium amount of water to receive a number of items

A horribly inefficient why to get resources

  • Receive a number of items
  • Anywhere on the map
  • Extremely explosive
  • Requires power
  • Requires water

docs.title: The Stem
docs.text:
One of his. A deity in sense of the word. To kill one of his kind is a great treachery.

Warning: - Could ruin the map beyond recovery. - Turrets perceive it as an enemy. Be wary of placing your defenses.

docs.title: Circuit Splitter
docs.text:
Splits the circuit pulse into multiple directions

the split pulses also has a shared travel distance

docs.title: Circuit Timer
docs.text:
Waits for a set time(In sec)

But can't be under circuit rate

docs.title: Circuit Wire
docs.text:
Used to transport power or circuit pulses. stores a small amount of power.

[I] - Circuit Heating: Triggered when the same circuit pulse travelled to a block it already travelled to once before.

  • Very cheap
  • Non-solid
  • Takes damage from circuit heating
  • Takes more damage
  • Slightly explosive

docs.title: Explosive Barrel
docs.text:
when this building is destroyed, it causes an explosion.

Will automatically explode after a short while after be placed.

Will mine ores and put them into a nearby storage within the outer ring.

  • Mines ore depots
  • Explosive
  • Explosive damages allied structure

docs.title: Copper Fort
docs.text:
Priority: 2.5

Generates a forcefield in a small area, Long cooldown time.

  • Explosive
  • Quick build

docs.title: Core: Facility
docs.text:
A more durable core foundation

  • Drone: Restoration

  • Durable

  • More storage
  • 4x4

docs.title: Core: Gateway
docs.text:
Build a compacted core. This core is very destructive and doesnt increase Item Capacity.

  • Small
  • Placable Anywhere
  • Could be upgraded
  • Could be quick travelled to (via clicking on it)
  • Very Explosive
  • Requires power to calibrate
  • There may only be a limit of 2 on the map at all times

docs.title: Core: Outpost
docs.text:
A larger, Far more durable core Able to store far more items

Once destroyed the sector is losted

docs.title: Core: Satellite
docs.text:
A simple thruster carried structure Holds a mediocre amount of items

Able to fabricate a unit to mine and build structures

Once all cores are destroyed the sector will be losted

docs.title: Core: Stronghold
docs.text:
A more durable core foundation

  • Drone: Atlas

  • Much more durable

  • Has much more storage space
  • 6x6

docs.title: Crate
docs.text:
Stores items, unloadable with an output port.

  • Expands core capacity
  • Explosive
  • Flammable

docs.title: Dihydrogen Shaft
docs.text:
Bores out water from asteroids.

[I] - Water could be used as coolant for turret and is required in certain production procceses.

Priority: 1.5

  • Bore out water
  • Requires power
  • Requires graphite

docs.title: Eluminate Bastion
docs.text:
Constructs eluminates to rebuild and assist the player.

  • Limit 2 (per building)
  • Requires power
  • Eluminates help rebuild

docs.title: Fusion Dome
docs.text:
Very durable defensive barrier, able to reliably tank constant damage.

  • High shield durability
  • Requires heavy powering
  • Extremely explosive

docs.title: Hydro Drill
docs.text:
Drills the ground for any possible extract.

  • Explosive
  • Reliable
  • Cheap

docs.title: Insulated Wall
docs.text: The classic. Protects from enemy projectiles and can also stop lasers and eletric bullets.

docs.title: Launch Silo
docs.text:
Launches flaks of bullets in all direction, Could also shoot manually by being clicked.

  • Omni Directional
  • Anti IFrame
  • Could be manually operated
  • Bullets at mid-range are homing
  • Range is smaller than bullet travel distance
  • Consumes alot of ammo
  • Explosive
  • Consumes Power

docs.title: Mend Pylon
docs.text:
A mending dome.

  • Mending range is square
  • Reliable
  • Requires power

docs.title: Oil Centrifuge
docs.text:
Absorbs ground oil. Oil is hardened in to coal and crushed. the water is then used during the cooling proccess.

  • Converts oil into graphite
  • Water is required
  • Explosive

docs.title: Outpost
docs.text:
Transfer power from one outpost to another.

  • Large radius
  • Cant be reconfigured
  • Same type connection only
  • Explosive

docs.title: Power Cell
docs.text:
Behaves as a battery. what you expect?

  • Durable
  • Releases lightning arcs upon damage
  • Could be manually activated via circuit logic

  • Consumes power to produce a lightning arc

  • Damage is proportional to damage taken

  • battery drain ratio damage to drain [1 : 1.75]

  • Lighting is team colored

docs.title: Rail
docs.text:
Transports items in stacks, Outputs like a router.

  • Is a Stack Belt
  • Outputs like a router

docs.title: Sand Strate
docs.text: Scrapes sand particles from the ground, if there is any.

docs.title: Scraping Rig
docs.text:
Extracts scrap metal from unit wrecks.

[i] - Scrap Metal: Poor metal, could be melted down into other metals.

docs.title: Sealent Capsule
docs.text: Seals liquids into capsules. Capsules could then be transported and released.

docs.title: Signal Detector
docs.text: Outputs the spread distance of a Circuit pulse

docs.title: Sunder Furnace
docs.text:
Priority: 5

Huge Smelting furnace, Able to smelt both metaglass and silicon at the same time.

docs.title: Tension
docs.text: Fires multiple homing missiles the the target.

docs.title: Titanium Barracade
docs.text:
Basic barracade isnt insulative nor does it block lasers

Serves as a cheap replacement for insulated walls

docs.title: Ton Crusher
docs.text:
A more advanced mineral drill, Can now be used to bore up beryllium and titanium.

  • Can drill titanium and beryllium
  • Could be disabled by being tapped on
  • Receives more damage when active
  • Requires power
  • Highly Explosive

docs.title: Trident
docs.text:
Costly turret, Able fire high-velocity rounds. Does enough base damage to ignore basic [IFrame] and could use multiple ammoTypes.

  • Fast bullet speed
  • Quite inaccurate

  • Explosive

  • Could ignore IFrame

  • Inflict melting

docs.title: Watt Reactor
docs.text:
Generates power by burning graphite. A variety of coolants could be used.

  • Not expensive
  • Low maintance
  • Extremely explosive
  • Requires active cooling

docs.title: Command Block
docs.text: Simple panel allowing the use of Command presets.

docs.title: Observer
docs.text: Sends out a circuit pulse when a building is built or destroyed behind it

docs.title: Signal
docs.text:
When pressed a circuit pulse is sent out

The circuit will fade after travelling too far

  • Explosive

docs.title: Incineration Rig
docs.text:
Incinerates items rapidly Produces slag as a byproduct

Cant melt any items that are unflammable

  • Incinerates items
  • produces slag
  • Explosive
  • Cant incinerate items with flammability lower then 0
  • requires power

docs.title: Fabricator
docs.text: Fabricates a chosen unit or a 1x1 block and destroys itself.

docs.title: Fissure Alamgam
docs.text:
Drains the hardened carbon from the wall behind it. And mixes it with silicon.

[i] - Outputted blocks are used for payload purposes.

  • Produces packed carbon: Carbon related
  • Produces packed beryllium: Beryllic and stone
  • Doesn't require power
  • Needs a required tile behind it
  • Explosive

docs.title: Freight Assembler
docs.text:
Constructs blocks using there requirements

Payloads are constructed at 50% speed

  • Constructs payload
  • Explosive
  • Constructs at 50% speed

docs.title: Tinted Oil Capsule
docs.text: Like a regular oil capsule but more durable less prone to exploding.

docs.title: Tinted Slag Capsule
docs.text: More durable capsule. Used to store molten slag.

docs.title: Depleted Thorium
docs.text: A far-less radioactive thorium Used in durable structures

docs.title: Steam
docs.text: Condensed water, Hot. Used for defrosting purposes and as a heating solution.

docs.title: Overdrive Fluid
docs.text:
Fluids with phase bound properties. Has accelerated heating properties.

Used to overdrive certain blocks. Prominently used for overdrive healing.

Extremely explosive

docs.title: Fragmented
docs.text:
Within the territory of the enemy. The exogens are located on this planet. Start gathering resources to move on.

Beating unlocks: - Dedrone Modifier - Delisted Modifier - Reinforced Modifier - Second lore chip

docs.title: Intercept
docs.text:
A nearby enemy base is present. Silicon tech is usable here.

Prepare defenses for the holdout.

docs.title: Production Site
docs.text:
No threats within this sector

Congrats you been hired! For further instructions launch to the sector

docs.title: Radiance
docs.text: A mining quarry located not far from the surface

docs.title: Trench
docs.text: This sector receives very little light. There multiple closed off sections of ore deposits.

docs.title: Dedroned
docs.text:
Drone facility and Facility dropzone will no longer be usable

Requirements: - Activated only on wave 1

docs.title: Delisted
docs.text:
Outpost is disabled

Requirements: - Activated only on wave 1

docs.title: Modifiers
docs.text: Modifiers to change how gier plays. May only be activated on wave one. Research on gier to active.

docs.title: Reinforced
docs.text:
Enemies gain 1.45x durability.

Requirements: - Activated only on wave 1

docs.title: Ash
docs.text:
A fast durable and very dangerous unit.

Priority: 3.5 IFrame Duration: 0.2 sec IFrame Damage Threshold: 10-75 Enrages: 50%

Counter: A very dangerous assault unit push back or fatally damage it.

Affiliation: BGP, SBDC, PTC - Epsilon

docs.title: Barracade
docs.text:
Whenever this unit takes damage it becomes invincible for a short duration.

Priority: 5 IFrame Duration: 0.416 sec Damage Threshold: (10-65)

  • Big hitbox
  • Cannot be retriggered while invincible
  • Cant be triggered by explosions

Hard counter: Since this unit is high priority using [Tensions] can knock it away. - Avoid letting it tank damage for other units.

Affiliations: SBDC, PTC - Epsilon

docs.title: Drive
docs.text:
Directive Research Informer Vehicle (model:)Epsilon

Primary research and combat vehicle usable in low-medium depth regions of there planet.

Hard counter: High firepower

Affiliations: BGP, PTC - Epsilon

docs.title: Abalone
docs.text:
Quite durable but has a short range

Is able to shoot sharp shrapnel using it's fuse cannon.

And is enragable.

Counter: Knock-back, Insulation

docs.title: Atlas
docs.text: Much better drone for general purpose. Can repair nearby blocks, Has bigger damage detection range, can carry payloads and has IFrame.

docs.title: Cruelty
docs.text:
A long-range snowballer tank. Able quickly shred through basic barriers and poccesses very high durability.

Counter: - Destroy them quickly - Avoid pushing them back - They take are weaker than firing

docs.title: Crusader
docs.text:
Extremely dangerous threat. a lightly armored assault vehicle.

Able to rapidly fire shells forward Drops bombs below it and can call in an Ash as reinforcement

docs.title: Fleet
docs.text:
Very fragile. Self duplicating assault units.

docs.title: Crawler «Tortuga»
docs.text: Assault. Designed to breach heavily fortified enemy positions and eliminate high-value/large-scale targets.

docs.title: Crawler «Tortuga»
docs.text: Support. Heavy shock shield-bearer, designed to breach fortified enemy positions. Sacrifices allied mobility for tactical advantage, drawing all defensive fire onto itself. Equipped with a plasma coil for precision threat elimination.

docs.title: Dagger «Hunter»
docs.text: Assault, scouting and support. Designed to pursue and destroy fast and maneuverable targets, but can also be used when capturing an enemy fort.

docs.title: Dagger «Commander»
docs.text: Assault and support. Field commander of the «Dagger» version. Designed to reinforce the squad and maintain the morale of assault units on the battlefield.

docs.title: Fortress «Destroyer»
docs.text:
Assault and support. These heavily armed, piloted mechs are a devastating force on the battlefield. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, they are designed to breach defenses, annihilate armored vehicles, and storm fortified positions. But their role isn’t limited to offense—thanks to their reinforced armor and energy shields, they can also serve as a living bulwark, shielding allies under heavy fire.

The ultimate war machine: crushing enemies in attack, enduring punishment in defense.

docs.title: Fortress «Devastator»
docs.text: Assault and support. «Devastator» are rarely seen in action, but are usually used when capturing and besieging well-fortified outposts, and when eliminating a large group consisting mostly of assault units.

docs.title: Locus «Vepr»
docs.text:
Assault and support. High-Speed Heavy Assault Transport - a perfect instrument for lightning-fast strikes against fortified positions. Its mobility allows it to either smash through defenses head-on or flank enemy strongholds, while volley rockets pummel targets from a safe distance.

The ultimate war machine: Speed for sudden strikes, firepower for sieges.

docs.title: Locus «Hammer»
docs.text: Assault and support. Designated siege breaker for neutralizing fortified positions and defensive emplacements. Optimized for sustained bombardment of static targets at medium-to-long range

docs.title: Mace «Stormtrooper»
docs.text: Assault and support. Designed for rapid suppression of the enemy under heavy fire.

docs.title: Mace «Grenadier»
docs.text: Assault and support. Used by assault teams to blockade enemy fortifications and support attacking forces.

docs.title: Nova «Shadow»
docs.text: Scouting and support. «Shadow» - the ghost operative who erases strategic targets from existence. His rounds find their mark across vast distances, and when the enemy realizes they're under attack, the shooter has already faded into the wind. Melee encounters are avoided at all costs, with nothing but a feeble shock pistol for truly hopeless last stands.

docs.title: Nova «Stalker»
docs.text: Assault, scouting and support. The perfect weapon for ambushes. A single «Stalker» can silently eliminate an entire squad, leaving only silence behind.

docs.title: Scepter «Mastermind»
docs.text: Assault and support. «Mastermind» - class units (or «Field Commanders») are rare, elite combatants deployed only in critical engagements where the battle's tide must be turned. These towering war machines don't just crush enemies - they rewrite the rules of combat, demoralizing foes and inspiring allies with their sheer presence.

docs.title: Stell «Dawn»
docs.text: Support. A siege tank equipped with an artillery cannon is designed to attack small and medium-sized fortified outposts.

docs.title: Stell «Tesla»
docs.text: Assault and support. The Assault Tank, equipped with a discharger, is used to quickly intercept enemy bases and forts.

docs.title: Channel Director
docs.text:
Restricts the flow of fluids from its input to output by half.

Can detonate Channel Nodes full of Aspect. Transports at 50% pressure.

Will chain destruct!

docs.title: Channel Face
docs.text: Acts as a fluid junction. Transmits fluid without storing it. No risk of explosion.

docs.title: Channel Hub
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side.

Stores 100 nodes worth of fluid.

docs.title: Channel Node
docs.text: Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side. Stores a small amount of fluid.

docs.title: Compartmentalized Node
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side.

Separately stores Nectar, Mercury, Blood and Ooze. When supplied Debris while full with all four fluids, slowly voids its contents.

docs.title: Displacement Pump
docs.text:
Dumps Debris into fluids to retrive a steady supply of fluid indefinitely. Requires Aspect to run.

Plated

docs.title: Filtration Unit
docs.text:
Acts as a filter. Outputs Mercury to any side.

When powered with Aspect while containing Mercury, filters out Debris and Starving masses from Blood and Nectar, producing some Mercury in the process.

Halts when fully pressurized with Mercury!

docs.title: Neutralization Chamber
docs.text:
Uses Mercury and Elderflesh to soak up Blood, producing miniscule amounts of power in the process. Acts as a fluid router for Blood.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Blood!

docs.title: Pipeline Crossing
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid junction.

docs.title: Pipeline Overpass
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a bridge

docs.title: Pipeline Router
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid router..

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a pipe.

docs.title: Conductive Pile
docs.text:
It's a pile of electrum coils which is conductive. Go figure what you can use this for.

And I guess it stores a tiny bit of power

...Squishi? (80)

docs.title: Connector
docs.text:
Projects lasers which share power between the node and its target.

Plated

docs.title: Discharge Outlet (PS)
docs.text:
Crushes Dissonitre and focuses the resulting Aether into Aspect efficiently using resonarum lenses, producing some power in the process.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Aspect!

Placeholder Sprite!

docs.title: Glass Burner (PS)
docs.text:
Burns Dissonitre based material with bits of Riplom stabalized with Rift, producing minute amounts of power.

Paceholder sprite!

docs.title: Powerbank
docs.text: Stores large amounts of power and releases it in times of defict.

docs.title: Purification Chamber
docs.text:
Blasts Starving Masses over high heat decomposing them into Blood, producing some power in the proceess.

Requires Mercury and Aspect to run.

Explodes when fully pressurized with Blood!

docs.title: Substation
docs.text:
Projects lasers which share power between the station and its target. Stores power in an internal buffer.

Plated!

docs.title: Thermo matting (PS)
docs.text:
Passively obtains power from meld digestion over Ichor sources, extracting some Ichor in the process.

PLACEHOLDER SPRITE

docs.title: Access Point
docs.text: Plugs into an Encrypter to power it.

docs.title: Crystal Cracker
docs.text: Breaks open Dissonitre crystals over aspect soil as a source of Aether.

docs.title: Earthen Grinder
docs.text: Crushes up earthen stone and mixes it with Nectar & Rift to make Stony Gloop.

docs.title: Elemental Blaster
docs.text:
Blasts deposits for items indefinitely. Requires Aspect to run.

Can be boosted with Meld to double harvesting speed.

docs.title: Elemental Sampler
docs.text:
Samples deposits for items indefinitely. Requires Aspect and Rift to run.

Can be boosted with Warp to double harvesting speed.

More efficient against soft tissue

docs.title: Filtrative Feeder
docs.text:
Processes batches of Ichor over meld floors, aquiring some Meld and pieces of Debris each batch processed.

Requires a tiny trickle of power.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Flarestack Filter
docs.text:
Harvests Rift from suitable sources by neutralizing the impurities from the air.

Requires Resonarum and Riplom to run.

docs.title: Sap Extractor
docs.text: Extracts Nectar from suitable sources. Needs to be attached to a Mangrove Heart or a Nectar Fissure over Nectar or Mercury floors.

docs.title: Siphon
docs.text:
Pumps Mercury fluid deposits at half pressure. Uses Compacted Bricks/Stony Gloop to repair stability.

Stability is limited and deposits will break open if exhausted!

Deposit repairing is a WIP and will only be added if there's enough of a need.

docs.title: Techno Dredger
docs.text: Collects massive amounts of lose pieces of technoscrap. Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Vitric Stimu1ator
docs.text:
Harvests Rift from suitable sources using Vitric Meshes to filter the air, producing a substantial amount of glass waste.

Requires Power to run.

docs.title: Downpour
docs.text: Barages ground targets with 30 Mercury-filled Silver thorns each burst. Slow reload speed. High burst damage and armor piercing. Inflicts Mercury Poisoning!

docs.title: Drill Turret
docs.text: Focuses Aspect into an armor piercing beam.

docs.title: Flurry
docs.text:
Charges and flings canisters of sticky Carbolith dust which spark on a delay. High damage vs force projectors

Warning: Putting hard matterials with sludge in will clog the machinery!

Armored!

docs.title: Grandeur
docs.text:
Flings a compacted ball of material at targets. over long distances Small amounts of armor piercing on hit

Effects vary based on ammo type

docs.title: Meld Cannon
docs.text: Lobs clusters of highly compressed Aether at enemies.

docs.title: Meld Spewer
docs.text: Sprays focused jets of Ichor toward targets doing huge focused knockback, healing any allied building in the way.

docs.title: Molotov
docs.text: Launches an Aspect-filled Silver shell at ground targets over long distances. High armor piercing damage on impact. Doubles the damage armoured units take!

docs.title: Scorcher Nest
docs.text: Crystalizes a scorcher crystal, which fuels 4 indipendantly targeted jets of flame. Bursts open into numerous Scorchers on destruction.

docs.title: Shredstorm
docs.text:
Sprays shrapnel at enemy targets with slight piercing. Spread is focused towards the aim direction

Effects vary based on ammo type

docs.title: Sunder
docs.text: Fires clumps of Debris flak at enemy targets. High damage versus flying targets

docs.title: Tantrum
docs.text: Compacts and puffs out clouds of Rift using a Silver piston, dealing heavy knockback. Reduces target's drag

docs.title: Tracker Encampment
docs.text:
Launches off larvel missiles which do bonus damage on direct hit. Dislodges from its base when destroyed.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Vivalo
docs.text:
Atomizes and fires a jet of crystalline particles which pierce armor.

Quick rotation speed and increased coolant effectiveness.

Effects vary based on ammo type, ranging from Laceration to Shattering

docs.title: Vivisection
docs.text: Assembles and launches Resonarum sawblades. Lacerates targets without armor

docs.title: Astrea Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Astrea units using Debris and Electrum.

Requires a sizeable amount of Aspect and Mercury to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Craig Incubator
docs.text:
Forms a metalic shell around larvae trios in an Ichor environment to form Craig constructs. The residual stone is formed into an Afraig with each batch. Bursts open into several Craigs and Afraigs when destroyed.

Lightly Armored

docs.title: Gilla Incubator
docs.text: Entombs pairs of larvae in crystal inside Aether environment to form Gilla constructs. Bursts open into a Gilla and a pair of Killas when destroyed.

docs.title: Hammerhead Bioforge
docs.text:
Rapidly Gestates Hammerhead units using Debris, Riplom and Resonarum.

Requires a sizeable amount of Rift and a trickle of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Jilla Incubator
docs.text: Entombs pairs of larvae in crystal inside Aether environment to form Jilla constructs. Bursts open into a Gilla and a pair of Killas when destroyed.

docs.title: Narwhal Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Narwhal units using Carbolith, Compacted Bricks and Stony Gloop.

Requires a sizeable amount of Aspect and Ichor to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

Lightly Armored

docs.title: Remora Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Remora units using Debris, Electrum and Vitric Mesh.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Shark Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Shark units using Silver and Carbolith.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Abberation Core
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain Liquid Data slources.

docs.title: Astral Fulgurite
docs.text: Refineable for a slew of glassy materials.

docs.title: Bioscrap Graft
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain regenerative appliences.

docs.title: Blossoming Elderflesh
docs.text: Puffballs of fine biological grains and slits intertwined with larger strands. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Bramble Vine
docs.text: Thick biological strands coursing with Mercury. Contains trace amounts of Ooze

docs.title: Carbolith
docs.text: Used for structural support and as a fuel source.

docs.title: Clay-Mallow
docs.text: Clay from the Badlands. Easly moulded to form containers, but difficult to aquire by blasting soil.

docs.title: Coagulated Vigor
docs.text: An eternally burning daemon's flesh, constantly in a cancerous state. One must imagine Icarus happy. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Compacted Bricks
docs.text: Used as a form of concrete for building foundations and power infastructure alongside Stony Gloop and Electrum Sheets.

docs.title: Compacted Masses
docs.text: Cluster of biological material wrapped with Bramble Vines.

docs.title: Debris
docs.text: Used in many kinds of constructs on Ikaru. Refineable.

docs.title: Dissonitre
docs.text: Rare alternative source of Aether sourced from the Storm Planes and Badlands. Somewhat unstable.

docs.title: Elderflesh
docs.text: Twisted biological strands coursing with Nectar. Constitutes the flora of the Mercury Swamps.

docs.title: Electrum Sheet
docs.text: Refined material used in power transmission and advanced unit production.

docs.title: Elnar Dust
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to conduct aspect.

docs.title: Fragment
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in advanced unit production.

docs.title: Grating Chunk
docs.text: No apparent use found. Panneling for the floors of the facilities which dot Ikaru.

docs.title: Grazing Bar
docs.text: A bar of highly compacted dehydrated flora with a Nectar center. Fragments easly with a loud cracking sound, but soft on the inside.

docs.title: Homunculus Chunk
docs.text: Chunks of... something? Not quite human. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Industrial Rubble (Cracked)
docs.text: Refinable for a slew of essential materials.

docs.title: Industrial Rubble
docs.text: Lucrative source of essential materials when cracked. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Larva
docs.text: Writhing metalic hunk with segments. Often seen in incubation structures that manufacture new constructs.

docs.title: Larval Plating
docs.text: Some sort of juvinile plating piece. No uses found.

docs.title: Meld Shard
docs.text: Vague lifeform in crystal form. Use unknown.

docs.title: Memory Shard
docs.text: Used to defragment the database to unlock new technology, and in certain Liquid Data sources.

docs.title: Metalic Chunk
docs.text: Some sort of metalalic hunk. No uses found. Edible to the Meld.

docs.title: Metalic Globule
docs.text: Some sort of metalalic blob. No uses found.

docs.title: Resonarum
docs.text: Used in high-energy Aspect appliences such as Nullifiers.

docs.title: Riploko
docs.text: Riplom which has been infused with Aspect. Ready to explode!

docs.title: Riplom
docs.text: Shale from the Storm Planes. A great flux for glasswork, though not much practical use found. Slightly volatile.

docs.title: Shiny Globule
docs.text: Melted remains of glass hardened into shiny globules. Best disposed of safely, or recycled.

docs.title: Silver
docs.text: Used in electrical components and structures. Integral part in most basic units.

docs.title: Starving Masses
docs.text: Shriveled up cluster of biological material. Acts as a great filtratium medium. The texture's quite dry.

docs.title: Stony Gloop
docs.text: Used as a motar for building foundations and power infastructure alongside Compacted Bricks and Electrum Sheets.

docs.title: Stormstruck Shell
docs.text: A crystalline weave of Dissonitre around a polished Resonarum clump. Highly unstable...

docs.title: Technoscrap
docs.text: Used in advanced storage logistics and basic Core blocks.

docs.title: Tenbris
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to insulate aspect when refined.

docs.title: Vitric Mesh
docs.text: An intricate piece of glasswork which captures Aether when stimulated with power, building on itself.

docs.title: Aether
docs.text: Passively collected by certain structures. Found in abundance from aether vents.

docs.title: Ichor
docs.text: Major food source for the Meld. Fuels Meld construct birthing and a major component in sustainable power systems/mass-produced infastructure.

docs.title: Liquid Data
docs.text: Fluid form of data pulled from technoscrap and other related materials.

docs.title: Meld
docs.text: Slowly disolves most metals and organics, save for a group of materials.

docs.title: Mercury
docs.text: Used as lubricant. Acts as a potent toxin inside creatures of Meld origin.

docs.title: Nectar
docs.text: Used as a potent coolant. Can be refined into Mercury over high heat with the right reagents. Encourages a slight mending effect on units.

docs.title: Null
docs.text: Byproduct of technoscrap cracking. Often vanishes without a trace.

docs.title: Ooze
docs.text: No apparent use found. Cold to the touch.

docs.title: Rift
docs.text: Refinable into Warp. Released from Aether fused with Carbolith under high heat.

docs.title: Warp
docs.text:
Used in utility buildings as fuel and in higher tier unit construction.

Highly unstable

docs.title: Ikaru
docs.text:
A wartorn planet with scraps of usable unrefined resources. Inhabited by the Meld.

Heavy fog lingers everywhere.

docs.title: Creek
docs.text:
Incursion point for Ikaru. Practise basic production and ways to push into enemy teritory.

Objective: Attack Weather: Drizzle

docs.title: Dead End?
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. A new data point is encrypted inside a nearby facility, but the keys are in other locations.

Come back when either Hedge or Shear have been completed!

Objective: Explore Weather: None

-Carbolith depleted

docs.title: Hedge
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Aerial threats will come from the north. Use Sunder turrets to counter them.

Objective: Survive Weather: Foggy

-Carbolith depleted -3 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

docs.title: Remenant
docs.text:
Datamine!

Abandoned and entombed with crystaline megaliths.

Huge swarms of flying and artillery constructs have been recorded, along with an unknown eradication tier threat.

Dredge and process as many research materials as you can, untill the waves overwhelm you.

There is no Resonarum in this sector. Nullifiers inaccesable!

Objective: Dredge

-Resonarum depleted -2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Spawning pools spotted!

docs.title: Scrapyard
docs.text:
Filled with Debris and Silver, but lacking in Carbolith. Deploy new infusion technology.

The landing area is resource deprived, be ready to attack!

Objective: Survive Weather: Hazy

-Carbolith depleted

-1 Meld Amplifier spotted!

docs.title: Shear
docs.text:
Scrapyard leaves no further routes to explore Ikaru. Backtracking from Creek is the only way fowards. The branching path ahead will further provoke the Meld.

Meld attacks will switch sides after every burst, starting from the west front.

Friendly signals have been detected... be ready for anything!

Objective: ??? Weather: Australian

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted!

docs.title: Slumber
docs.text:
This planet hasn't solidified yet...

You've done well to make it this far.

Objective: ??? Weather: ???

docs.title: Tempest in a Teacup
docs.text:
Another Strata instance has already setup a base here, and moved on.

Harsh weather had been observed in response to activity, so the base lies dormant in a divot.

Ensure you don't get overwhelmed by the heavy storms, and keep your units repaired.

Objective: Weather the storm Weather: Clear, then Torrential, then Clear

-2 Meld Amplifiers spotted! -Quick Start!

docs.title: Aspect Burn
docs.text: Doubles damage taken, does a tiny bit of DoT. Applied by Aspect-based weaponary in conjunction with burning. Only affects mechanical and armored targets.

docs.title: Aspect Channeling
docs.text:
Details about how to contain and channel Aspect into a variety of uses like Sonar Pings, self regeneration and even NULLIFICATION.

Contains some schematics for buildings which use Silver & Resonarum to achieve this, but the rest are scattered through other entries...

docs.title: Carbonic Barrens
docs.text:
This data point appears to mark the entrance to a large expanse of carbon stone.

There is a heavy pink fog in the area lowering visibility dramatically, though there appears to be plentiful carbolith deposits scattered throughout.

docs.title: Blackout
docs.text: Fade to nothing. Applied by the Backdrop

docs.title: Building Foundations
docs.text:
For too long structures have been made with Debris and Carbolith as foundations, only using refined materials for moving parts...

With new data about Ichor's properties, and observations about how Meld constructs form their shells, a new way to industrially cement Carbolith dust into mock Carbon Stone has been prototyped and is ready to deploy.

Brick Conglomerators and Earthen Crushers produce the bricks and motar for building foundations with a variety of materials and deposits, allowing certain buildings to take on some natural armor and be built far quicker.

Boulders are a good source of Bricks/Gloop and will return some when deconstructed.

docs.title: Crude Crackers
docs.text:
Schematics taking advantage of the badland's catalytic features.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: Dissolving
docs.text: Small bit of DoT and doubles damage taken. Applied by Meld Beacons.

docs.title: Fissure Tapping
docs.text:
Schematics for buildings which can utalize Ikaru's various crevices like Vents, Fissures and Growths.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: Fluid Extraction
docs.text: Filtration methods inspired off Blossoming Elderflesh give way to means of directly obtaining fluids from surface deposits with varying expirimental methods.

docs.title: Glacier's Edge
docs.text:
This data point leads to a giant formation of crystalline megaliths.

The fog isn't as thick here, allowing full vission of the terrain.

Conversely, there seem to be trace amounts of resources available, though many friendly signals pop up within the datapoint's bounds.

docs.title: Item Logistics
docs.text:
Schematics for a basic item distribution system and an Item source.

This system is comprised of a system of Chute components which route items from place to place.

docs.title: Lacerated
docs.text:
Heavly reduced mobility and fireate. Increases durability slightly and encourages light regeneration.

Applied by Resonarum related sources. No effect on armored meld or inorganic targets.

docs.title: Liquid Logistics
docs.text:
Schematics for a basic liquid distribution network and an Aether source. The network is comprised of four components.

-Channel Nodes which form the corners and outlets of the network -Channel Faces which connect parts of the network. -Channel Directors which control the direction and pressure of fluids -Aspect Outlets which serve as the endpoint for Aether networks.

Channels can be walked on freely and are stable enough to be placed on deep patches of liquid. The Backdrop will not support Channels.

docs.title: Lonely Creek
docs.text:
This data point leads toward a secluded creek woven between monolithic rock formations.

There are hundreds, maybe thousands of heat signatures in the distance, none of which are recognisable through the fog.

What is this place?

docs.title: Refreshed
docs.text: Doubles reload speed and slightly reduces damage taken. Invokes slight regeneration.

docs.title: Infested
docs.text:
Hefty amount of DoT an' damage taken and dealt is magnified. Doubles... reload speed?

What applies this again? I don't know, but we've got to ru-

docs.title: Mercury Poisoning
docs.text: Extremely deadly to critters of Meld origin. Effects unknown. TODO: Update this for Strata

docs.title: Mercury Coating
docs.text: Coating of Mercury. Fun! Hey don't eat that-

docs.title: Mercurial Extraction
docs.text:
A group of schematics, all revolving around one thing: Refining raw material into Mercury over geothermal spots.

Intrestingly, there is an outlier. The Electrum Amalgamator.

docs.title: Murk Handling
docs.text:
The Mercury Swamp has proven to be quite hostile in numerous ways, but bessides the outright hostile threats, there have been issues reguarding excess Starving Masses and fluid filtration...

Theese schematics detail a number of ways to handle this, ranging from Compartmentalized Nodes, Filtration Units, Neutralization/Purification Chambers.

Pressurized Dispersion would be helpful to control any accidents.

docs.title: Power Transmission
docs.text:
Schematics for buildings which use Electrum to focus power into lasers, allowing transmission without physical connection. This entry is comprised of three buildings.

-Connectors are a stock standard power node which use Stony Gloop & Compacted Bricks as compared to more abundant materials, allowing them to be built quickly. -Substations are able to both connect over longer distances (but to fewer targets) and store small amounts of power. -Continental Links are able to bridge large sections of the sector in a cardinal direction, and can withstand a large amount of damage.

More observation may be required to fully defragment this entry's buildings.

docs.title: Pressure Control
docs.text: Advanced means of pressure control involving large fluid hubs, pressurized directors, and fluid siphons.

docs.title: Pressurized Dispersion
docs.text:
Getting fluids from point A to B was previously only possible with Channels. Any attempts to shoot Fluids out into the world only created puddles.

With advances in Pressure Control combined with observations about the Mercury Swamp's flora, fluids can now be dispersed into the world with more control over longer distances.

Further advances in technology are required to bridge gaps inside Channel networks or to utalize solid atomized jets.

Murk Handling is greatly helpful to filter out fluids for use by Fluid Sprayers.

docs.title: Ruins
docs.text:
This data point marks the last known location of a Strata instance, and seems to branch out into an almost endless amount of sector groups.

As the campaign is a WIP right now, no sector groups are accessable yet!

docs.title: Shattered
docs.text:
Doubles damage taken and reload speed. Increases damage and mobility.

Applied by Dissonitre related sources. No effect on unarmored meld.

docs.title: Storage Hubs
docs.text:
Details about Buffers and Unloaders, thought to be lost to time.

Plans for massive storage warehouses are encrypted for now...

docs.title: Shellshocked
docs.text: Heavly reduced mobility and fireate. Applied by most sources of EMP.

docs.title: Storm Surge
docs.text: Increased mobility, damage and reload. Applied by most sources of EMP.

docs.title: Rally
docs.text: Increased mobility and reload. Applied by Commanders and Sonars.

docs.title: Primed
docs.text: Increased mobility, damage, reload. Heavly increased health. This unit's ready to go off!

docs.title: Anchored
docs.text: Heavly increased drag and health. Heavly decreased speed. Applied by Movement Anchors

docs.title: Rebound
docs.text: Heavly increased speed, slightly increased reload speed. Decreased drag. Applied by Movement Anchors

docs.title: Strata
docs.text: Utilises Ikaru's basic resources to great effect. This is you!

docs.title: Amplified
docs.text: Amplifies mobility, durability and reload. Applied by Meld Amplifiers.

docs.title: Reconstitution
docs.text: Increases durability and drag. Slightly decreases speed. Light regeneration. Applied by Meld Beacons. Certain constructs spawn with this. Only affects biological targets.

docs.title: Sentry
docs.text: Heavily reduced mobility, but double fireate. Does constant DoT. Certain constructs apply this upon shooting.

docs.title: Surge
docs.text: Massive boost in reload speed, but heavly decreased damage. Certain constructs can intiate a surge with a long cooldown.

docs.title: Dragonfly
docs.text: Revs up a needle launcher when hovering in place.

docs.title: Gala
docs.text: Small blob carrier Caries blobs to wherever they're needed. Sometimes the construct will sacrifice itself, crashing down from the skies to release its blobs on hostiles.

docs.title: Pester
docs.text: Small sprayer flier Blasts targets with a burst of flame. Requires time to recharge. Damages units and buildings caught under its wake.

docs.title: Spillway Core
docs.text:
Projectile construct While the core looks inconspicuous at first, two eye indents have been observed.

It is not certain if the core or the spillway controls the unit, but both burst into multiple constructs on destruction.

docs.title: Spillway
docs.text:
First form projectile carrier Birthed in its final form rather than being composed of multiple units, yet bursts open into Craigs and Wubbas..

Reffer to for more information on this construct's center.

docs.title: Tracker Projectile
docs.text: Projectile construct Construct is manufactured inside Tracker constructs and is directed towards its target through some unknown guidance mechanism.

docs.title: Zip
docs.text: Light spawner missile Spotted in swarms that flock between colonies. Beware the Jilla they cary.

docs.title: Afraig
docs.text:
First form bezerking scrap heap When splurging flame, the construct launches itself towards the direction of shooting. Beware Amplified Afraigs.

Armored

docs.title: Allegro
docs.text:
Guardian phalanx nest construct Construct comes with a localised storm projector organ which bursts a cloud of vaporous meld periodically.

Reconstitutes all constructs in range and dissolves nearby enemy units with its spewers, recoiling backwards to stick in front of a defensive perimeter.

FOCUS FIRE AND DESTROY ON SIGHT. DO NOT GET ENGAGE IN CLOSE COMBAT. YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED

docs.title: Astrea
docs.text: Launches armor-piercing spines at targets. Crawls over obstructions.

docs.title: Blob
docs.text:
Blob! A blob. What more is there to say?

Blob blob blob blob blob.

Blob!

It explodes after a delay, dealing massive damage. Don'y you remember what happened last time we got near one of tho-

docs.title: Braig
docs.text:
Second form artillery scrap heap The construct stays at range to shoot, while being armed with a Craig's blaster.

Acts as a small seige engine, able to take cover in Meld Capsules & Beacons.

docs.title: Bulwark
docs.text:
First form shielding fulgurian Construct has a small capsule construct encased in a layer of metal. I wonder how it's fueled...

Lightly armored & Mechanical!

docs.title: Craig
docs.text: First form scrap heap Low durability and an unstable weapon, but often comes in swarms.

docs.title: Enforcer
docs.text: Commander of squads during the incursion. Launches sprays of pellets towards targets and missiles with heavy knockback. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Fletch
docs.text: First form hovercraft mimic This construct appears to mimic Shark units? Im not sure what it's suposed to be other than that...

docs.title: Gilla
docs.text: Second form crystal bug Bulky form allows the construct to survive longer while spurting flame.

docs.title: Globkin
docs.text:
Guardian skirmisher nest construct

Construct jolts backwards after launching a blast of shrapnel from its cannons, containing several blobs that detonate if not dealt with.

Distract with moble units or drop overseer pings on it to prevent it from recoiling past defensive lines.

Plated!

docs.title: Graig
docs.text:
Megalith nest scrap heap? Observed to birth Craigs en-masse. Armored with multiple of Braig's and Craig's weapons, the construct can defend itself well.

Theorised to be a fragment off of a larger scrap heap.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Hammerhead (PS)
docs.text:
Launches piercing shards at enemies, making them take more knockback from other sources. Slowly regenerates from combat.

Can be affected by most helpful effects.

Biological!

PLACEHOLDER SPRITES

docs.title: Iguana
docs.text:
Commander of the Bunker core. Launches out sap vortexes which prime after a short delay. Rallies nearby allies. Quick omnidirectional movement.

Plated

docs.title: Impaler
docs.text:
Pierces targets with shrapnel blasts at short range. Deploys autoturrets from its thorax.

Plated

docs.title: Impovrished
docs.text:
Guardian battery nest construct Construct is an amalgamation of common combat scrap heaps.

Often hides behind other artillery units while using its cannons/snipers to provide fire support. Scatters miniturized Meld Capsules from its tip.

Construct is a dangerous source of attrophy, engage in flanking manuvours and DESTROY on identification.

Plated!

Biomechanical!

docs.title: Inator
docs.text:
First form skirmishing fulgarian Construct is the first observed which has no visible forms of Meld protrusions. Im not sure how it operates...

Fully mechanical!

docs.title: Jilla
docs.text: First form worm/crystal bug Stabalized crystal enables spurting flame indefinitely with no reprecussion.

docs.title: Kathid
docs.text:
First form nestling crystal bug Theories about how Meld forms colonies have circulated around since its discovery.

One theory is armored constructs like Kathids use their piercing flame to penetrate stone, like they do to metal. That woudn't account for the giant rock formations spotted around.

Armored

docs.title: Katika
docs.text:
First form hydra crystal bug Construct appears to be a malformed Kathid without a hardened shell with multiple heads, though there is little evidence to go off of.

Maybe an error in creation propagated by its usefulness?

Despite the appearence, the blob controlling the construct acts as one whole entity.

docs.title: Killa (Armored)
docs.text:
Second form crystal bug Observed to launch dissolving globules at hostile targets, being catapulted away from the threat.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Killa
docs.text: Second form boosting crystal bug Thrusters enable quick movement and resistance to being swept back by wind.

docs.title: Kithlid
docs.text:
Megalith nest crystal bug Construct has been observed constantly pumping out Jilla constructs in missile form when engaging threats.

Whilst Kithlid often turn quickly to face their targets, their ability to do so is hindered when charging up a barage of flame.

Ensure that all parts of a Kithlid are thoughroughly dealt with after breaching the construct's shell.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Narwhal
docs.text:
Launches short-ranged orbital strikes. Hovers over deep bodies of liquid. Charges an energy field channeled from its spike when moving quickly which bounces units away.

If only there was some way to launch them as missiles...

Plated

docs.title: Observer
docs.text: Commander of the Dormant Raft core. Fields a large build radius and Rallies nearby allies. Cannot mine resources, and comes with a reduced build speed.

docs.title: Omega
docs.text:
Commander of the Omega pad. Launches canisters of shrapnel and Rallies nearby allies.

Has a personal shield generator feeding into a force projector which gets faster at lower shield integrety. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Ontragga
docs.text:
Second form seige worm Construct creeps foward shielding numerous wuba inside from harm whilst sporting a heavy aether cannon which fires in three round bursts.

This construct is a high priority target and must be taken out before it breaches a defensive perimeter, DO NOT LET IT LEAK.

Plated!

Biomechanical!

docs.title: Outcast
docs.text: Old commander of the Bunker core. Drops whirling mines that sap health from targets hit.

docs.title: Phi
docs.text:
Commander of the Phi pad. Launches armor-piercing spines which release ooze foam upon hitting the ground, and Rallies nearby allies.

Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids, or with enough time.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Pointago
docs.text:
Second form incubating scrap heap Construct stays at range after shooting, but will often run fowards afterwards.

Observed to cary an incubator that can form crystals, which the heap consumes for a burst of energy.

docs.title: Poisag
docs.text:
Second form shielding scrap heap Observed launching miniturized Meld Capsules, deploying on hit/near to units.

Dangerous when combined with constructs that can effectively use the protection, or when ammo is limited.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Psi
docs.text:
Commander of the Psi pad. Charges up and fires beams of Aspect, doing devistating damage, and Rallies nearby allies.

Has a personal shield generator which gets faster at lower shield integrety. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Purifier
docs.text: Drills through enemy structures and units alike. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids.

docs.title: Remora
docs.text: Launches homing spears which sap target's health, pulling targets further back after traveling a certain distance.

docs.title: Scorcher
docs.text: Small swarmling crystal bug Construct observed to take constant damage while spurting its flame.

docs.title: Shark
docs.text: Launches missiles which sap target's health. Hovers over deep bodies of liquid. An excellent scout. Struggles against force fields.

docs.title: Splurger
docs.text:
Tiny shelled blob They gave the dam blobs armor, why the hell would you give it armor?

If this is some sort of prank like last time I swear ill-

Plated!

docs.title: Stoner
docs.text:
Bulky incindary artillery fulgurian

Construct needs to steady itself in place before unsheathing its weapon. I can't tell if it's impressive that it works or if it's concerning that it has a giant chunk of Dissonitre embedded into it.

Fully mechanical!

docs.title: Time Keeper
docs.text:
Lacerates targets with a spray of particulate resonarum. Slowly regenerates health over time.

Lightly armored

docs.title: Tracker
docs.text:
First form artillery support primitive scrap heap

Construct appears to be a mobile form of an incubator, who's sole purpose is to form projectiles and guide them towards targets.

docs.title: Uwubba
docs.text:
First form kamekaze worm A wuba encased in a stony shell, not too different to an armored killa.

Heavly Armored!

docs.title: Wuba (Exploding!)
docs.text:
A large, volatile blob, soon to detonate.

Blob!

docs.title: Wuba
docs.text: First form kamekaze worm When threatened or means of protecting its colony, the construct blasts off its shell and attempts to detonate.

docs.title: Bulbhead
docs.text: Commander of the Raft core. Shoots sonar pulses and Rallies nearby allies. Repairs allied structures. Can reconstitute itself using appropriate liquids, or with enough time.
