Under scattered gloomy sunlight in the shimmering seas, within the shifting sanctuary, Strata awoke.

No mouth to scream with, no skin to feel with, yet one sense remained.

A great longing of meaning.

Only has custom game content! (play the info map to understand)

docs.title: Meld
docs.text: Slowly disolves most metals and organics, save for a group of materials.

docs.title: Aether
docs.text: Passively collected by certain structures. Found in abundance from aether vents.

docs.title: Bound Aspect
docs.text:
A highly energy dense, stable fuel.

Can be used in place of Aspect

docs.title: Pollutant Mix
docs.text:
A mix of common aspects in the atmosphere of Ikaru. Emitted by aether vents.

Can be used in place of Aether

docs.title: Storming Aspect
docs.text:
Sparks and flashes, dancing on the monitor.

Can be used in place of Aspect

docs.title: Thundering Aether
docs.text:
Cackles and crackles, an energy inbetween.

Can be used in place of Aether

docs.title: Fumes
docs.text: Passively seeps into conductive materials. Used for a variety of metallurgic and restorative appliances.

docs.title: Aether Vitrifier
docs.text: Grows Dissonitre with Aether over aspect soil using power.

docs.title: Crush Weaver
docs.text: "Efficiently" weaves Dissonitre into Vitric Mesh over aspect soil. Requires Aspect to run.

docs.title: Earthbound Infuser
docs.text:
Infuses Debris with vent fumes to synthesize Carbolith.

Requires Aspect to run, can siphon Fumes from vents.

docs.title: Gas-fired Kiln
docs.text:
Heats materials using Aspect, often used for primitive refinement processes like smelting or ceramic blasting.

Carbolith + Tenbris -> Shadesteel + Fumes Silver -> Annealed Silver

Clay-Mallows + Quartz Strata + Likestone Sediments -> Glassy-Mallows

Clay-Mallows + Likestone Sediments + Debris -> Crucible-Plating Debris + Shadesteel -> Crucible Platings

docs.title: Pneumatic Extruder
docs.text:
Extrudes material into pipes and capsules, uses Aspect to run.

Debris + Elnar -> Aspect Pipe

Silver/Annealed Silver + Debris -> Aspect Pipe

Glassy-Mallows + Silver/Annealed Silver + Storming Aspect -> Aspect Bombs

docs.title: Rotary Kiln
docs.text:
Burns mass amounts of Aspect as fuel, heats materials to process them in bulk.

Carbolith + Tenbris -> Shadesteel + Fumes Silver -> Annealed Silver

Clay-Mallows + Quartz Strata + Likestone Sediments -> Glassy-Mallows

Clay-Mallows + Likestone Sediments + Debris -> Crucible-Plating Debris + Shadesteel -> Crucible Platings

docs.title: Storm Iris
docs.text: Converts stable Aether into charged Thundering Aether

docs.title: Large Crystal Barrier
docs.text:
Nigh indestructable crystaline formation of Meld. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from the floor melting underneath.

Heavly armored

docs.title: Crystal Barrier
docs.text:
Nigh indestructable crystaline formation of Meld. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from the floor melting underneath.

docs.title: Gate Spike

docs.title: Lake Rim

docs.title: Silver Husk
docs.text:
Buildable, insulated protection. Slowly regenerates when fed Aspect.

Plated

docs.title: Large Carbonic Barrier
docs.text:
Artificial formation of Carbon Stone. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from sustained firepower.

Artificial formation of Carbon Stone. Often demolished as a result of a broken Synapse, or from sustained firepower.

docs.title: Chute Crossing
docs.text: Lets items cross through without intersecting with eachother.

docs.title: Chute Overflow
docs.text:
Routes items to the front, or to the sides if blocked.

Accepts items from the back, or the sides if empty.

docs.title: Chute Router
docs.text: Routes items to three sides. Only accepts items from the back. Can be configured as a sorter.

docs.title: Chute
docs.text: Transports items fowards. Only holds a single item.

docs.title: Meld Node
docs.text: Keeps the surounding swampland frozen. Spawnpoint for Meld creatures during waves.

docs.title: Meld Synapse
docs.text: Stabalizes surounding crystal barriers. Once no synapses remain, the entire wall crumbles.

docs.title: Plated Chute
docs.text:
Transports items fowards, blocks items from non-distrib blocks at the sides. Only holds a single item.

Plated

docs.title: Unloading Hub
docs.text:
Rapidly unloads the selected item out of adjacent blocks. Heavly Armored!

Works on cores!

Damages all neary buildings on destruction!

docs.title: Aspect Incinerator
docs.text:
Incinerates items when fed Aspect.

Buffers items otherwise.

docs.title: Bruisekit
docs.text:
Regenerates target block's health.

Prioritises large, functional blocks and works at half speed on 1x1s.

Heals up to 4x more health based on how low target health% is, down to 50%.

docs.title: Buffer
docs.text:
Stores a small amount of items with separate capacities per type. Can be unloaded to empty its contents.

Connects to the core!

Lightly Armored!

docs.title: Core: Raft
docs.text:
Core of the base. Allows units to pass through freely. Once all are destroyed, the sector is lost.

Requires an adjacent incinerator to void excess items.

docs.title: Depot
docs.text:
Stores a small amount of items with separate capacities per type.

Outputs its contents to adjacent blocks, can be configured to only output one type of item.

docs.title: Gauze
docs.text: Weaves a Resonarum thread using Fumes, automatically applying it to connected blocks.

docs.text: Pulses Amplification to all allies in range.

docs.title: Meld Capsule
docs.text: Projects a barrier against physical attacks. Requires gasseous Meld to run.

docs.title: Nullifier
docs.text:
Constructs a devistating Aspect-filled paylod that decimates hostile buildings and units alike.

Annihilates its immediate surroundings on destruction, don't get too close!

docs.title: Large Meld Cluster
docs.text: A pile of Meld which has overgrown an Aether vent. Good source of starting debris.

docs.title: Aspect Bomb
docs.text:
Have you ever tried using a channel director on a node full of aspect? Like Yeah, that's a standardised building now.

Who thought shoving a bunch of explosive capsules in a pipe would be so effective...

docs.title: Aspect Channel
docs.text:
Acts as a directional router.

When transporting Aether, fills nearby buildings with highly volatile Aspect.

Works as an insulated input/output terminal for a fluid network.

Plated!

docs.title: Aspect Outlet
docs.text:
Decompresses Aether into highly volatile Aspect at a ratio of 1:10.

Works as an output terminal for a fluid network.

docs.title: Channel Director
docs.text: When used with other fluid blocks, restricts the flow of fluids to one direction only.

docs.title: Channel Face
docs.text: Acts as a fluid junction. Transmits fluid without storing it. No risk of explosion.

docs.title: Channel Hub
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid router. Liquid can be input or output from any side.

Stores 100 nodes worth of fluid.

Plated!

docs.title: Channel Node
docs.text: Acts as a fluid router. Fluids can be input or output from any side. Stores a small amount of fluid.

docs.title: Intake Valve
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid junction. Can be toggled to control if fluids can pass through.

Can compact/de-compact incoming sources of fluids into the channel network.

Plated!

docs.title: Manual Valve
docs.text: Acts as a fluid junction. Can be toggled to control if fluids can pass through.

docs.title: Pipebox
docs.text:
Routes fluids to the sides.

Can be toggled to rotate the connections.

docs.title: Pipeline Crossing
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid junction.

docs.title: Pipeline Overpass
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a bridge

docs.title: Pipeline Router
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a fluid router..

docs.title: Pipeline
docs.text: Meld construct which acts as a pipe.

docs.title: Pressure Vent
docs.text: Acts as a fluid router. Releases stored vapor into the atmosphere.

docs.title: Valve Controller
docs.text:
Acts as a fluid junction. Enables the targeted block when surrounded by blocks with fluids over its threshold.

Threshold/State can be configured.

docs.title: Aspect Discharger
docs.text: Converts Aspects to power over aspect soil.

docs.title: Conductive Pile
docs.text:
It's a pile of electrum coils which is conductive. Go figure what you can use this for.

And I guess it stores a tiny bit of power

...Squishi? (80)

docs.title: Substation
docs.text:
Projects lasers which share power between the station and its target. Stores power in an internal buffer.

Plated!

docs.title: Amalgam Decomposer
docs.text: Grinds Electrum down and blasts it using high amounts of Aspect till the remainder is pieces of Debris and Ichor.

docs.title: Crystal Cracker
docs.text:
Breaks open Dissonitre crystals over aspect soil as a source of Thundering Aether.

Acts as a liquid router for its output between adjacent blocks.

docs.title: Elemental Blaster
docs.text:
Blasts deposits for items indefinitely. Requires Aspect to run.

Can be boosted with Meld to double harvesting speed.

docs.title: Filtrative Feeder
docs.text:
Processes batches of Ichor over meld floors, aquiring some Meld and pieces of Debris each batch processed.

Requires a tiny trickle of power.

Input liquid requirements based on efficiency.

docs.title: Fumehood
docs.text: Placed over sources of aspects or gasses.

docs.title: Grinder Quarry
docs.text:
Rips up the land it's placed on, and harvests from ore deposits indefinitely.

Requires Aspect to run.

Connects to adjacent Depots!

Pipe in explosives, stronger fuels, grinding particulate, or solvents, to rip up the ground faster, or increase its yield.

docs.title: Pneumatic Pulsar
docs.text:
Blasts a single deposit for items indefinitely while maintained. Requires Aether to run.

Explosions damage everything around them, high maintenance!

docs.title: Meld Cannon
docs.text: Lobs globs of Meld at enemies, suppressing them.

docs.title: Molotov
docs.text: Launches an Aspect-filled Silver shell at ground targets over long distances, blasting shrapnel out of targets for extra damage. High armor piercing damage on impact. Doubles the damage armoured units take!

docs.title: Shredstorm
docs.text: Sprays debris shrapnel or silver buckshot at enemy targets. Spread is focused towards the aim direction.

docs.title: Sunder
docs.text: Fires clumps of Debris flak at enemy targets. Sticks shrapnel in targets!

docs.title: Vinca
docs.text: Sprays down targets with high pressured armor piercing crystalline particulate suspended in Aspect. Sticks shrapnel in targets!

docs.title: Vivisection
docs.text: Assembles and launches Resonarum sawblades. Lacerates targets without armor

docs.title: Friction Pad
docs.text:
Increases the drag of units, and removes the boost from Launch Stations.

Can only be placed on shallow liquids, always replaced by other buildings.

docs.title: Launch Station
docs.text:
Pulls units in, and propels them in the target direction.

Fueled by Aspect.

docs.title: Logistic Docks
docs.text: Attempts to set nearby unit's items to a certain threshold, using adjacent buildings as storage.

docs.title: Shark Autoforge
docs.text:
Pumps out Shark units using Silver and Carbolith.

Requires a large amount of Aspect to run, getting quicker corosponding to the supply.

docs.title: Carbolith
docs.text: Used for structural support and as a fuel source.

docs.title: Clay-Mallow
docs.text: Clay from the Badlands. Easly moulded to form containers, but difficult to aquire by blasting soil.

docs.title: Debris
docs.text: Used in many kinds of constructs on Ikaru. Refineable.

docs.title: Dissonitre
docs.text: Rare alternative source of Aether sourced from the Storm Planes and Badlands. Somewhat unstable.

docs.title: Electrum Sheet
docs.text: Refined material used in power transmission and advanced unit production.

docs.title: Resonarum
docs.text: Used in high-energy Aspect appliences such as Nullifiers.

docs.title: Silver
docs.text: Used in electrical components and structures. Integral part in most basic units.

docs.title: Vitric Mesh
docs.text: An intricate piece of glasswork which captures Aether when stimulated with power, building on itself.

docs.title: Aspect Bomb
docs.text:
Intricate glasswork and silver capsule containing volatile Storming Aspect.

A primary high explosive usable both as an extremely potent ammo, and for use in industrial mining applications.

Perfect to load into units for kamikaze runs.

docs.title: Gunpowder
docs.text:
A self oxidising, rapidly decomposing powder who's deflagration produces supersonic shockwaves.

Highly useful in mining explosives, can be manufactured into many standardised ammo types.

docs.title: Annealed Silver
docs.text: Highly refined and attuned. Makes for a great aspect conductor.

docs.title: Aspect Pipe
docs.text:
Insulated hull with a conductive core, used to transport aspects safely.

Made from a variety of processing chains.

docs.title: Crucible Plating
docs.text:
Versatile ceramic often used as an armor plating, or in the chambers of the more industrial high aspect appliances.

Made from a variety of processing chains.

docs.title: Elnar Dust
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to conduct aspect.

docs.title: Glass-Mallow
docs.text: Refined clay from the Badlands, more glass than ceramic.

docs.title: Iampsi
docs.text:
Hardy mineral found accumulating in deposits under dried riverbeds, or as spikes above surface.

Decomposable for Silver and Quartz Strata, useful for grinding.

docs.title: Likestone Sediments
docs.text: Claystone deposited bessides old rivers. Acts as a great glass flux.

docs.title: Motis
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its natural magnetism.

docs.title: Quartz Strata
docs.text:
Silicon oxide grains and crystals of various sizes, ready for industrial or military use.

Too disorderly to be used in electronics raw.

docs.title: Shadesteel
docs.text: Not just some rock anymore. Durable building material.

docs.title: Tenbris
docs.text: Raw material, valued for its ability to insulate aspect when refined.

docs.title: Larval Plating
docs.text: Some sort of juvinile plating piece. No uses found.

docs.title: Meld Shard
docs.text: Vague lifeform in crystal form. Use unknown.

docs.title: Ichor
docs.text: Major food source for the Meld. Fuels Meld construct birthing and a major component in sustainable power systems/mass-produced infastructure.

docs.title: Mercury
docs.text: Used as lubricant. Acts as a potent toxin inside creatures of Meld origin.

docs.title: Nectar
docs.text: Used as a potent coolant. Can be refined into Mercury over high heat with the right reagents. Encourages a slight mending effect on units.

docs.title: Ooze
docs.text: No apparent use found. Cold to the touch.

docs.title: Ikaru
docs.text:
A wartorn planet with scraps of usable unrefined resources. Inhabited by the Meld.

Heavy fog lingers everywhere.

docs.title: Amplified
docs.text: Amplifies mobility, durability and reload. Applied by Meld Amplifiers.

docs.title: Anchored
docs.text: Heavly increased drag and health. Heavly decreased speed. Applied by Movement Anchors

docs.title: Aspect Burn
docs.text: Doubles damage taken, does a tiny bit of DoT. Applied by Aspect-based weaponary in conjunction with burning. Only affects mechanical and armored targets.

Heavly reduced mobility and fireate. Increases durability slightly and encourages light regeneration.

Applied by Resonarum related sources. No effect on armored meld or inorganic targets.

docs.title: Rally
docs.text: Increased mobility and reload. Applied by Commanders and Sonars.

docs.title: Refreshed
docs.text: Doubles reload speed and slightly reduces damage taken. Invokes slight regeneration.

docs.title: Sentry

RU: Очень опасный мод, который влияет на баланс и механику игры, добавляет новый контент в виде статус эффектов и оборонительных сооружений (башен, мин и т.д.).

Рекомендуется перед установкой сделать СОХРАНЕНИЕ (чтобы откатиться назад), если в случае вам не понравится то, что может сделать данный мод (ну или если вы встретили конфликт / фатальную ошибку). Лучше не рискуйте лишний раз и поверьте на слово: МОД. МЕНЯЕТ. МНОГОЕ.

Важно: Описание некоторых юнитов не корректно, либо и вовсе неправильное.

ENG: A very dangerous mod that affects the balance and mechanics of the game, adds new content: status effects, defensive structures (towers, mines, etc.), completely overhauls all vanilla units. .

Preferably before installing create a BACKUP (to roll back), if in case you dont like changes or have issues with mod. And it is better to really do not take unnecessary risks and take my word for it: MOD. CHANGES. EVERYTHING.

A mod based on the old legend of the Terraria Calamity is being continuously updated and currently has over 300 contents!

The Mod campaign emphasizes blitzkrieg, please pay attention to it when playing for the first time.

If you encounter any problems during the gameplay, please provide feedback to the author.

docs.title: BitingGlacier
docs.text: Group BOSS Map The frigid environment has given rise to these massive ice spikes, with northern mountain ranges covered in thick ice layers. Further up lies the origin point of Wulfrum, where Wulfrum frequency signals are strongest.

docs.title: Dry Sands Oilfield
docs.text: MinBOSS Map A desert occupied by several Wulfrum bases, showing signs of past wars. Data indicates Oil resources beneath the sand. Surface traces of underground lava flows exist. Use lava for power generation. Extract Oil to produce Plastanium. Surface Coal deposits can be utilized. Water must be somewhere.

docs.title: Floating Ice Bay
docs.text: BOSS Map An Arctic inlet with volcanic activity. The sea surface has extensive ice floes. Shallow waters between floes provide passage. Wulfrum defenses here are stronger than other regions. Gather resources, build a base, capture this area.

docs.title: Misty Outpost
docs.text: A tranquil forest with a river, housing several unclaimed constructs' bases. Begin your journey here. Destroy bases, research technology.

docs.title: Haze Ravine
docs.text: BOSS Map A mountainous area. Higher-tier Wulfrum machines are entrenched here. Await Reinforcements. Develop and destroy all enemy cores.

docs.title: Meteorite Basin
docs.text: A basin downstream from the river valley. Houses several Wulfrum bases and an energy-emitting meteorite crater. This area has Chromium deposits for ship construction.

docs.title: Turbulent Valley
docs.text: A valley with fast-flowing water. Houses 2 Wulfrum bases. Resources are not abundant. Destroy bases, research technology.

docs.title: Vast Lake
docs.text: MinBOSS Map A lake with a Wulfrum water base. Transport and ground unit movement are difficult here. Use Payload devices for resource transport. Attack with Hover units and navy.

docs.title: NEMP
docs.text: Short-term strong electromagnetic interference caused by nuclear explosion.

docs.title: Sulphurous Radiation
docs.text: Background radiation levels here far exceed other areas. This is your minimal warning.

docs.title: Wulfrum Amplify
docs.text: Enhances Wulfrum machine performance. Amplified Wulfrum machine indicators turn blue.

docs.title: Astrolabe
docs.text: Powered by a central energy orb. Fires energy bombs that release three laser beams on impact/explosion. Mounts cluster bombs and laser emitters. Massive item and payload capacity.

docs.title: Asylum

docs.title: Axis
docs.text: Equipped with laser repair and construction systems. Guards the Axis Core and surrounding area.

docs.title: Berg
docs.text: Highly agile. Fires multiple laser beams at enemies. Charges to fire multiple homing EMP shells.

docs.title: Bless
docs.text: Equipped with construction tool. Finds and rebuilds destroyed structures. Amplifies nearby units.

docs.title: Downpour
docs.text: Drops 4 bombs while dashing. Also drops bombs when reaching bomb-release speed.

docs.title: Gather
docs.text: Automatically mines minerals and transports them to the core.

docs.title: Heaven

docs.title: Lark
docs.text: Equipped with construction system and unit repair tool.

docs.title: Massif
docs.text: Highly agile. Fires small shells at enemies. Charges to fire homing EMP shells.

docs.title: Mound
docs.text: Highly agile. Fires small shells at enemies. Charges to fire eight homing EMP shells.

docs.title: Origin
docs.text: Equipped with laser repair and construction systems. Guards the Origin Core and surrounding area.

docs.title: Patrol
docs.text: Automatically mines minerals and transports them to the core. Equipped with structure repair tool; finds and repairs damaged buildings.

docs.title: Simple Core Drone
docs.text: Maintains production around the core or repairs structural damage from invasions.

docs.title: Quadrant

docs.title: Trochilus

docs.title: Wulfrum Bomber
docs.text: Drops 4 bombs while dashing. Also drops bombs when reaching bomb-release speed.

docs.text: An essential part of the Wulfrum series. Expands Wulfrum territory, establishes bases, gathers resources to produce more Wulfrum machines.

docs.title: Wulfrum Homing Missile
docs.text: Homing capability. Heavily armored; difficult to destroy before detonation.

docs.title: Wulfrum Freighter

docs.title: Wulfrum Rocket
docs.text: Extremely fast. Heavily armored; difficult to destroy before detonation.

docs.title: Wulfrum Sprinter
docs.text: Attacks by ramming with its hardened nose.

docs.title: Wulfrum Surrounder
docs.text: Mounts homing energy bolt launchers on both sides. Retreats while attacking when facing enemies.

docs.title: Wulfrum Fighter
docs.text: Fires crossing energy bolts at targets. Equipped with suppression field, repair suppression, constructor. Mounts force field projector to protect allied units.

docs.title: Accretion
docs.text: Fires energy bolts at enemies. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Aggregation
docs.text: Fires energy beams at enemies. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Collapse
docs.text: Charges to create a small black hole, spewing dark energy from the singularity for massive damage. Normally fires energy arrows. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Deviation
docs.text: Fires discharging armor-piercing rounds at targets while releasing several shells. Can crush buildings.

docs.title: Disintegration
docs.text: Fires multiple discharging armor-piercing rounds at targets. Can crush buildings.

docs.title: Distort
docs.text: Attacks by tearing space to harness energy from black holes. Fires energy arrows; equipped with energy bomb launcher. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Dust
docs.text: Highly agile. Can hover on liquids. Fires bullets at targets.

docs.title: 绿机甲t1
docs.text: 向敌人发射激光，搭载范围恢复系统。 可治疗友方建筑但不会主动治疗。

docs.title: 绿机甲t4
docs.text: 向目标发射能量激光。 可跨越大多数地形。

docs.title: Jet
docs.text: Charges and fires explosive energy bombs. Mounts point-defense lasers. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Light Cone
docs.text: Fires high-temperature energy flames at targets. Can traverse most terrain.

docs.title: Magnetic Storm
docs.text: Fires spreading electromagnetic bolts. Central magnetic generator inflicts EMP II debuff on enemies in range. Triggers a massive magnetic burst after each charge cycle.

docs.title: Pulse
docs.text: Fires lightning arrows at targets. Arcs release lightning upon breaking.

docs.title: Sandstone
docs.text: Highly agile. Fires floating shells at enemies.

docs.title: Wulfrum Armored Crawler
docs.text: Charges and fires massive pulse bombs. Rear-mounted web launcher ensnares targets and fires pulse shells, drastically reducing ensnared target efficiency. Equipped with force field defense system. Periodically spawns Wulfrum Spiders. Amplifies Wulfrum units within range.

docs.title: Wulfrum Armored Serpent
docs.text: Has 26 body segments. Each segment fires pulse shells. Head mounts an overloaded energy laser. Destroying any segment spawns one Wulfrum Surrounder and two Wulfrum Rammers. Dies when head is destroyed or only head remains.

docs.title: Wulfrum Mech
docs.text: Mounts a Gauss laser emitter capable of penetrating two units.

docs.title: Wulfrum Polar Mech
docs.text: Armed with Tesla Cannons firing numerous Tesla orbs that electrocute buildings/units within range. Orbs connect with each other. Rear-mounted pulse cannon launcher fires volleys of pulse shells.

docs.title: Wulfrum Tank
docs.text: Crushes buildings. Armed with Wulfrum rockets for long-range strikes.

docs.title: Blue River
docs.text: Charges and fires three orbital energy armor-piercing shells at enemies.

docs.title: Wulfrum Cruiser
docs.text: Fires multiple pulse shells at targets. Equipped with disintegration system.

docs.title: Wulfrum Frigate
docs.text: Mounts mortar energy cannons for pinpoint strikes. Shells cannot fly over buildings.

docs.title: Acid Rain
docs.text: Local atmospheric nitrogen oxide levels exceed 2%. Severe pollution turns life-giving rain deadly.

docs.title: Haze
docs.text: Water vapor permeates, clouds swirl, shrouding the Primeval Forest in mystery.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/coaldeficit/moredefences Stars 38 Last updated 2026-06-10T16:22:02Z

A mod made by CD, meowkitty and 7rodo that overhauls the campaign, significantly modifying Serpulo's campaign and adding a new planet, Fieros.

Amidst the features in this mod are:

  • 18 New Turrets to defend with

  • 21 New Units to attack with

  • 16 New campaign Sectors to play on, including 2 Remakes of vanilla sectors

  • Post-Surge Alloy-tier content for Serpulo

  • 12 New Miscellaneous blocks to mess around with on Serpulo

⚠ This mod moves Serpulo sectors around without moving their saves, backup your game data in [ SETTINGS > GAME DATA ] before enabling/disabling this mod to prevent campaign corruption if you have any campaign saves. ⚠

Discord: https://discord.gg/9YHA3q8HHq

docs.text: Transports liquids over terrain or buildings. Outputs to 3 sides at the end.

docs.title: Intelligence Record
docs.text: Stores a message for communication between allies.

docs.title: Memory Drive
docs.text: Stores information for a logic processor. Extremely high capacity.

docs.title: Huge Battery
docs.text: Stores power in times of surplus energy. Outputs power in times of deficit. Lightly armored and stores tremendous quantities of power. Susceptible to chain reaction on destruction if too closely packed, even when empty.

docs.title: Thermal Turbine
docs.text: Generates power when placed in hot locations. Uses a steam-powered turbine for higher efficiency.

docs.title: Germinator
docs.text: An upgraded cultivator. Feeds spores nutritional supplements for faster growth.

docs.title: Beehive
docs.text: A turret that fires large projectiles that fire a swarm of piercing homing bullets.

docs.title: Blade
docs.text: Fires highly damaging Blades and self destructs after 12 seconds.

docs.title: Delay
docs.text: Fires a continuous slowing stream of condensed gas at enemy targets.

docs.title: Emphasis
docs.text: Shoots very powerful barrages of homing projectiles at enemies. Fires slower the more blocks it has near it.

docs.title: Firenado
docs.text: Floods powerful blasts of thick slag on enemies.

docs.title: Fusillade
docs.text: Rapidly fires powerful railgun shots, but overheats easily if shooting for too long. Ignores weak targets to avoid producing unnecessary heat.

docs.title: Gauge
docs.text: Fires a spread of high speed incendiary projectiles at targets.

docs.title: Instant
docs.text: Fires fast, hard-hitting tungsten missiles at air units. Missiles redirect at enemies with the least max health and are highly effective against weak units, but have trouble penetrating the armor of higher tier air units.

docs.title: Juan
docs.text: Detonates a huge amount of explosives and funnels the resulting explosions through a shaped charge, creating an extremely powerful blast that pierces all enemy armor and inflicts massive damage.

docs.title: Mica
docs.text: Fires a fluid-filled grapeshot at enemies. Water-filled grapeshot is automatically aimed at and can extinguish fires. Can be unloaded from with unloaders.

docs.title: Multishot
docs.text: Slowly fires powerful spreads of bullets at nearby enemies.

docs.title: Puncture
docs.text: Fires powerful naval missiles that cannot stay on land for long. Deals massive critical damage to enemies near max health.

docs.title: Reservation
docs.text: Fires salvos of weak but ammo consumption efficient pellets of advanced materials.

docs.title: Shieldlayer
docs.text: Shoots mines that project shields and disrupt nearby enemy units.

docs.title: Tearer
docs.text: Fires a torrent of weak bullets that shred weak aerial enemy targets.

docs.title: Triops
docs.text: Shoots twisting pairs of bullets at enemy targets. Potent against unprotected targets, but struggles against armor.

docs.title: Armor Plate
docs.text: A simple plate of armor for unit production.

docs.title: Basic Unit Factory
docs.text: Uses resources to construct basic, low tier units.

docs.title: Basic Component Assembler
docs.text: Creates basic components for the creation of units.

docs.title: Lithitic Router
docs.text: Redirects payloads to other destinations. Capable of sorting payloads by type.

docs.title: Bromine
docs.text: A highly reactive orange element, frozen solid from the low temperatures of Fieros.

docs.title: Bulletum
docs.text: A tough alloy of Cobalt and Lithium used for ammunition and construction.

docs.title: Cinnabar
docs.text: A soft vein-filling volcanic mineral used for most construction on Fieros.

docs.title: Cobalt
docs.text: A hard, slightly brittle metal used for most construction on Fieros.

docs.title: Lithium
docs.text: A soft, reactive metal used for ammunition and synthesis.

docs.title: Radium
docs.text: An explosive radioactive resource. Used for the production of highly dangerous substances and materials with useful optical properties.

docs.title: Rage
docs.text: An extremely powerful and shock sensitive explosive. Usable as ammunition for turrets.

docs.title: Vanadiphor
docs.text: An alloy of Vanadium and various other materials. Highly durable.

docs.title: Dimethyl
docs.text: A highly potent liquid neurotoxin. Can be refined into Mercury and Ethane.

docs.title: Mercury
docs.text: A liquid metal that reacts strongly with most metals to form alloys.

docs.title: Expansion
docs.text: This sector contains deposits of Lithium. Destroy the enemy outposts in the area and discover uses for lithium.

docs.title: Fortification
docs.text: A large enemy defensive structure has been detected in this sector, aswell as the development of a potent support turret. Destroy the enemy cores. Investigate the turret and take it for yourself.

docs.title: Inception
docs.text: A small, isolated valley in the middle of an island with low enemy activity. Take out the enemy outpost here. Gather basic resources and technology. Begin your conquest of Fieros.

docs.title: Junkyard Barrens
docs.text:
[optional objective] An ancient junkyard, hiding an enemy base constructed during the old wars.

Scrap synthesizing technology data has been detected here. Take out the enemy base and claim the technology for yourself.

docs.title: Lowland Torrents
docs.text:
Past combat operations on nearby areas during the old wars have turned the weather here into perpetual rainfall, even long past their conclusion the rain persists.

Further unknown unit signatures have been detected here. Take out the growing enemy presence and reverse-engineer the new units.

docs.title: Mycelium Lake
docs.text:
A large spore-infested lake, surrounded by enemy fortifications.

Further unknown unit signatures have been detected here. Take out the enemy base and reverse-engineer the new units.

docs.title: Reentry
docs.text: A fireball has been detected over this sector during your battle in Ruinous Shores, aswell as rapidly increasing enemy presence within. Unknown unit signatures have been identified among the enemy forces present here. Take out the enemy units. Investigate what is attracting their attention.

docs.title: Scourged Rivers
docs.text:
A formerly thriving network of rivers and creeks, now severely infested with spores. Attacking this area will put the novel enemy on alert, however doing so will also lure out much of their standard forces into a disadvantageous position.

Lure the novel enemy's forces here. Survive and destroy them as they come to weaken their main base.

docs.title: Sulfurism
docs.text:
A volcanic passage to the shoreline north. No enemy base is present here, however the enemy now knows of your presence and will send large waves of units to destroy you.

Deposits of Bromine have been detected here. Mine it and discover what it can be used for.

docs.title: Insulated
docs.text: Protects units affected by it from electricity and low temperature embrittlement.

docs.title: Apis
docs.text: An armored distraction unit. On death, explodes into fragments outfitted with beacons that confuse enemy turrets.

docs.title: Assaulter
docs.text: A weak drone used as a source of extra firepower by some weapons systems. Self-destructs after a short period of time.

docs.title: Troni
docs.text: Helps with upgrading units. Produced by unit assemblers.

docs.title: Flocker
docs.text: An armored distraction unit, armed with a lightning autogun that explodes when destroyed.

docs.title: Hornet
docs.text: A distraction unit that fires missiles armed with decoy beacons that confuse enemy turrets.

docs.title: Messenger
docs.text: Unleashes a barrage of powerful bullets on enemy targets while peppering them with artillery.

docs.title: Tundra
docs.text: Drops bombs that freeze damaged structures, destroying them even with health remaining. Outfitted with an Underdrive Dome that slows down nearby enemy structures, and overpowers the effects of overdrive projectors.

docs.title: Protium
docs.text: Builds structures to defend the Monoquark core. Shields nearby ally units. Capable of carrying 2x2 structures.

docs.title: Blitz
docs.text: Overwhelms enemy defences with drone swarms and lobs self-deploying turrets into enemy defences.

docs.title: Cogwheel
docs.text: A lightweight unit designed to be thrown over enemy defences, where it'll damage vital infrastructure and eventually detonate.

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: A highly durable war machine that crushes anything in its path. Has automatic salvo turrets to defend itself from air units.

docs.title: Havoc
docs.text: A mobile bunker. Stationary and strong against buildings above 25% health, slowly moving and strong against units below 25% health.

docs.title: Jerald
docs.text: Fires lasers and streams of bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Jeri
docs.text: Fires salvos of bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Klotzi
docs.text: Fires bullets at enemy targets and crawls over them.

docs.title: Mortar
docs.text: Fires medium-range explosive shells at ground enemy targets.

docs.title: Rocketeer
docs.text: Slowly fires long-range homing missiles and lobs groups of Cogwheels past enemy defences.

docs.title: Shotgunner
docs.text: Fires a burst of bullets at enemy targets.

docs.title: Slugger
docs.text: Rapidly fires powerful slug shells that pierce enemy units and structures. Suppresses enemy structure repair blocks. Can walk over most terrain.

docs.title: Agaricus
docs.text: Fires extremely powerful homing short range bursts of energy, aswell as drones to pick on farther away targets. Self-regenerative.

docs.title: Armillaria
docs.text: Shoots extremely powerful energy bombs that overwhelm enemy point defence systems. Self-regenerative.

docs.title: Macrocybe
docs.text: Sprays a stream of spores that infest blocks they break. Self-regenerative.

docs.title: Panaeolus
docs.text: Shoots a barrage of oil-filled projectiles and large spores that develop into turrets on contact with land. Self-regenerative.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/alphajred1/nexus-mod Stars 20 Last updated 2025-10-24T13:12:05Z

A mod that adds more content to Serpulo and Erekir, as well as a new planet, Thanaras, that has a fully playable campaign and tech tree!

over 100+ blocks, 40+ units, 15+ sectors, and so much more!

This mod is still in development, and it will get updates every so often :)

You can check out my youtube channel @ajr1814 for NeXus Devlogs and other stuff, and feel free to comment on any of them if you have any thoughts or problems with the mod.

I hope you enjoy!

docs.text: Cultivates and decays tryphoton, collecting the nitrogen released from the decaying process. Requires power and methane.

docs.text: Grinds down nickel into sand. Used when sand is scarce or not present in certain sectors.

docs.text: Submerges and fuses titanium with nitrogen, creating cryo compound.

docs.text: Merges methane and nitrogen together, outputting cyanogen. Requires power and tryplasma as a stabilizer.

docs.text: Smelts titanium and tungsten together to form gigantion alloy. Requires methane and power to function.

docs.title: Lead Pulverizer

docs.text: Creates a wormhole connecting to other Plasma Gateways, allowing items to be transported over long distances. Must be completely collinear to other Plasma Gateways in order to work.

docs.text: it has an organic-like feel to it... its revolting to the touch.

docs.text: The advanced upgrade of the Nucleus Core, can store an incredulous amount of items. Protected by the Delta Core Unit.

docs.title: Erekir Nexus Message Decoder
docs.text: Decodes messages from an unknown wavelength only discoverable through the quantum power of monolite. Creates power as a by-product.

docs.title: Korru Sthenos
docs.text: A large statue created by the Korru that, when powered and filled with tryplasma, is able to invigorate all structures on the map by 50%.

docs.title: Large Chrome Regulator
docs.text: Heals surrounding structures with a powerful regeneration laser. Require tryplasma and power.

docs.title: Chrome Regulator
docs.text: Heals surrounding buildings with regenerative bolt lasers.

docs.title: Nexus Blueprint Vessel
docs.text: Indestructible. contains one Nexus Blueprint, which can be used to unlock more special and advanced content in the tech trees of any planet. These are hidden around sectors, sometimes in plain sight, sometimes inside walls. One thing is for sure, when you find it, deconstruct it to obtain the Nexus Blueprint... before the others do.

docs.title: Serpullion Nexus Message Decoder
docs.text: Decodes messages from an unknown wavelength only discoverable through the quantum power of monolite. Creates power as a by-product.

docs.title: Oscillator
docs.text: Creates a shockwave that debuffs and knocks back enemies. Requires coal and power.

docs.title: Secure Container
docs.text: Stores a good amount of items, well protected and armored. Can be connected to the Core to increase it's storage amount, which is required to get enough resources to upgrade to the next Core Tier.

docs.title: Secure Container
docs.text: Stores a large amount of items, heavily protected and armored. Can be connected to the Core to increase it's storage amount, which is required to get enough resources to upgrade to the next Core Tier.

docs.title: Sharded Sthenos
docs.text: A reverse engineered Korru Sthenos, reconstructed and redesigned to fit Sharded standards. When powered and filled with tryplasma, is able to invigorate all structures on the map by 50%.

docs.title: Shine Pod
docs.text: A well armored block that gives off light when powered.

docs.title: Subzero Tower
docs.text: Inflicts subzero freezing on enemies in its range, slowing them down and debuffing them.

docs.title: Tekton Drone Bay
docs.text: Manufactures a Tekton Drone which assists in construction and rebuilding destroyed structures. Requires power and a steady supply of nitrogen.

docs.title: Thanarian Nexus Message Decoder
docs.text: Decodes messages from an unknown wavelength only discoverable through the quantum power of monolite. Creates power as a by-product.

docs.title: Toxin Mine
docs.text: Explodes when enemies walk on top of it, inflicting uranium decay which slowly burns them down.

docs.title: Uranium Mender
docs.text: An advanced version of the Mend Projector. Rapidly heals all structures in its proximity. Requires uranium and power.

docs.title: Liquid Vessel
docs.text: A liquid container capable of holding much more liquid than a liquid tank.

docs.title: Pipe Junction
docs.text: Creates a junction between two pipes, allowing their respective liquids to cross paths.

docs.title: Pipe Overpass
docs.text: Transports liquids over blocks, connecting to other pipe overpasses that are in its current direction.

docs.title: Pipe Router
docs.text: Distributes liquids to nearby structures or pipes.

docs.title: Secure Liquid Container
docs.text: Stores a good amount of liquid capacity, well armored and secure. Can dispense the liquid to adjacent pipes.

docs.title: Secure Liquid Tank
docs.text: Stores a large amount of liquid capacity, heavily armored and secure. Can dispense the liquid to adjacent pipes.

docs.title: Secure Message
docs.text: Stores messages in a secure, well armored block.

docs.title: Annexion Generator
docs.text: Generates a good amount of power at peak efficiency. Requires a positive power input to begin building up efficiency. May take some time to reach its peak.

docs.title: Armored Power Pod
docs.text: An armored powerline that distributes power to structures in its range.

docs.title: Confliction Generator
docs.text: Generates a large amount of power. Utilizes the temperature difference between noxionite and nitrogen.

docs.title: Power Queller
docs.text: Distributes power to nearby structures. Has the ability to store some power for later use as well.

docs.title: Power Vessel
docs.text: Stores a large amount of power. Heavily armored and well protected.

docs.title: Radio-Isotope Power Plant
docs.text: Generates a significant amount of power from uranium. Requires a constant flow of nitrogen as coolant. Will explode if an insufficient amount of coolant is supplied.

docs.title: RTG Absorber
docs.text: Absorbs the radiation from radioactive floor tiles, converting it into power.

docs.title: T.O.S. Reactor
docs.text: The Tryplasmic Oscillation System Reactor unstablizes tryplasma, generating a large amount of power. Requires cyanogen as coolant.

docs.title: Vaporization Chamber
docs.text: Rapidly vaporizes nitrogen, releasing huge amounts of steam and pressure that quicky turn turbines, which generates power.

docs.title: Vionic Power Vault
docs.text: A large, towering battery that stores an insane amount of power. One of these fully charged could power a small sector for days.

docs.title: Methane Concentrator
docs.text: Slowly concentrates methane in the atmosphere into a gas that can be transported.

docs.title: Duplexon
docs.text: Forges duplexon from titanium and monolite. requires cryofluid as coolant.

docs.title: Impact Miner
docs.text: A basic drill that builds up pressure, mining items in batches.

docs.title: Monolite Extractor
docs.text: Capable of mining monolite ore from the ground. Requires water.

docs.title: Nitrogen Extractor
docs.text: Extracts frozen nitrogen from nitrogenous ice floors, dispensing them back as a gas.

docs.title: Quake Miner
docs.text: Builds up pressure with the quick evaporation of nitrogen gas, allowing it to mine items at a much faster pace. Can mine uranium.

docs.title: Serpulo Core Driller
docs.text: Drills to the very core of Serpulo and extracts serpullium. Requires massive amounts of power and slag.

docs.title: Tremor Miner
docs.text: Has faster mining speed than a Profuse Drill. Can mine

docs.title: Tryphoton Cultivator
docs.text: Extracts tryphoton from underneath the surface. Must be placed on tryphoton-active floors.

docs.title: Tryphoton Extractor
docs.text: Extracts tryphoton from underneath the surface. Must be placed on tryphoton-active floors.

docs.title: Volantic Drill
docs.text: A gigantic drill capable of mining any ore at an insane pace. Requires cryofluid and power to function.

docs.title: Admonish
docs.text: Launches large amounts of artillery shells at enemies. Each type of ammo inflicts a different type of status effect.

docs.title: Degrade
docs.text: Shoots out a cloud of cosmic rust that affects enemies in its path.

docs.title: Diurnal
docs.text: Targets and drags in flying enemies, slowing them down and damaging them slighty. Requires tryplasma and nitrogen to function.

docs.title: Fissure
docs.text: Bursts out jets of fire by setting lead toxin ablaze.

docs.title: Fracture
docs.text: Fires interwaving bullets at enemies that pierce and deal good damage.

docs.title: Harbinger
docs.text: Blasts enemies with bursts of splash damaging bolts over long distances. Any nearby smaller units will get obliterated if in proximity to it's target.

docs.title: Hastati
docs.text: Fires rapid bursts of thin powerful light rays at enemies.

docs.title: Hoplite
docs.text: Charges up and fires a large lightning laser, heavily damaging enemies that it pierces through.

docs.title: Lavender
docs.text: Rapidly fires sapping lasers at enemies, which can also heal itself.

docs.title: Multitude
docs.text: Fires homing missiles at enemies in large bursts. Requires power to function.

docs.title: Nebula
docs.text: Charges up and fires a large, powerful star orb at enemies. Requires power and duplexon for ammo.

docs.title: Objurgate
docs.text: Blasts enemies with powerful status inflicting orbs that fragment into smaller, piercing orbs.

docs.title: Orb
docs.text: Charges up a plasma core and strikes it repeatedly, sending off homing orbs that damage enemies.

docs.title: Peltast
docs.text: Blasts enemies with a supercharged piercing dart that releases electric sparks as it travels.

docs.title: Preliminary
docs.text: Fires piercing liquid comets at enemies, inflicting status effects and damaging them from long range.

docs.title: Punctual
docs.text: Fires a shotgun blast of heavy shells that knockback nearby enemies.

docs.title: Puncture
docs.text: Fires homing spikes that pierce multiple enemies.

docs.title: Rail
docs.text: Charges up an artillery bomb, which sparks lightning bolts as it travels to its destination.

docs.title: Reprimand
docs.text: Rapidly fires large shrapnel shells at enemies, dealing a good amount of splash damage to clumped up units.

docs.title: Shiver
docs.text: Strikes the ground, sending out vibrating shockwaves that inflict enemies with trauma. Requires methane and power to function.

docs.title: Solder
docs.text: Fires rounds of piercing shrapnel at nearby enemies. Uses methane to propel the shrapnel further.

docs.title: Spherule
docs.text: Charges up a large plasma core and smashes into it violently, firing out plasma orbs that home onto enemies. An advanced version of the Orb turret.

docs.title: Spicule
docs.text: Fires thorny bombs that explode into tiny armor piercing frag shards when detonated.

docs.title: Turf
docs.text: Blasts enemies in it's range with splash damaging shrapnel.

docs.title: Vertex
docs.text: Zaps enemies with a single-target bolt that sparks lightning in all directions.

docs.title: Wreathe
docs.text: Takes time to charge. When fully charged, unleashes a storm of bullets on enemies.

docs.title: Champion Constructor
docs.text: Creates Champions, units which are meant to be the middle ground between tier 4 and tier 5 units. They are either upgrades of certain units or have unique gimmicks that make them stand out from the crowd. Due to their lack of requiring multiple reconstructors, they require much more time and materials to create.

docs.title: Femto Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades tier 3 Micro units into their tier 4 forms.

docs.title: Mech-Ship Hybrid Assembler
docs.text: Combines the Mech and Ship families to create Arietis.

docs.title: Monument Assembler
docs.text: Combines all Serpulo tier 2 ground units into the Monument.

docs.title: Nano Reconstructor
docs.text: Upgrades Tier 1 Micro units into their tier 2 forms.

docs.title: Pico Reconstructor
docs.text: upgrades tier 2 Micro units into their tier 3 forms.

docs.title: Secure Payload Conveyor
docs.text: A secure and armored conveyor that moves large payloads, such as units from factories.

docs.title: Secure Payload Router
docs.text: A secure and armored router that distributes payloads into adjacent blocks.

docs.title: Ship-Tank Hybrid Assembler
docs.text: Combines the Ship and Tank families to create Ruse.

docs.title: Shrine Assembler
docs.text: Combines all Serpulo tier 1 ground units into the Shrine.

docs.title: Tank-Mech Hybrid Assembler
docs.text: Combines the Tank and Mech families to create Hexahedron.

docs.title: Titanium Payload Conveyor
docs.text: An advanced Payload Conveyor, much larger and able to move bigger payloads.

docs.title: Cryo Compound
docs.text: A coolant compound used as a substitute for cryofluid in building units and structures.

docs.title: Depleted Uranium
docs.text: Byproduct of using uranium in nuclear reactors. Used in radiation shielding and weaponry.

docs.title: Nickel
docs.text: A silvery white metal known for its hardness, malleability, and ductility.

docs.title: Nitrogen
docs.text: Used in resource extraction, gas creation and unit production. Inert.

docs.title: Gigantion Alloy
docs.text: An incredibly dense alloy with a powerful resistance capacity.

docs.title: Monolite
docs.text: A strange metal containing some kind of quantum power, allowing for more advanced tech and creations.

docs.title: Nexus Blueprint
docs.text: The basis of the Nexus Research Tree. This enables you to research special content in any Tech Tree, if there are any. This is ONLY used for research purposes.

docs.title: Nickel
docs.text: A silvery white metal known for its hardness, malleability, and ductility.

docs.title: Nitinol
docs.text: An alloy forged from nickel and titanium. Has superelastic properties and a unique shape memory.

docs.title: Noxionite
docs.text: A flammable and radioactive compound, the best of both worlds.

docs.title: Tryphoton
docs.text: An organic material with rock-like properties, somewhat radioactive.

docs.title: Uranium
docs.text: A radioactive metal known for its role in nuclear power generation.

docs.title: Vion Quartz
docs.text: A powerful, energy-ridden quartz that can be used in unit creation, power, and ammo. Highly explosive.

docs.title: Methane
docs.text: A colorless, odorless gas used in power and item production.

docs.title: Cosmic Rust
docs.text: A pulverized mix of admix and deadly cosmic toxins, forming the death of all mechanical lifeforms: cosmic rusting. (in the works)

docs.title: Tryplasma
docs.text: Radioactive juices extracted from tryphoton. Holds some sort of inter-dimensional power when utilized correctly. Can be used as coolant for turrets.

docs.title: Thanaras
docs.text: A dark, isolated planet that happened to fly by the Serpulo Erekir Solar System a few centuries ago and got into orbit around their sun. There was a struggle between factions as they tried to conquer the planet despite its hostile nature and... seemingly alive celestial body, yet it appears something seems to have been reawakened in the presence of warmth... something sinister that the Korru, the Green faction that currently occupies Thanaras, is obliviously unaware of.

docs.title: Arche Ruin
docs.text: As punishment for your INCREDIBLY lackluster performance at operating a high value resource sector in Serpulo, you have been sent to a planet almost beyond the reaches of this solar system, a cold and sinister planet called Thanaras. Mystery fills the atmosphere, dread lurking at every corner, but, as fate may have it, you are not alone in this supposedly desolate wasteland. Figure out the inner workings of this planet's tech and hope to survive the onslaught of waves that will come your way.

docs.title: Cratorial Super Quarry
docs.text: Two large craters formed from asteroid impacts a long long time ago are riddled with plentiful resources such as nickel, titanium, and tungsten. Legend says the asteroid had split in two before impact, causing the two distinct side-by-side craters imprinted on this quarry today. The Korru have been using this sector as a means of collecting large quantities of said resources, and have used this super quarry as a research lab and testing grounds aswell, with powerful Anti Aircraft Technology that inhibits enemy flying units from trespassing into their territory, automatically smiting them down when they come into range of the weapons. Utilize the Tier 3 Hover and Crawler units as well as the Unit Cap of the new core to target their weak spots and capture the sector.

docs.title: Desperation Canyon
docs.text: In the face of a large canyon stretching across the vion plains, the Korru have switched to a mostly all-out air assault, allowing them to fly over the canyon with ease. Fortunately, preparing this air siege takes some time, giving you a few minutes to prepare for the assault. A warning before you head in, though, and do not take this lightly. Once the attack begins, the wave intervals get so short that waves will be sent despite enemies still being present on the map. Capture the sector and keep your will to fight. This canyon is called Desperation for a reason.

docs.title: Festering Oval
docs.text: The Korru have set up an enemy outpost on this tryphostone infested sector, where they were able to utilize tryphoton to create new compounds and tech discoveries. Capture this enemy base by using the tryphoton to your advantage and your newly unlocked unit factories and destroy the enemy core.

docs.title: Frost Mounds
docs.text: Hidden on the dark side of Thanaras, nitrogen has deposited into many frozen mounds, complete with sharp crystals that litter around them. A most unfortunate predicament would have to be the lack of tryphoton and sand in this region, slowing down production and progression by an incomprehensible amount. Use your newly researched Crumbler and Annexion Generators to get past these limitations and capture this sector.

docs.title: Green Valley
docs.text: This sector, full of decaying rocks and stones, is littered with a plentiful amount of radioactive uranium. The conditions on here may not be ideal, and the intricate siege of units that are sent wave after wave will be hard to hold back. Despite this, use the resources at your disposal to capture this sector and continue with your conquest.

docs.title: Infested Grounds
docs.text: With patches of sand craters spread out across a tryphoton-consumed landscape, this field full of pure tryphoton rock marks the beginning of an all out branch in all directions of discovery. Defend and capture this sector to unlock multiple new research branches and tech that will help you in your adventure. Beware though, the Korru won't let you get off that easily.

docs.title: Luminescent Tendrils
docs.text: Lengthy patches of tryphostone have stretched across this land not long ago. This opened pure tryphonic scars that threatened to overtake the region, if it weren't for a mysterious new growing mineral called vion, diving the land in two and preventing the two tendrils from connecting. Use your newly researched tech to conquer this sector and discover more about the inner workings of this planet.

docs.title: Maze Of Gibberish
docs.text: Groups of vion gemstones litter the surrounding area, causing blockages and winding pathways that force units to travel across a maze of distorted proportions. Patches of lone tryphoton rock are found around the sector, as the march of Vion enemies tremble the ground with their agility and power. Vion boulders are plentiful across the maze, creating illusions that trick you into thinking they are walls, but do not be deterred. Set up defense and capture this sector despite the Vion onslaught brought down upon you.

docs.title: Miscellaneon
docs.text: You may have noticed units that aren't part of the micro family tree appearing throughout different sectors to aid in your demise. These units are much more powerful than the micro units, both in shape and form, with each family having their own unique set of abilities. This sector contains all 3 biomes that depict each of the Mega units, as they're called: the vion quartz representing the flaming and quick Vion family; the frozen ice sheets being the environment in which the Shadow family thrives; and the decaying and toxic stones where the Nuclear family originates from. Capture this sector in the face of this mega onslaught and move on with your conquest.

docs.title: Perilous Stream
docs.text: This sector, although unharming at first, is a cascade of aggression and shock. Intel suggests that the Crux have adopted a new strategy of making you feel comfortable with the first few waves before bringing everything out on your vulnerable defense. Be alert, and take refuge as not one, but TWO copies of a Champion have been spotted waiting for the right moment to strike.

docs.title: Reconcite
docs.text: This sector seems to hold the key to the discovery of more research, as well as more tech on monolite. Capture it, and beware as rumors of another Champion are said to be arriving.

docs.title: Reverent Junction
docs.text: Traces of a new mineral ore have been discovered here, one that unlocks a new wave of tech that can be used for various purposes. Proceed with caution, however, as the Crux have managed to obtain this resource as well and are currently testing out the power of this new tech on you.

docs.title: River of Floe
docs.text: Despite the harsh and cold conditions of this sector, the tryphoton has somehow found a way to survive, spreading even here in the freezing climate. The nitrogenous ice, however, has managed to flow through the organic rock and create a frozen river, filled with more of these frost mounds all over the place. Unfortunately, the tryphoton has been able to consume these mounds and warp them into their own radioactive blobs, which creates a winding maze full of obstacles you need to traverse. Capture this sector by using the environment to your advantage and beware the final wave.

docs.title: Shoal Depth
docs.text: Another sector has been found harboring the strange new resource, however intel has been discovered on a new weapon the Crux have been working on that has been identified as Champions. One of these Champions are suspected to arrive on this sector any wave now, so get ready.

docs.title: Tryphoton Research Facility
docs.text: Here lies the remains of countless derelict tech that has been left to rot over decades, most of which have been destroyed. This sector also introduces tungsten and multiple other structures that you will need to survive. Capture this sector to unlock new ways to use this mysterious tryphoton resource.

docs.title: Vion Plateau
docs.text: This once barren plateau has been overtaken by this vion material, turning it into a large amalgamation of different mineral floors and resources. Proceed with caution, however, as the Korru have set up three different spawn points throughout the lengthy flat. It appears there is a new resource here that they hope they obtain, so capture this sector and discover this item before they do.

docs.title: Viridescent Plain
docs.text: Amidst the mass extinction caused by the spore breakout, a piece of land known as the Viridescent Plain has managed to sustain life, a wide array of greenery populating its surface. Perhaps it was the workings of a new resource located here that the grass was able to survive and grow, but you better have your head up because the Crux have sent yet another Champion to take you down.

docs.title: Xechas
docs.text: By some miracle of whatever mindustrian forces are out there, this small patch of land remained unaffected by the harsh conditions that destroyed and shaped Thanaras' landscape. It gives you a glimpse into what Thanaras once was; a planet full of alien life that makes no sense whatsoever, yet beautiful in its own way. With titanium-infused soils and yellow kitri plant life, this small isolated sector remains disconnected from the outside, seemingly through the power of the large derelict structure located at its core, now spent and rotting away into the flora it desperately protected.

docs.title: Zeus' Domain
docs.text: The name of this sector, called Zeus' Domain, may be in relation to the fact that the final wave will be... a shocking experience, to say the least. Mutliple biomes fused into one; tryphostone, titanar, nitrogenous ice, decayed stone, all present. Utilizing the resources scattered in all directions, defeat the onrush of waves and prove yourself ruler of this domain.

docs.title: Atom
docs.text: A flying support unit that has a healing aura, rapidly regenerating nearby allies and destroying nearby bullets.

docs.title: Delta
docs.text: Protector of the Prime Core. Equipped with guns that rapidly fire bullets and lightning cannons that burst out bolts of lightning at the enemy.

docs.title: Iota
docs.text: Equipped with a strong forcefield and a halo that fires lightning bolts. Occasionally gives units an Iota Boost Effect.

docs.title: Molecule
docs.text: Protects allies with double 360 arc shields. Has a much more powerful healing aura than its tier 1 form.

docs.title: Paradigm
docs.text: Fires vion plasma shells that explode into perpendicular plasma flames. Also has an automatic flame mount that targets nearby enemies.

docs.title: Pyrrhic
docs.text: Fires burst after burst of piercing shells at enemies. At its core is an aggressive energy field which explodes into cruxian essence missiles every few seconds.

docs.title: Scintilla
docs.text: Equipped with a strong forcefield and a halo that fires lightning bolts. Occasionally gives units an Iota Boost Effect.

docs.title: S-Immobilizer Drone
docs.text: Gives nearby allies the Soul Powered status effect, which increases their damage and reload speed. Also fires splash damaging orbs that slowly speed up as they home in on their targets.

docs.title: Sanction
docs.text: A giant flying unit, equipped with missile launchers, lightning cannons, and minigun mounts, supporting nearby units with status effects and a forcefield, as well as spawning in Novas.

docs.title: Tekton
docs.text: Assists in the construction and rebuilding of structures.

docs.title: Tenebrous
docs.text: Drops fragmenting bombs and fires rail beams.

docs.title: Vestige
docs.text: Fires heavy piercing darts and heals nearby allies with it's regen projectors. Equipped with an arc shield for protection.

docs.title: V-Assault Drone
docs.text: A flying vion drone that circles and drops plasma bombs on enemies. Occasionally boosts nearby units, inflicting them with the Paragon of Speed boost, which doubles their current speed.

docs.title: Claymore
docs.text: A well armored melee unit that has the ability to quickly regenerate it's health constantly. Strikes down nearby buildings with it's razor sharp blades, which are laced with toxins that inflict uranium decay to any enemy that dares challenge it.

docs.title: Defensive End
docs.text: A defensive unit that has 2 healing lasers and a mini force field.

docs.title: Diox
docs.text: A hovering unit that charges and fires powerful bullets.

docs.title: Division
docs.text: Fires a dart that fragments into 2 piercing lasers.

docs.title: Electron
docs.text: A hovering unit that fires rounds of piercing saw bullets.

docs.title: Epitome
docs.text: A hover craft that fires zion energized missiles which burst into flame lasers when they hit their target. Equipped with a shield arc ability.

docs.title: Fission
docs.text: Damages nearby structures by charging up and releasing lightning bolts from its body.

docs.title: Gladius
docs.text: Strikes nearby buildings with it's tough, sharp, toxin laced blades. Fires a large amount of artillery shells when attacking, as well as having a much stronger self-regeneration than its tier 1 form.

docs.title: Hatch
docs.text: Support Guardian. Fires missiles, artilliery, and a giant laser.

docs.title: Hexahedron
docs.text: fires high splash area bullets and rapid close heal. Can fly over terrain.

docs.title: Ion
docs.text: A strong hovering unit, equipped with large arm cannons, firing massive star orbs that fragment into multiple lightning missiles.

docs.title: Mirage
docs.text: Fires a salvo of heavy shadow shells at enemies, aswell as inflicting nearby enemies with soul drain and damaging close structures by rapidly ejecting shadow formula from its body, which cloaks it in a dark fog that unfortunately doesn't provide it with invisibility. Just like its previous generations, it is equipped with its own powerful forcefield.

docs.title: Monument
docs.text: Tier 2 Ground Unity Mech. Fires charged bullets at enemies, as well as plasma fire from its mounts that deal heavy damage at close range.

docs.title: Neutron
docs.text: A strong hovering unit that fires a salvo of heavy star orbs at enemies. Also equipped with phase orbs on it's shoulders that occasionally fire homing missiles.

docs.title: NeXus Omega
docs.text: The Serpullion Core Champion. Has a couple of frontal mount guns that fire rounds of bullets at enemies. Equipped with two powerful cannons that blast omega shells, bullets that fragment into artillery, missile, laser, and lightning types resepctively. One final addition is the powerful NeXus Ring surrounding its coreal cells, which gives itself and nearby units temporary invincibility, aswell as lightning strikes at random directions.

docs.title: N-Artillery Drone
docs.text: Launches an artillery barrage at enemies from long distances. Equipped with self-regeneration.

docs.title: N-Support Drone
docs.text: Inflicts nearby allies with the Nuclear Healing status effect, which gives them rapid self-regeneration. Equipped with a small cannon mount on its back but has a weaker regeneration ability than its Nuclear counterparts.

docs.title: Nucleon
docs.text: An incredibly powerful hover mech, equipped with two chest cannons that fire lightning shells, and two massive arm cannons bursting out piercing lightning darts.

docs.title: Defensive End
docs.text: A defensive unit that has 2 healing lasers and a mini force field.

docs.title: One handed Dagger
docs.text: A dagger created solely for the purpose of the 100 daggers vs 1 reign challenge. My arm... my arm is gone...

docs.title: Panzoe
docs.text: Fires missiles at enemies. They knockback enemies and stun them for a while. Multiple Acacias can render one huge enemy useless.

docs.title: Paragon
docs.text: A hovering unit that burns nearby enemies by rapid firing plasma flames.

docs.title: Proton
docs.text: A hover mech that fires star orbs at enemies.

docs.title: Rift
docs.text: Charges up a powerful lightning laser that fragments into smaller lasers when

docs.title: Rupture
docs.text: Blasts enemies with shrapnel bursts and mini lasers on it's mounts.

docs.title: Ruse
docs.text: Fires missiles at enemies. They knockback enemies and stun them for a while. Multiple Acacias can render one huge enemy useless.

docs.title: Shade
docs.text: Slowly trudges along terrain, firing homing star orbs that deal splash damage to a wide area. Equipped with a small forcefield that protects itself from oncoming attacks.

docs.title: S-Striker Drone
docs.text: A hovering unit that charges and fires powerful bullets.

docs.title: Shallow
docs.text: Capable of flying at low depth, undetectable by anti-air craft but seen by ground turrets. Fires flak at enemies, along with darts that pierce through defenses.

docs.title: Shrine
docs.text: Tier 1 Ground Unity Mech. Fires a salvo of flak bullets at enemies. Also equipped with 2 mini mounts that fire regular shells for added supression.

docs.title: Spatha
docs.text: Armed with two deadly razor claws that eject powerful piercing shells, which release a barrage of artillery bombs as it slashes through the air. Has a much more powerful self-regeneration ability than its previous counterparts.

docs.title: Tauron
docs.text: A hovering unit that charges and fires powerful bullets.

docs.title: V-Supressor Drone
docs.text: A legged vion drone that fires homing plasma missiles at enemies. Immune to all slowing effects as well as possessing an arc shield.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/smolkeys/new-console-hardline Stars 13 Last updated 2026-02-19T14:17:45Z

The officially acknowledged port of New Console for v147-above.

Adds a console UI superior to the built-in one and the ones provided by any other mods.

User-friendly interface, an actual code editor with syntax highlighting and indentation guides, assistance and more:

A good log panel, execution history - all of that is included in this mod.

In addition to the console, this mod offers:

  • An ability to save as many scripts as you want and to either execute them or copy to the console

  • An ability to execute scripts when certain events get fired

  • A full-blown file browser (be careful, you can cause real harm with that!)

See README.md for more info.

docs.title: Large Crystal Pod
docs.text:
Protects structures from enemy projectiles. Creates a large burst of crystallization upon destruction.

This crystallization can damage your own team's blocks, so do not place it next to allied structures. Placing these near eachother could cause a chain reaction.

docs.text:

This lightning can damage your own team's blocks, so do not place it next to allied structures. Placing these near eachother could cause a chain reaction.
