Serpulo Resources → Copper, Lead, Coal, Titanium, Thorium

Erekir Resources → Beryllium, Tungsten, Oxide, Carbide

Serpulo Units → Flare, Dagger, Mace squads

Erekir Units → Stell, Locus, Merui squads

Boosts → Skip waves or heal all buildings

Pets → 13 pets for passive income

Pet Missions → Send pets for guaranteed rewards

Auction House → Bid on exclusive items

Converter → Exchange Serpulo ↔ Erekir resources

Crafting → Craft advanced materials

Cosmetics → Visual effects and badges

Prestige → Reset for permanent power

Favorites → Star your favorite items

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

The more you spend, the more VIP EXP you get. Level up your VIP status and earn coins way faster. At max level (VIP 5), you get 6x coins and 25% discount on everything!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PC:

  1. Press K key anywhere

  2. Type /shop in chat

  3. Click Shop button in pause menu

Mobile:

  1. Tap the SHOP [K] button on the right side of your screen

Your coins, VIP level, and Shop level are always shown in the UI!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💡 Pro Tips:

• Check the auction house regularly

docs.title: Voltaic Chamber

docs.title: Vanadium Carbide Wall
docs.text: An immortal wall, made to withstand the test of time. Can last almost forever against group of enemies.

docs.title: Harvester bay

docs.title: Imperial Railgun

docs.title: Biomass Pipe

docs.title: Hatchery

docs.title: Biomass reactor

docs.title: Lotus panel

docs.title: Neocell generator
docs.text: Uses neocell to generate energy, dont bother asking how and why.

docs.title: Extractor

docs.title: Mass cultivator

docs.title: Zinc extractor

docs.title: Artillery Turret

docs.title: Flak accelerator

docs.title: Impaler Cannon
docs.text: A Giant cannon designed for destroying big units. Require Biomass to use, its range is reduced in exchange for high damage.

docs.title: Oarch
docs.text: Shoot exploding biomass that deal splash damage to enemy.

docs.title: Sentinel

docs.title: Spore garrison

docs.title: Suppressor

docs.title: Acidifier Module

docs.title: BioSil

docs.title: Carbine composite

docs.title: Nanite alloy

docs.title: Zinc

Property Value Repository https://github.com/uujuju1/steam-works Stars 48 Last updated 2026-06-25T17:36:49Z

No nowhere has nothing anywhere.

docs.title: Blast Furnace
docs.text: Melts iron fused with coke under a stream of Ozone to produce Bloom in large batches. Produces a small quantity of Slag as byproduct.

docs.title: Coke Oven
docs.text: An oven that is hot enough to turn Graphite into Coke. Requires Water cooling to function

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: Grinds metals that are later oxidized and combined into thermite.

docs.title: Engine Smelter
docs.text: Reacts Sand with Solvent to produce Silicon.

docs.title: Thermal Exchanger
docs.text: Heats Water into Steam using Thorium with Lead as a byproduct. Avoid the buildup of Steam or Lead, as well as the lack of Water.

docs.title: Water Ball Mill
docs.text: Separates water into Hydrogen and Ozone through force.

docs.title: All Source
docs.text: Creates infinite liquids, items, power and heat. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Belt
docs.text: A conveyor whose speed depends on rotation.

docs.title: Compact Container
docs.text: A small container able to hold some items.

docs.title: Core: Bunker
docs.text: A core built to stand its ground, featuring a purely defensive core unit.

docs.title: Core: Mole
docs.text: A core specialized in underground exploration. Digs through the ground instead of launching.

docs.title: Core: Scaffold
docs.text: A hollow imitation of a core, functions as a makeshift launch platform, has low build cost but lacks item capacity.

docs.title: Grind Lamp
docs.text: A grindstone that pulverizes and ignites coke, producing a bright light.

docs.title: Lamparine
docs.text: A torch that combusts ozone and hydrogen, producing a bright light.

docs.title: Lava Lamp
docs.text: A can with a set of Aluminium mirrors that spread the glow of Slag over an area.

docs.title: Repair Station
docs.text: Repairs nearby structures. Cannot repair more than 5 buildings at the same time.

docs.title: Liquid Distributor
docs.text: Larger version of a conduit router. Able to hold a considerable amount liquid.

docs.title: Mechanical Conduit Tunnel
docs.text: Allows crossing of liquids under buildings and terrain.

docs.title: Adjustable Gear Train
docs.text: A set of gearshifts that allows speed to be multiplied up to a factor of 10.

docs.title: Carnot Engine
docs.text: A configurable source of rotation. Sandbox only.

docs.title: Clutch
docs.text: Allows 2 separate axles to be connected without locking one to another.

docs.title: Combustion Engine
docs.text: Exploits the properties of Solvent to drive a piston mechanism.

docs.title: Convection Turbine
docs.text: Uses the vapour of hot water coming from vents to generate torque. Builds up water over time.

docs.title: Crankshaft
docs.text: The core of the Crankshaft Mechanism. Will spin according to the Pistons attached to its sides.

docs.title: Evaporator
docs.text: Lets Solvent evaporate quickly and passes the rising vapour through fans that generate a small amount of torque.

docs.title: Flywheel
docs.text: Resists change in speed due to its high moment of inertia.

docs.title: Hand Wheel
docs.text: Allows for manual torque input to an axle using a cogwheel.

docs.title: Large Overhead Belt
docs.text: An upgraded version of the Overhead Belt. Bigger and has more range, but halves the speed when connected to a regular overhead belt.

docs.title: Mechanical Governor
docs.text: Applies a friction force if the speed surpasses a certain target speed.

docs.title: Overhead Belt
docs.text: A chain connecting 2 different axles. Can cross over terrain.

docs.title: Piston
docs.text: A piston for a Crankshaft Mechanism. Dumps Steam away unless facing the sides of a Crankshaft.

docs.title: Axle Gearbox
docs.text: A larger block that transfers angular momentum between 2 parallel axles.

docs.title: Axle Transmission
docs.text: A larger block that transfers angular momentum between 2 parallel axles. But the bigger axle will always do half of what the smaller axle does.

docs.title: Spring
docs.text: Holds rotation that can be accessed using a payload loader/unloader.

docs.title: Water Wheel
docs.text: A set of paddles that rotate according to the water current. Needs to be placed in water while facing a waterfall.

docs.title: Axle Router
docs.text: A router that splits angular momentum between two perpendicular axles.

docs.title: Axle
docs.text: A spinning bar able to transfer angular momentum.

docs.title: Artesian Well
docs.text: A machine capable of dragging water out of the ground.

docs.title: Auger
docs.text: Extracts resources out of the ground below. More efficient than a Hydraulic Drill.

docs.title: Casting Outlet
docs.text: Casts slag into a specific metal, other materials are discarded. Needs to face away from a Liquid Basin with slag.

docs.title: Hydraulic Drill
docs.text: Extracts resources from the ground around itself.

docs.title: Mechanical Bore
docs.text: Extracts resources from the walls on it's front.

docs.title: Mechanical Fracker
docs.text: Extracts resources from cracks in the wall or in hard rocks.

docs.title: Pumpjack
docs.text: Extracts Slag from deep magma chambers. uses Slag Plugs as an outlet.

docs.title: Quarry
docs.text: Digs out chunks of rock out of the ground.

docs.title: Imber
docs.text: Ignites and fires clumps of burning coke, releasing hot embers on the ground.

docs.title: Assembler Arm
docs.text: An extension of the Mechanical assembler. Boosts unit production.

docs.title: Assembly Outpost
docs.text: Assembles units using a welding arm. Can assemble larger units than the Mechanical Assembler.

docs.title: Construction Manifold
docs.text: Prints small blocks. Requires a Mechanical Arm to output payloads.

docs.title: Courier Port
docs.text: Transports small payloads between ports using balloons.

docs.title: Deconstruction Manifold
docs.text: Salvages small payloads. Requires a Mechanical Arm to input payloads.

docs.title: Mechanical Arm
docs.text: Transports small payloads between two specified positions.

docs.title: Mechanical Payload Loader
docs.text: Loads items, liquids or rotation onto proper payloads.

docs.title: Mechanical Payload Unloader
docs.text: Unloads items, liquids or rotation from payloads.

docs.title: Bloom
docs.text: Unfinished steel product, can withstand great loads applied to it.

docs.title: Coke
docs.text: Carbon rich material, used as a general purpose fuel.

docs.title: Iron
docs.text: A material mainly used in liquid related machinery.

docs.title: Thermite
docs.text: Powerful explosive that is able to burn to great temperatures if ignited.

docs.title: Verdigris
docs.text: A common resource used in many transportation builds.

docs.title: Solvent
docs.text: A light blue fluid used to extract oxygen.

docs.title: Labirinto Abandonado
docs.text: Here lies a giant derelict structure, function still unclear. Various pitfalls can be found, with some reaching hot bedrock. Use the new sources of Slag to uncover and explore new technologies.

docs.title: Bay of Embers
docs.text:
The source of the nearby body of solvent can be found here, feeding it through this bay. Untouched by The Maze.

The Enemy has a strong presence due to the exposed aluminium and slag, which made them create new technologies that may be of interest.

Research Bloom and its related tech to remove the Enemy presence.

  • The Enemy may bring reinforcements coming from the bay as their cores are destroyed.

docs.title: Broken Corridors
docs.text:
A small grid of Slag Plugs cuts across the terrain. Even if most ofthe facility was destroyed, some sets of plugs remain and could be helpful to gather resources. Scraps of payload transport technology are present, researching it allows access to the plugs of the collapsed facility.

  • The initial area has a low concentration of both Verdigris and Iron.

docs.title: Cavern
docs.text:
This is a piece of a larger facility, cut off by collapsed blocks of concrete. The structure is slowly decaying due to the infiltration of water. Enemy activity has been found here, though it's limited and sensitive to some external phenomena.

  • Enemy units receive damage from light sources.
  • Reduced visibility due to the lack of light sources.

docs.title: Crevasse
docs.text: The geometry of this place allows for temporary cover of the scout helicopters. Research some basic infrastructure while the enemy doesn't know about your presence.

docs.title: Live Storm
docs.text:
A facility surrounded by a giant body of solvent. Function unknown.

This island is a point of interest of the enemy despite its relatively common resources, as evidenced by the existing remains. They developed a machine capable of patching up damages in nearby buildings, recovering that technology can be useful, because it seems to be what allowed the remains to barely withstand something that came out of the lightning rod matrix within this island's facility.

Extreme weather may be found within these lands. Be careful.

docs.title: The Delta
docs.text:
An enemy base sits deactivated next to the delta.

It will take some time for its unit factory to start up, giving you time to set up defenses.

Research the Mechanical Assembler and use it to create your own helicopters to take down this base.pt:

docs.title: Flammable
docs.text: Covered in a reactive substance, will ignite if there is too much light present.

docs.title: Courier
docs.text: What are you doing in this screen, there's nothing here for you.

docs.title: Psi
docs.text: The core unit fo the Core: Bunker. Able to repair nearby blocks and units.

docs.title: Rho
docs.text: The core unit of the Core: Mole. Able to float over all terrain.

docs.title: Soar
docs.text: A small helicopter with a pair of guns.

docs.title: Volare
docs.text: A helicopter that fires 2 sparking plasma orbs along with a stream of Slag.

docs.title: Ballistra
docs.text: A tank with a railgun that fires piercing projectiles.

docs.title: Lambda
docs.text: The core unit of the Core: Scaffold. Able to walk over all terrain.

docs.title: Wisp
docs.text: A hovering machine with a burning core. Throws combusting debris. Capable of going over terrain.

A mindustry mod i made out of boredom because i really really liked the original Tower Defense mod by AForgetfulness.

docs.title: Heatproof Research Station
docs.text: Uses iodine capsules to create research runes from ambient energy fluxes.

docs.title: Rune Solidifier
docs.text: Uses different fluxes to combine a few research runes into more powerful ones.

docs.title: Burner
docs.text: Destroys any item or liquid it receives.

docs.title: Gas Duct
docs.text: Transports items in stacks of two using a closed iodine gas cycle to move them forward.

docs.title: Teleporter
docs.text: Teleports items over large ranges using ambient energy fluxes.

docs.title: Core: capsule
docs.text: Core of the base, has high health but is vulnerable to crushing. Once destroyed, the sector is lost.

docs.title: Heat Resistant Liquid Router
docs.text: Sends liquids it receives out in different directions.

docs.title: Flux Generator
docs.text: Consumes turret flux capsules to make a good amount of power, but also outputs slag. If it fills with too much slag, it'll melt down.

docs.title: Variable Generator
docs.text: Consumes power flux capsules to make a varying amount of power. also outputs slag.

docs.title: Iodine Encapsulator
docs.text: Extracts idione from the depths of the planet and puts it in convenient little capsules.

docs.title: Supreme Flux Capturer
docs.text: Captures every flux, extracts iodine, and occasionally produces a research rune, and more rarely, solidified research rune.

docs.title: Knocker Turret
docs.text: Fires high-knockback bullets made of iodine and energy.

docs.title: Needle Turret
docs.text: Fires fast piercing turret flux projectiles at ennemy targets. Can also fire long-lasting piercing missiles using research runes.

docs.title: Orb Turret
docs.text: Fires a slow armor-piercing orb over large distances at ennemy targets.

docs.title: Defender Turret
docs.text: Fires artillery shells that leave motion-blocking shields behind after impact using defense flux.

docs.title: Supremacy: Iodine
docs.text: Fires powerful fragmenting knockback bullets at ennemy targets. Requires iodine capsules and power to function.

docs.title: Supremacy: Turret flux
docs.text: An heavy machine gun that fires bullets wich create more bullets on hit.

docs.title: Supremacy: O R B
docs.text: Fires a massive orb wich leaves a mine field behind itself. Pierces lower health units.

docs.title: Supremacy:  Defender
docs.text: Fires a massive piercing laser at ennemy units wich can also heal friendly blocks. Also protects itself with an arc shield while firing.

docs.title: Iodine Capsule
docs.text: Iodine extracted from the depths of the molten zone and put in a convenient capsule.

docs.title: Molten Research Rune
docs.text: Used for researching all stuff from the molten zone.

docs.title: Turret Flux Capsule
docs.text: A compressed specific type of energy that allows turrets to function.

docs.title: Power Flux Capsule
docs.text: A compressed specific type of energy that allows power blocks to function.

docs.title: Defense Flux Capsule
docs.text: A compressed specific type of energy that allows defense blocks to function.

docs.title: Solidified Research Rune
docs.text: A lot of materials were used to re-solidify a research rune and allow for the use in more powerful turrets.

docs.title: Funnel
docs.text: A sector that contains multiple ennemy drop points that then all converge into a single path towards the core. Researching the needle turret will be necessary to destroy the larger groups of ennemies that will come for you.

docs.title: Crossing
docs.text: Two paths intersect each other here, and so double the ennemies will come, but you have double the cores. Use the Orb Turret to defend against the larger and stronger waves.

docs.title: Tightrope
docs.text: A powerful guardian has been detected here. Researching the defense flux capturer and the teleporter will be necessary to get what will be needed to beat it and the large waves that will go along with it.

docs.title: Reroute
docs.text: This sector contains a lot of very strong units, including a cleaner guardian on its final wave. Researching the Supremacy: Iodine turret and producing re-solidified research runes will be necessary to stand a chance.

docs.title: Gridlock
docs.text: A gridded pattern of bridges. Large groups of units as well as large ennemy tanks have been detected. Research the needle supremacy and destroy them.

docs.title: Divergence
docs.text: A diverging bridge. A bunch of strong ennemy guardians have been detected including a potential flying guardian that will need to be taken down as fast as possible.

docs.title: Protector
docs.text: Builds structures and helps with destroying ennemy units to avoid the destruction of the Capsule core.

docs.title: Beamer
docs.text: A small and light tank equipped with a singular laser turret.

docs.title: Castle
docs.text: A massive destructive mech equipped with twin shotguns. Completly invincible from the sides without using laser weaponry.

docs.title: Cleaner
docs.text: A massive tank, upgrade of the crusher. Deals massive amounts of ram damage and has a short-range iodine flame beam.

docs.title: Crusher
docs.text: Rams into blocks to damage them, although it also causes damage to its core, wich causes it to explode after a bit.

docs.title: Demolisher
docs.text: A mechanical worm that crushes anything under itself with ease.

docs.title: Soaker
docs.text: A powerful mech with really high health. Fires homing bullets at nearby targets.

docs.title: Spearhead
docs.text: A massive tank, upgrade of the beamer. Posseses twin laser turrets and a larger central one to destroy anything in its path swiftly.

  • This mod adds in 1 or 2 higher tiers of vanilla blocks. Mod is still in development. More contents coming soon.

  • Erekir is cooking

docs.title: Omega Press
docs.text: Compresses coal into graphite. Requires extra water as coolant.

docs.title: Silicon Forge
docs.text: Refines silicon from sand and coal, using blast compound as extra power. More efficient in hot locations.

docs.title: Oven
docs.text: Smelts sand and lead into metaglass, using pyratite as an additional heat source.

docs.title: Furnace
docs.text: Smelts sand and lead into metaglass, using blast compound as an additional heat source.

docs.title: Plastanium Flattener
docs.text: Produces plastanium from oil, spores and titanium.

docs.title: Plastanium Synthesizer
docs.text: Produces plastanium from oil, spores, lead and titanium.

docs.title: Phase Composer
docs.text: Synthesizes phase fabric from thorium and sand. Requires cryofluid as coolant.

docs.title: Phase Fabricator
docs.text: Synthesizes phase fabric from thorium, sand and silicon. Requires extra cryofluid as coolant.

docs.title: Surge Furnace
docs.text: Fuses silicon, titanium, graphite and lead into surge alloy, using pyratite as an additional heat source. More efficient in hot locations.

docs.title: Alloy Forge
docs.text: Fuses silicon, titanium, thorium and graphite into surge alloy, using blast compound as an additional heat source. More efficient in hot locations.

docs.title: Cryofluid Blender
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder to produce cryofluid. Requires extra lead to boost production.

docs.title: Cryofluid Amalgamator
docs.text: Mixes water and fine titanium powder to produce cryofluid. Requires extra lead and silicon to boost production. Also produces antifreeze.

docs.title: Pyratite Blender
docs.text: Mixes coal, lead and sand into pyratite. Requires extra oil to boost production.

docs.title: Pyratite Forge
docs.text: Mixes coal, lead and sand into pyratite. Requires more extra oil to boost production.

docs.title: Compound Blender
docs.text: Bigger blast mixer. Requires oil for faster blast production.

docs.title: Blast Forge
docs.text: Bigger and faster blast mixer. Similar input to Tier 2.

docs.title: Burner
docs.text: A bigger melter, uses coal as fuel for faster scrap melting.

docs.title: Molten Scrap Extractor
docs.text: Extracts large amount of slag from molten scrap. Pyratite is required as better burning fuel.

docs.title: Large Disassembler
docs.text: An advanced separator, does not consume scrap but use large amount of slag.

docs.title: Spore Crusher
docs.text: Bigger spore press, crushes more spore for better oil output.

docs.title: Synthetic Compactor
docs.text: Tier 3 spore press, requires fast spore input to get this working.

docs.title: Shredder
docs.text: Works like Grinder, just uses more water.

docs.title: Mass Coal Extractor
docs.text: Tier 3 coal centrifuge, requires additional spore pods.

docs.title: Tier 1 Combined Wall
docs.text: A combination of copper and titanium walls.

docs.title: Huge Tier 1 Combined Wall
docs.text: A combination of copper and titanium walls.

docs.title: Tier 2 Combined Wall
docs.text: A combination of thoriums and plastaniums walls. Can absorb laser and eletric arc, also functions as mender but heals slowly.

docs.title: Huge Tier 2 Combined
docs.text: A combination of thoriums and plastaniums walls. Can absorb laser and eletric arc, also functions as mender but heals slowly.

docs.title: Tier 3 Combined Wall
docs.text: A combination of surge alloy and phase fabric walls. Walls are now shielded, reflects bullets and release electric arc when damaged.

docs.title: Huge Tier 3 Combined Wall
docs.text: A combination of surge alloy and phase fabric walls. Walls are now shielded, reflects bullets and release electric arc when damaged.

docs.title: Colossal Lead wall
docs.text: Made of the weak, heavy metal. Slight armor and cost requirements increase from sheer density. Needs integrity reinforcements. 5x5.

docs.title: Gigantic Lead wall
docs.text: Made of the weak, heavy metal. Slight armor and cost requirements increase from sheer density. 4x4.

docs.title: Huge Lead wall
docs.text: Made of the weak, heavy metal. Slight armor and cost requirements increase from sheer density. 3x3.

docs.title: Large Lead wall
docs.text: Made of the weak, heavy metal. Slight armor and cost requirements increase from sheer density. 2x2.

docs.title: Lead wall
docs.text: Made of the weak, heavy metal. Slight armor and cost requirements increase from sheer density.

docs.title: Colossal Metaglass wall
docs.text: Made of the hard, yet brittle material. Explodes into fragments when broken. Needs integrity reinforcements. 5x5.

docs.title: Gigantic Metaglass wall
docs.text: Made of the hard, yet brittle material. Explodes into fragments when broken. 4x4.

docs.title: Huge Metaglass wall
docs.text: Made of the hard, yet brittle material. Explodes into fragments when broken. 3x3.

docs.title: Large Metaglass wall
docs.text: Made of the hard, yet brittle material. Explodes into fragments when broken. 2x2.

docs.title: Metaglass wall
docs.text: Made of the hard, yet brittle material. Explodes into fragments when broken.

docs.title: Colossal Refurbished Scrap wall
docs.text: Made of scrap and reinforcement materials. Good as an emergency defense against unexpected attacks. Needs further integrity reinforcements. 5x5.

docs.title: Gigantic Refurbished Scrap wall
docs.text: Made of scrap and reinforcement materials. Good as an emergency defense against unexpected attacks. 4x4.

docs.title: Huge Refurbished Scrap wall
docs.text: Made of scrap and reinforcement materials. Good as an emergency defense against unexpected attacks. 3x3.

docs.title: Large Refurbished Scrap wall
docs.text: Made of scrap and reinforcement materials. Good as an emergency defense against unexpected attacks. 2x2.

docs.title: Refurbished Scrap wall
docs.text: Made of scrap and reinforcement materials. Good as an emergency defense against unexpected attacks.

docs.title: Colossal Silicon wall
docs.text: Made of the semi-conductive material. Can induce poor electric retaliation upon getting damaged. Needs integrity reinforcements. 5x5.

docs.title: Gigantic Silicon wall
docs.text: Made of the semi-conductive material. Can induce poor electric retaliation upon getting damaged. 4x4.

docs.title: Huge Silicon wall
docs.text: Made of the semi-conductive material. Can induce poor electric retaliation upon getting damaged. 3x3.

docs.title: Large Silicon wall
docs.text: Made of the semi-conductive material. Can induce poor electric retaliation upon getting damaged. 2x2.

docs.title: Silicon wall
docs.text: Made of the semi-conductive material. Can induce poor electric retaliation upon getting damaged.

docs.title: Alloy Conveyor
docs.text: Transport items in large batches. Quite armored too.

docs.title: Large Mass Driver
docs.text: Transport large amount of items in one shot. Slower reload than the smaller variant in exchange for longer range.

docs.title: Huge Distribution Driver
docs.text: Last mass driver tier. Requires cryofluidas coolant to operate properly.

docs.title: Mender Dome
docs.text: Effectively repairs blocks in a large radius. Requires phase fabric and silicon to operate.

docs.title: Overdrive Tower
docs.text: Massively boost the speed of blocks in its radius.

docs.title: Large Shield Projector
docs.text: Creates a large octagonal force field around it, more effective than its smaller variant. Input are not optional.

docs.title: Advanced Defense System
docs.text: Last tier of force projector tree, extremely effective. Input are not optional.

docs.title: Core: Fortification
docs.text: The ultimate core for your base. Heavily armored, massive capacity, increased units capacity.

docs.title: Armored Warehouse
docs.text: Store massive amount of items, expands storage when placed next to the core.

docs.title: Gigantic Liquid Pump
docs.text: Pumps and outputs huge amount of liquids.

docs.title: Liquid Reservoir
docs.text: Store significant amount of liquid. Built with thorium protection plates, has decent resistance against damage.

docs.title: Surge Network
docs.text: Tier 3 surge tower, used for really far range power connection.

docs.title: Medium Battery
docs.text: Tier 2 of small battery, has better power capacity.

docs.title: Huge Battery
docs.text: Tier 2 of large battery, really high power capacity.

docs.title: Burner Generator
docs.text: Advanced burner, creates more power from flammable items. Requires differential generator to be reseached first.

docs.title: Thermal Power Plant
docs.text: Similar to Thermal Generator but bigger and more efficiency.

docs.title: Advanced RTG Generator
docs.text: Similar to RTG Generator but bigger and more efficiency.

docs.title: Medium Solar Panel
docs.text: An upgraded version of small solar panel.

docs.title: Huge Solar Panel
docs.text: Last tier in solar panel upgrade tree, produces considerable amount of power.

docs.title: Radioactive Reactor
docs.text: Uses thorium and cryofluid for high power generation. Explose violently if lacks coolant.

docs.title: Nuclear Power Plant
docs.text: Tier 3 thorium reactor. Higher efficiency and more well armored. Uses extra phase fabric as a boost to startup power generations.

docs.title: Surge Plasma Reactor
docs.text: Uses surge alloys and blast compound to produce massive amount of powers, requires kickstart power.

docs.title: Oil Combustion Generator
docs.text: Uses oil as input for starter power production.

docs.title: Colossal Drill
docs.text: The last tier of drills you get. Extracts gigantic amount of resources. Requires cryfluid to operate.

docs.title: Upgraded Water Drill
docs.text: Extracts more underground water than its smaller version. Used in locations with little surface water.

docs.title: Mass Groundwater Extractor
docs.text: Extracts underground water at high rate. Used in locations with no surface water available.

docs.title: Spore Harvester
docs.text: Collects spore from atmospheres more efficiently than smaller version.

docs.title: Biomass Incubator
docs.text: Collects and produce spore pods at huge amount. Incubator needs a lot of water input to work. Caution: Produces so much spore pods when placed on spore tiles that it cannot unload fast enough by itself. Use unloaders to help.

docs.title: Advanced Oil Rig
docs.text: Produces large amount of oil. Inputs are unchanged.

docs.title: Mass Oil Extractor
docs.text: Produces significant amount of oil. Requires at least one tier 1 thorium reactor to receive enough power.

docs.title: Antifreeze
docs.text: Secondary output from Tier 3 cryofluid mixer. Count as coolant for turret as well as Plasma Reactor and Nuclear Power Plant.

docs.title: Upsilon
docs.text: Tier 4 core unit. Defends the Fortification core from enemies. Builds stucture. Armed with high damage missles launcher.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/bttodi/virtuality Stars 16 Last updated 2026-05-26T09:31:50Z

A mod centered around fighting bosses, with a focus on pattern-based attacks. Entirely detached from Mindustry's traditional gameplay loop - The Virtuality Archives restrains the player in a measly vessel and pits them against encoded entities. Does not utilize scripts or Java, seeking to explore the technical scope of (H)JSON and MLOG. Best experienced with a mouse and keyboard.

Currently features 6/7 planned bosses in the campaign - Candor, Ardent & Argent, Pandemonium, Misanthrope, Nyx, and Alluvion.

[i] In the campaign, Misanthrope's sector currently does not behave as intended for the latest stable build. Play the sector in Custom Game or build 157.4.

Property Value Repository https://github.com/sunkenmelody/rospule Stars 21 Last updated 2026-06-05T16:53:43Z

A personal Serpulo campaign rework map pack with personal minor rebalancing on few blocks.

This mod's gameplay is based on NORMAL difficulty and cannot be changed.

Contains 45+ sectors!

All maps are created under Serpulo environment and are vanilla compatible on terrain , wavesets and most contents.

Have fun.

Update log: V0.5 -- Stage 5-1 to Stage 5-5 added.

--Credits--

Coding:Everdusk22

Sector icon:Seabed

Music selection:しかみど☆

Bundle Polish:Gort
Everything Begins Welcome to Rospule, this is a parallel universe of Serpulo. Collect resources and grasp technologies to gain footstand.

Disadvantage The previous sectors' captures aroused enemy's attention. An immense enemy unit force is heading directly to reclaim control of these sectors. A tough fight is estimated in the chilling valley's exit. Prepare for the worst and survive from the flooding attacks at all costs. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Frozen Passage This chilling place is closer to enemy activities. Set up automated defenses to ward off enemy patrols.
Taiga A massive frozen pinewood forest lies here. Hostile aerial units detected in the approaching attack. 「Guardian Presence」
Lowlands A low-altitude riverbed with fossilized coals nearby. Gather coal and start to learn the usage of graphite press.
Crossing Point Two different paths cross together, forming into an unpredictable terrain. Learn to use new turrets, figure out enemy paths and successfully defend the sector.

Snowpiled Coalfield Ages ago, the remains of rich plants near the riverbed transformed into gigantic patches of coal. Start using coal to generate power and learn how to use the arc turret. 「Guardian Presence」
Headwaters The headwaters of a flowing stream. Use kilns to produce metaglass, make usage of water via pumps.

Nonfreezing Lake This place is closer to warmer sections. A big round lake that never freezes lies here. Resources are scarcer than previous sectors. Try using pumps to boost the drills to make them mine faster.
Gusty Canyons Multiple rivers flow through this sector, forming into a complex terrain. Use menders to repair damaged blocks. Produce pyratite as advanced ammo for hails. 「Guardian Presence」
Transition Section Closer to warmer areas, the chilling valley's exit leads to a tight sandy passage. Use silicon smelters to refine silicon from sand and coal.

Retaliation The recent sectors' captures completely irritated the enemies. The destruction of their cores has resulted in them sending a huge wave of retaliation units to retake previous sectors. It must be stopped before the units succeed. Prepare for an immense battle at the foot of the mountains. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Scrapyard Remnants of once several large structures detected. No enemy patrols detected around this sector. Produce enough silicon to depart further. 「Production Sector」

Karst Landscape A sector with moderate enemy amounts. Waters eroded the walls and turned this valley into a beautiful scenery. Some advanced units are coming to this sector. Set up stronger defenses. 「Guardian Presence」
Initial Conflict Enemy bases detected in this sector. Start constructing units to attack enemies proactively. Destroy the enemy cores to take them down.

Ancient Rampart During old times, several conflicts took place here. A frontier rampart was set up for defense, reduced into scraps nowadays. Melt scrap into slag and use it as liquid ammo for wave turret.

Tributary Traveling through the dark sand valley, a long river flows through this sector. Advanced generator unlocked, capable of generating more power. Rospule is getting night times, solar panels are less efficient now. 「Guardian Presence」 「Night Times」
Micro Outpost A set of multiple enemy bases blocked the way to proceed. Use air factory to produce flares to take out the cores.

Outbreak Incubator Once a gigantic facility that produces synthesised bioproducts. During the old war ,this place was abandoned, the spores went out and spread widely. Retake the ancient biomass technologies. Scanners detected only air units in the upcoming attacks. Survive without scatter's assistance.

Exhausted Quarry Mass extractions of this sectors' ore resources resulted in the exhaustion of copper and lead. Produce monos to drill the basic resources automatically. Insectoid units detected, capable of directly walking through thin walls. 「Guardian Presence」

Minefield During old wars, a vast minefield was deployed at the entrance of the mountains. Repair them to use as defense against enemies. All turrets are unavailable , try to survive using shock mines and units only.

Dilemma Looks like the enemies have taken one step ahead this time. An enormous large troop of enemy units have arrived at the sandy karst in advance. They are indeed going to take revenge this time. Another troop of enemy reinforcement is approaching from rear. Prepare for a terrible pincer attack from 2 sides. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」
Sharp Crevice Deeper into the mountains, spaces are tighter in this crevice. Titanium ores detected. Use pneumatic drills to mine titanium. 「Night Times」

Leeward Side The ridge blocks the gales on the other side. This mountainside's resources are scarce and far away from estimated landing area. Monos are dispatched to help gather basic resources. A higher level core upgrade is available. 「Guardian Presence」

Giant Dam A giant Gravity Dam was established here ages ago. Enemies took over the region and set up defenses across the dam. Reconstruct the dagger units into stronger maces to destroy enemy defenses. 「Night Times」

Rusty Railtrack A long railway was set up here with unknown purpose. Sensors detected enemies are splitting into 2 paths trying to siege the sector. Naval unit presence detected. Secure the sector with great caution ,use salvo turrets to fend off enemies.
Hotsprings Strong thermals from underground erupted into hotsprings. Sensors detect scarcity in coals. Use salvo and parallax turrets to fend off enemies. 「Guardian Presence」

Observatory A flat space near the summit. Once there was an observatory used for watching stars, now abandoned. Enemies took over this relic and built a base away from low grounds. Heavy anti-air defenses detected. Produce Novas to boost across the terrain to launch a surprise attack.

Petroleum Chasm Shales are rich in petroleum resource here. Coals are absent. Centrifuge coals from oil. Advanced graphite processing technique unlocked. Polies are deployed to assist for building. 「Production Sector」

Collapsed Massifs During an earthquake, a landslide covered some derelicts beneath. Larger quantites of enemies are approaching. Do not underestimate them. Resources are scattered, hard to route to core, polies will be helpful here. 「Guardian Presence」
Wavecut Cliff Strong waves of sea eroded the shores and formed a sharp steep cliff. Larger quantites of enemy naval units are approaching. A larger version of drill unlocked.

Turbulence These damp islands will be a cruel battleground against the enemies' prime naval fleet. The invasion behaviour aroused enemy to deploy all naval units patrolling globalwise. This will be an unprecedented harsh cruel battle, stay attentive and fully focused. 「⚠Massive Enemy Offense⚠」

Tidal Flat A narrow delta lies at the downstreams with damp grounds. Naval units are coming, use containers to work as ammo buffer and use them to increase core storage capacity. Learn the usage of unloaders.

Seaside Promenade Following along the coastlines, a narrow sandy passage provided a path for enemies to approach towards the estimated core landing position. Resources are hard to gather and transfer across islands. Ripple turrets will help with long-range firepower. 「Guardian Presence」
Archipelago Takeover Several islands are under enemy control for now. These bases have fatal weakspots. Construct naval units and horizons to take out them. 「Night Times」

Forsaken Shipyard Once one of the largest shipyards in the seas, now abandoned. This pier has no titanium ores around at all. Construct Separators to refine titanium out of scrap. 「Production Sector」 「Night Times」

Floating Wreckage Remnants of broken metal structures are floating in the middle of ocean. The barren metal pieces are the only option to land on. No resources detected, use loadouts from launched core to make units to defend. 「Guardian Presence」
Quay Skirmish The enemy's biggest transport dock is located in this sector. A gigantic defense base detected, prepare for a long battle. Cryofluid and Plastanium technologies acquired.

Twin Channels Two parallel channels split this region into 3 sections. Enemy units are approaching in multiple directions. Take advantage of the terrain to set up defenses. Plastanium conveyors and Plastanium walls unlocked. 「Night Times」

Uninvited Guest A gigantic exponential tier unit detected in the upcoming attack. Advanced turret and generator unlocked. This unit has equipped with energy laser weapon. Plastanium Walls will be essential to prevent it piercing through. 「Guardian Presence」 「Night Times」
Eastern Coast A gigantic enemy coastal defense array is located at the edge of a barren desert. Produce minkes and oxynoes to help clear out threatening enemy turrets.

Arid Streambed Ages ago, a stream travelled through this place, now vaporized due to drought. Some ancient facilities was set up around the riverbank. Waters have been vaporized in this place. Use Water Extractors to extract groundwater.

Barren Saltmarsh A tremendous salt flat with no ground water. Thoroughly desolated sector with heavy resource poverty. Advanced silicon production technique acquired. A new resource is sensored in this barren desert.
Storage Gateway This place is taken over by the enemies as a resource transport hub. Sabotage the gates with hail turret and demolish the enemies' transport facilities.

Asphalt Deposits Deeper into the deserts, abundant asphalt has formed into tar lakes in this sector. Gather as much resources as possible. Silicon crucibles gain extra effiency when placed on thermal tiles. Take advantage of abundant oil and magma resources.

docs.title: Oxide Wall
docs.text: Protects own buildings, blocks enemy shells. Can absorb lasers and arcs, but also prevents automatic connection of power nodes. Can adsorb scattered Neoplasm on ground, but has adsorption limit.

docs.title: Explosive
docs.text:
Mysterious square box with powerful explosives inside, explodes when destroyed or manually triggered.

Loading corrosive tumor block may increase explosive power.

docs.title: Coagulant Ingot
docs.text:
Oxide adsorbed with Neoplasm, still restless inside. Recommended to incinerate.

But perhaps it has other uses.

docs.title: Neoplasm Protein
docs.text: Dead Neoplasm, but not completely lifeless. Under suitable conditions, it may regain activity.

docs.title: Ammonia
docs.text:
NH₃ gas, with a strong pungent odor, an important chemical raw material.

Seems to inhibit Neoplasm and its parasites.

docs.title: Nutrient Solution
docs.text: A nutrient-rich liquid used to cultivate organisms.

docs.title: Venous Plasma
docs.text:
Nutrient-depleted plasma, darker in color, less fluid.

Can be revitalized in respiratory tissues.

docs.title: Lysosome
docs.text: Core swarm unit, uses height advantage to bombard buildings with acid projectiles. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Ribosome
docs.text: Basic swarm unit, follows the nearby unit with highest HP, assists in combat. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Trichocyst
docs.text: Elite swarm unit, fires high-pressure acid streams capable of piercing buildings. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Bomber
docs.text: Vanguard swarm unit, destroys buildings via suicide attacks, spreading plasma on the ground.

docs.title: Cell Wall
docs.text: Core swarm unit, equipped with corrosive field and shield, cannot attack but provides strong protective effect for other units. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Diploid
docs.text: Core swarm unit, sprays large amounts of acid liquid at distant units and buildings. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Haploid
docs.text: Basic swarm unit, sprays acid liquid at targets. Absorbs nearby plasma to self-heal, leaves plasma upon death.

docs.title: Triploid
docs.text: Elite swarm unit, cannot attack directly, launches suicide bugs to attack buildings. Absorbs plasma to heal, leaves large plasma upon death.
